jobs.title: Assistant Workplace lead
jobs.description:
CBRE Global Workplace Solutions is a leading global provider of integrated facilities and corporate real estate management. We are recruiting for an Assistant Workplace Lead to join our team in Stockholm. This is a great opportunity for an experienced and enthusiastic candidate to join a global account team.

As Assistant Workplace Lead you will deputize to the Workplace Operations Lead, providing strategic support and operational leadership across campus. This role drives operational excellence, leads improvement projects, and supports governance and reporting activities to ensure high-quality service delivery and customer satisfaction.

Acting as a trusted partner to the Workplace Operations Lead, this role ensures continuity of leadership, drives operational initiatives, and maintains strong relationships with stakeholders and service partners. The Assistant Lead plays a critical role in translating strategic vision into operational execution, supporting the team to deliver consistent, efficient, and customer-focused facilities services across all sites within the geographical scope.

What You'll Do:

Client relationship and stakeholder engagement


    Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across campus and act a senior point of contact

    Represent CBRE interests and teams while aligning with the client's needs and expectations

    Support in client engagement activities and service review meetings with senior stakeholders

    Communicate operational updates, changes, and improvements to stakeholders in both English and Swedish

    Foster collaborative relationships with service providers and suppliers


Finance, governance and reporting


    Be well-versed in CBRE's contractual commitments, including financial, commercial and performance models and ensure operational compliance with contractual obligations

    Collate, prepare and analyse performance and governance reports to enable client sign off

    Collaborate with Workplace operations- lead, managers and Finance teams to prepare accurate forecasts, financial performance reviews and budget drafts

    Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to help the team and client to better understand the operational output

    Prepare analysis and presentations on operational performance, key performance indicators, customer satisfaction and trends and make recommendations for improvements and service adjustments


Leadership and team support


    Support the Workplace Operations Lead in team leadership and management

    Provide guidance, coaching, and support to Workplace Operations Managers

    Foster a culture focused on service excellence, proactiveness and continuous improvement

    Support performance management activities, succession planning and team development initiatives

    Drive the one team and service first mindset across campus alongside the client

    Review and sign off on annual leave and other resource planning activities


Operational leadership and site management


    Support the Workplace Operations Lead in overseeing facilities operations and service delivery

    Good understanding of CBRE's contractual commitments, including statement of work, matrix of responsibility and service level agreements in order to translate these into effective deliverables for the teams in collaboration with the Workplace operations lead

    Act as deputy to the Workplace Operations Lead, providing leadership continuity in their absence

    Monitor service delivery performance and identify areas requiring attention or improvement and coordinate with Workplace operations managers to resolve challenges and implement improvements

    Working closely with QHSE- and operational teams to ensure sites are fully compliant with the client's and CBRE's QHSE standards

    Ensure health and safety policies and observations are logged to minimize risk exposure and enable a safe workplace environment

    Review and sign off all campus applicable risk assessments together with the Workplace Operations Manager


Improvement projects and strategic initiatives


    Lead and manage improvement projects to enhance operational efficiency and service quality

    Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement solutions

    Drive continuous improvement initiatives across campus operations

    Be an active participant in our vendor care program, working closely with strategically important service partners across the contract

    Support implementation of transformational change programs, including the Evolve program

    Analyse operational data and trends to inform strategic decision-making

    Program manage key projects, acting as a conduit between the client and CBRE's operational and project teams


Working hours and location

This position is based at the client's premises in Kista, Stockholm. This role requires onsite presence Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00, depending on business needs. Occasional travel to other locations may be required.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
ECARX is a global automotive technology provider partnering with OEMs to accelerate the future of software-defined vehicles. As OEMs develop new vehicle platforms from the ground up, ECARX is developing a full-stack solutions to enhance the user experience, while reducing complexity and cost.

To date ECARX products have been integrated into more than 8.7 million cars worldwide, and we continue to shape the interaction between people and vehicles by rapidly advancing the technology at the heart of smart mobility. Founded in 2017, and listed on the Nasdaq in 2022, we have more than 1,800 team members across Europe, Asia and the Americas working towards one ambition: to redefine the driving experience

We are now looking for a Product Owner to join our team in Gothenburg.

About the role

The purpose of the role is to serve as a Product Owner. This involves defining goals and creating a vision for the assigned area from a high-level perspective. The Product Owner is responsible for generating a backlog of items and prioritizing them in accordance with the overall strategy and business objectives established by the Product Manager.

To ensure that the product's vision, strategy, and priorities are aligned, the Product Owner should invest a significant amount of time in understanding the product and the value it delivers. Additionally, the Product Owner serves as the primary communicator and liaison between stakeholders and teams.

Main responsibilities

    Prioritizing and managing the product backlog to ensure smooth development
    Translating strategies devised by product managers into actionable tasks for development
    Gaining insights into the market and customer requirements to enhance product quality
    Acting as a liaison between product and development teams to ensure seamless communication
    Being available to answer development team's queries and concerns
    Providing an explanation of why the product is best and how it aligns with the overall product strategy
    Attending Feature & Planning HUB and Trinity meetings as an active member
    Managing stakeholder expectations effectively

Required Qualifications

    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    Proven experience working as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or similar role within software development.
    Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum, and experience working in Agile development teams.
    Experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs, including writing and refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
    Ability to translate business objectives and product strategies into clear and actionable development requirements.
    Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to balance competing priorities and expectations.
    Experience gathering, analyzing, and prioritizing customer, user, and market requirements.
    Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to act as an effective bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
    Demonstrated ability to define product goals, communicate product vision, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.
    Experience working closely with software developers, UX/UI designers, and other product team members throughout the development lifecycle.
    Ability to make prioritization decisions and provide clear guidance to development teams in a fast-paced environment.
    Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders simultaneously.
    Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Lead Engineer - Plants who wants to take on a key role at HVDC in technical leadership in tenders and projects. You will have the responsibility to coordinate global teams with focus on Plants and Civil engineering design solutions and its interfaces for our onshore and offshore converter stations.  

As a Lead Engineer - Plants, you will drive strategic technical decision making, ensure that our design solutions meet customer requirements, quality standards and project goals. You interact with other stakeholders such as customers, contractors, supply chain and site team, contributing to the successful delivery of some of the world's most advanced energy infrastructure projects. The role is offering a unique opportunity to contribute to the global energy transition while working in a highly collaborative and international environment. We are looking for three Lead Engineers. This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden.

"Are you ready to become part of a group of technical leaders with a passion for supporting our engineering teams and driving them forward? We work closely with many different functions and as a Lead Engineer - Plants, you will play a key role in driving transparency around technical solutions and their impact on projects that contribute to a greener future."

– Kamilla Sommarsjö, Global Head HVDC Lead Engineers - Plants

How You'll Make an Impact

Your Background

jobs.title: QA Manager, Product Growth
jobs.description:
You are a QA Manager leading and developing QA within our Product Growth team. You own our QA strategy and how we approach quality across the full growth journey — from acquisition entry points through website, sign-up, payments, subscriptions, and in-app experiences.

Your mission is to help Product Growth move faster while improving the quality of what we ship. You look beyond individual features and releases to understand the end-to-end customer journey, focusing QA where it matters most — across experimentation, analytics and tracking, payments, and the different devices, browsers, and in-app browsers our users rely on.

You lead and develop our QA team while continuously improving how we work. Through smarter testing strategies, automation, AI, and modern QA practices, you help reduce repetitive manual work, catch more meaningful issues, and enable faster development and release cycles.

What you will be doing

    

Own the QA strategy and operating model for Product Growth, defining what we test, how we test it, and where QA effort creates the most value

    

Lead, coach, and develop our QA team, supporting their performance, career development, and growing capabilities in areas such as automation

    

Take an end-to-end view of quality across the growth journey, ensuring we test both individual functionality and how experiences work together across surfaces, browsers, devices, and entry points

    

Improve QA processes and prioritization to shorten the time from idea to launch without compromising quality

    

Drive the adoption of test automation, AI, and modern tooling to make QA more effective and scalable

    

Lead the QA approach for larger cross-pod and cross-functional initiatives, identifying risks early and defining the right testing strategy

    

Partner closely with Product and Engineering, and collaborate with Marketing, Design, Analytics, and other teams when needed to ensure quality across the broader customer journey

    

Build a strong quality mindset across Product Growth, making QA an integrated part of product development rather than a final step before release

What skills and experience we think you have

    

QA leadership: Experience leading and developing QA professionals and owning QA strategy, processes, and ways of working

    

Growth product experience: Strong experience testing growth-oriented digital products, including commercial funnels, experimentation/A/B testing, analytics and tracking, conversion journeys, and fast-moving product environments

    

End-to-end quality mindset: You think beyond individual features and understand quality across complete user journeys, including different browsers, devices, entry points, and systems

    

Test automation: Hands-on experience with test automation — whether through implementation, technical evaluation, or close collaboration with automation engineers — strong enough to guide framework and tooling decisions for our stack

    

AI and modern QA practices: Experience using AI and modern QA tooling to improve testing efficiency, effectiveness, or scalability

    

Commercial understanding: Experience with areas such as payments, pricing, subscriptions, or other high-impact commercial flows

    

Strategic and pragmatic thinking: Balances a clear long-term view of where QA needs to go with pragmatic, in-the-moment trade-off calls under time pressure.

    

Risk-based prioritization: Ability to identify where the biggest quality risks lie — including dependencies between features, experiments, and user journeys — and guide the team on where deeper testing or other quality measures deliver the most value.

    

Cross-functional leadership: Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence Product, Engineering, and other partners

It's a plus if you also have

    

Experience across both web and mobile apps

    

Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks

    

Experience with subscription-based products

jobs.title: Category Manager
jobs.description:
The sourcing organization at Husqvarna Forest & Garden Division is divided into several functions and categories, in order to secure quality, delivery, cost efficiency and sustainability throughout the supply chain. The Sourcing team is dedicated to deliver on our full range of business targets and to provide a profound base for our teams driving these objectives together with over 1000 suppliers and are guided by the principles of Strategic, Collaborative, and Professional. One of the key functions within Sourcing is category management and related commercial relationships with suppliers. Our task is to ensure that the greatest value is provided to the organization´s internal customers and thereby positively affecting the overall business result.

About the role

As Category Manager you are part of a highly motivated team of Category Managers and Operational Buyers and you report to the Sourcing Director Powertrain Categories. You will be overall responsible for the sourcing of accessories to Husqvarna Forest & Garden. This specific role will be responsible for accessories to robotics & wheeled portfolio. The accessories business is a highly strategic and profitable part of Husqvarna’s business offering. Your primary responsibility is to develop and apply business strategy and relationship management, deliver value in terms of quality, delivery, cost efficiency, innovation and sustainability for your categories during the full product life cycle.

You will step into a broad commercial role where you can build on your initial purchasing experience, gradually take on greater responsibility and continue developing within category management.

Your main tasks:

· Be ultimately responsible for all commercial relations with the suppliers within your categories and secure set targets of cost, quality, delivery and sustainability.

· Create long term strategies, well anchored with internal stakeholders, for your categories to deliver optimized value and drive implementation of the same.

· Develop and maintain vendor agreements.

· Manage sourcing projects and lead negotiations of commercial terms and conditions.

· Build and maintain mutually beneficial relations with suppliers in order to improve supplier performance and collaboration, not only to decrease costs and eliminate waste but also to utilize the suppliers full potential in areas such as product development and innovation.

· Build and maintain strong internal relations within sourcing functions such as Project Sourcing, Supplier Quality Assurance and Supplier Development but also with other internal stakeholders such as R&D, Product Management & Logistics.

·  Set up and manage the annual budget of cost saving activities and negotiations.

About you

To succeed in this role, we expect you have:

    A bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, engineering, supply chain management or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
    Around 2 to 3 years of experience within purchasing, sourcing or another relevant commercial role.
    A good commercial understanding and an interest in developing further within strategic sourcing and category management.
    Experience of working in an international environment is an advantage.
    Fluent in English

You also demonstrate a strong understanding of both internal and external customer service, complemented by exceptional communication abilities that encompass strategic thinking, diplomatic finesse, social competence, and negotiation skills.

Further it is of importance that you have strong influencing skills to promote Category Strategies to Business Partners, Experience and insights in the Purchasing environment and strong planning, analytical and organizing abilities.

Location and work setup

This role is based in Huskvarna. Occasional travel within service is expected, approximately 10 days per year.

We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application

Can you envision yourself being a part of this? If so, send us your application including resumé and personal letter already today. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations.

For questions regarding the position please contact hiring manager Johan Grauf at johan.grauf@husqvarnagroup.com.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Jonathan Olsson at jonathan.olsson@husqvarnagroup.com.

What happens after you apply?

The application period will be set during the summer and the selection process will start up in mid-to-late August. Do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions, but response time might be longer than usual due to the vacation period.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.  

Our culture is built on three core themes:  

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.  
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.  

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!  

Learn more about our culture here

områder i samfunnet. Som BPA-assistent skal en fungere som arbeidsleders forlengede armer/ben/øyne.

Er man BPA for barn skal man bistå barnet med å være barn, men samtidig være en trygg voksen som avlaster foreldre.

Som tilkallingsvikar kan du søke på ledige vakter, eller bli tilkalt ved behov. Du står fritt til å takke ja eller nei til vakter ut fra hva som
passer for deg. Det er likevel viktig at du er fleksibel og kan stille på kort varsel ved sykdom hos andre ansatte.

Vi har flere ledige stillinger, så det er stor fleksibilitet i å finne en match mellom deg og den du skal jobbe hos, og deres og din
timeplan.

Presiser derfor gjerne i din søknad:

Personlig pleie
Forflytning

Være med på reiser Kjøre bil

Er pålitelig

Har gode norskkunnskaper Er noe praktisk anlagt
Kan arbeide selvstendig
Helst har førerkort klasse B
Har plettfri vandel

Det er ingen krav om formell utdanning når en skal jobbe som BPA-assistent. Vi ser alltid etter en god match mellom arbeidsleder og
assistent. Personlig egnethet vektlegges. Det framsettes krav om plettfri vandel og politiattest må søkes før eventuell oppstart. Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser (tariff) med grunnlønn på 236,49kr i timen, rask og effektiv oppstart for aktuelle kandidater og fast kontaktperson hos Medvind

For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. jobs.title: Postdoktor i bioinformatik och cancergenetik
jobs.description:
Göteborgs universitet möter samhällets utmaningar med mångsidig kunskap. 58 000 studenter och 6800 medarbetare gör universitetet till en stor och inspirerande arbetsplats. Stark forskning och attraktiva utbildningar lockar forskare och studenter från hela världen. Med ny kunskap och nya perspektiv bidrar Göteborgs universitet till en bättre framtid.



Ämne

Bioinformatik och cancergenetik



Ämnesbeskrivning

Somatisk mutationsackumulering och klonal evolution är centrala processer i cancerutveckling. Genom storskalig helgenomsekvensering och storskaliga metoder kan dessa processer kartläggas i detalj, vilket ger insikter i tumörinitiering, progression och behandlingsrespons.

Denna tjänst fokuserar på utveckling och tillämpning av bioinformatiska metoder för analys av genomiska cancerdata, inklusive stora publika internationella dataset och lokalt genererade patientnära sekvenseringsdata. Projektet omfattar studier av somatiska mutationsprocesser, klonal dynamik, tumörers utvecklingshistoria eller integrativa analyser av genomiska och kliniska data. Analyser av icke-cancerrelaterade sekvenseringsdata kan också komma i fråga.

Arbetet sker i en forskningsmiljö med stark kompetens inom cancergenomik, beräkningsbiologi och translationell forskning.

Arbeten publicerade av gruppen under senare tid inkluderar:



Ögren et al., Light-based footprinting of a eukaryotic genome. Science Advances 2026; Elliott et al., Mechanistic basis of atypical TERT promoter mutations. Nature Communications. 2024; Elliott et al. Base-resolution UV footprinting by sequencing reveals distinctive damage signatures for DNA-binding proteins. Nature Communications. 2023; Boström et al. Somatic mutation distribution across tumour cohorts provides a signal for positive selection in cancer. Nature Communications. 2022; Elias et al. Independent somatic evolution underlies clustered neuroendocrine tumors in the human small intestine. Nature Communications. 2021; Van den Eynden et al. Lack of detectable neoantigen depletion signals in the untreated cancer genome. Nature Genetics. 2019.





Arbetsuppgifter

Den postdoktorala forskaren kommer att tillämpa och utveckla bioinformatiska metoder för analys av helgenomsekvensering och andra NGS-baserade data från patienter, så som mutationscalling och detektion av mosaikmutationer. Arbetet kan också innefatta statistiska analyser och visualisering för att identifiera och tolka somatiska mutationsmönster och andra genomiska förändringar, samt integration av genomiska data med kliniska och fenotypiska variabler när så är relevant. Forskaren förväntas bidra till manuskriptförfattande och publicering i internationella vetenskapliga tidskrifter, och kan komma att presentera forskningsresultat vid nationella och internationella konferenser.



Behörighet

Behörighet för anställning som lärare regleras i Högskoleförordningen 4 Kap och Göteborgs universitets anställningsordning.

Behörig att anställas som postdoktor är den som har avlagt doktorsexamen, konstnärlig doktorsexamen eller som har en utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara doktorsexamen.

I första hand bör den komma i fråga som har avlagt examen högst tre år före ansökningstidens utgång. Även den som avlagt examen tidigare bör komma i fråga i första hand, om det finns särskilda skäl. Med särskilda skäl avses ledighet på grund av sjukdom, föräldraledighet, förtroendeuppdrag inom fackliga organisationer, tjänstgöring inom totalförsvaret, eller andra liknande omständigheter samt klinisk tjänstgöring eller för ämnesområdet relevant tjänstgöring/uppdrag.



Bedömningsgrund

Goda programmeringskunskaper och erfarenhet av linux/unix är ett krav. Kunskaper i R eller Matlab är också mycket önskvärt. Tidigare erfarenhet av analys av storskalig sekvenseringsdata rekommenderas, särskilt kunskaper inom mappning av somatiska mutationer. Erfarenhet från relevanta biologiska områden är önskvärt, och den sökande förväntas ha publicerat flera referentgranskade vetenskapliga artiklar. Utmärkta kommunikativa färdigheter krävs, inklusive flytande engelska i tal och skrift.

Bedömningsgrunder vid anställning som lärare finns angivna i 4 kap 3 – 4 § högskoleförordningen samt Göteborgs universitets egen anställningsordning.



Anställning

Anställningen är på heltid och tidsbegränsad, två år med möjlighet till ett års förlängning, med placering tills vidare på institutionen för biomedicin. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.



Tillsättningsförfarande

https://www.gu.se/jobba-hos-goteborgs-universitet/sa-blir-du-en-av-oss#S%C3%A5-h%C3%A4r-g%C3%A5r-rekryteringsprocessen-till%20%]%C2%A0



Kontaktuppgifter för anställningen

Upplysningar om anställningen lämnas av: Erik Larsson Lekholm, Professor, phone: +46 31 786 6942, e-mail: erik.lekholm@gu.se.



Fackliga organisationer

Fackliga företrädare vid Götebrgs universitet hittar du här: https://www.gu.se/jobba-hos-goteborgs-universitet/sa-blir-du-en-av-oss#kollektivavtal-och-fackliga-foretradare



Ansökningsförfarande

Du söker anställningen via Göteborgs universitets rekryteringsportal genom att klicka på knappen "Ansök". Du som sökande ansvarar för att ansäkan är komplett i enlighet med annonsen och att den är univversitetet tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdag.

Ansökan ska innehålla:

    Ett personligt brev med motivering till varför du söker tjänsten
    CV som inkluderar vetenskapliga publikationer
    Två referenser med kontaktuppgifter
    Kopia på bevis för doktorsexamen



Ansökan ska vara inkommen senast: 2026-10-10



Universitetet arbetar aktivt för en arbetsmiljö med jämställda förhållanden och sätter värde på de kvalitéer mångfald tillför verksamheten. Universitetet tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Enligt Riksarkivets föreskrifter är universitetet skyldigt att förvara ansökningshandlingar i två år efter tillsättningsbeslutet. Om du som sökande till en anställning särskilt begär tillbaka dina handlingar återsänds de när de två åren har förflutit, i annat fall kommer de att gallras ut. Till bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare: Göteborgs universitet anlitar upphandlad annonsbyrå i samband med rekrytering av personal. Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av jobbannonser.

jobs.title: Konsulent til elektronisk sagsdokumenthåndtering (ESDH) på Professionshøjskolen Absalon
jobs.description:
Brænder du for elektronisk sagsdokumenthåndtering (ESDH), SharePoint og for at omsætte brugernes behov til digitale løsninger, der fungerer i praksis? Vi søger en ESDH-konsulent med stærk SharePoint-faglighed, der vil være en central brik i arbejdet med at implementere, drifte og videreudvikle vores ESDH-løsning.

På Absalon har vi et mål om at arbejde tæt sammen på tværs af vores uddannelser, fællesfunktioner og campusser, så vi udnytter vores mange styrker og store viden. Vi vil udvikle fælles løsninger, uanset om det gælder digitalisering, studieadministration, vejledning af de studerende, drift af kantiner, udvikling af campusmiljøer eller noget helt andet, der er vigtigt for vores uddannelsesopgave.

Vi er i gang med at implementere en ny ESDH-løsning i WorkPoint, der bygger på SharePoint. Løsningen skal understøtte organisationens arbejde med sager og dokumenter, hvilket kræver løbende udvikling af blandt andet skabeloner, arbejdsgange og automatiseringer.

Din profil
Vi søger dig, der har erfaring med ESDH og trives i rollen mellem brugernes behov og de tekniske muligheder. Det er væsentligt, at du kan se dig selv i følgende:

Viden om ESDH og SharePoint. Du har erfaring med ESDH og en stærk teknisk forståelse for SharePoint samt Microsoft 365. Du forstår samspillet mellem dokumenthåndtering, metadata, rettigheder, arbejdsgange og den tekniske platform.

Omsætter behov til løsninger. Du er nysgerrig på, hvordan dine kolleger arbejder, og kan omsætte deres behov til konkrete løsninger. Du kan gå fra dialog om en arbejdsgang til eksempelvis en skabelon, ændret opsætning eller automatisering.

Detaljeorienteret og evner at samarbejde på tværs. Du trives med at arbejde struktureret med systemer og processer. Derudover er du god til at samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper, og du kan kommunikere tekniske løsninger til både teknikere og kolleger uden stor teknisk forståelse.

Derudover forventer vi, at du har:>
  • en relevant teknisk uddannelse eller erfaring, f.eks. inden for IT, systemadministration eller lignende
  • relevant erfaring med ESDH samt stærk faglighed indenfor SharePoint
  • erfaring med at afdække brugerbehov og omsætte dem til digitale løsninger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Din primære opgave bliver vores ESDH-løsning, hvor du får en vigtig rolle i implementeringen og den efterfølgende drift og videreudvikling. Du skal være bindeled mellem organisationen og løsningen, hvor du sikrer, at brugernes behov bliver forstået og omsat til løsninger, der fungerer i praksis. Som en del af Team Digitalisering får du også mulighed for at bidrage til andre digitale løsninger og opgaver.

Eksempler på opgaver er:
Videreudvikle sammen med brugerne. Du skal være i tæt dialog med brugerne om deres arbejdsgange og behov og omsætte dem til konkrete løsninger i ESDH, eksempelvis skabeloner, arbejdsgange og automatiseringer.

Konfiguration, test og kvalitetssikring. Du skal arbejde med vores ESDH-løsning og SharePoint, hvor du skal konfigurere, teste og kvalitetssikre ændringer og nye funktioner. Du skal fordybe dig i tekniske problemstillinger og følge dem til dørs.

Samarbejde med vores tekniske kolleger om sikkerhed, integrationer, brugeradministration m.m. Du skal også samarbejde med vores leverandører om fejl, ændringer og videreudvikling, samt udarbejde dokumentation og vejledninger, der gør løsningerne brugervenlige.

Du skal desuden understøtte brugere med teknisk hjælp og kompetenceudvikling i form af blandt andet kurser og webinarer.

Dine arbejdsopgaver er varierende og vi tilbyder gode muligheder for fleksible arbejdsforhold, herunder hjemmearbejde, når det passer ind i opgaverne.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver ansat i Digital og Analyse under Team Digitalisering. Du bliver en del af et dedikeret team, der arbejder med forskellige digitale løsninger og projekter på tværs af Absalon, og som værdsætter faglighed, nytænkning, samarbejde og trivsel.

Hos os får du mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer gennem spændende og varierende arbejdsopgaver. ESDH bliver dit primære ansvarsområde, men du bliver samtidig en del af teamets øvrige arbejde med at udvikle og understøtte digitale løsninger i organisationen.

Arbejdsstedet er på Campus Slagelse, hvor vi har en sund og varieret kantineordning og mulighed for at træne i vores fitnesslokale eller bare på alle de mange trapper, der er på campus - vi bor på 5. etage. Hvis du er med toget, så er vi placeret lige ved Slagelse Station, så du kører næsten lige til døren.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have, at du begynder snarest muligt.
  • Afhængigt af din anciennitet og uddannelsesbaggrund vil en forventet løn ligge mellem 40.000 kr. og 50.000 kr. pr. måned ekskl. pension. Hertil kommer et pensionsbidrag på 16,68% eller 18,07% afhængigt af din uddannelsesbaggrund.
  • Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Anders Nordbøge Thiel på mail andt@pha.dk eller tlf. 7248 3020.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 20. september 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. samtale den 23. september og 2. samtale den 25. september.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Familjebehandlare till Hemmaplansteamet
jobs.description:
Ref: 20261940

Nu utökar vi Hemmaplansteamet med ytterligare två familjebehandlare!

Arbetsuppgifter

Hemmaplansteamet erbjuder en intensiv och flexibel familjebehandling riktad mot föräldraförmågan för familjer med barn och ungdomar som uppvisat normbrytande beteende. Målgruppen är familjer med barn mellan 10 år och 18 år.

Hemmaplansteamet arbetar med en målgrupp, normbrytande barn och ungdomar och deras närmaste nätverk. Det kan vara barn och ungdomar med utåtagerande beteende, att det är en hög konfliktnivå i hemmet och på andra platser, att man ses i sammanhang med äldre kriminella, att man ses på platser som förknippas med drogförsäljning och där det finns en risk för att man utvecklar ett kriminellt beteende/tankemönster

Målet med insatsen är att hjälpa familjer att hitta ett fungerande sätt att hantera familjens svårigheter samt att utveckla fungerande kommunikationsvägar. Hemmaplansteamet arbetar tätt tillsammans med Lyftet och Flexet, som är två andra sektioner inom enheten Plattformen. Lyftet eller Flexet tar då ofta ansvar för stödet och behandlingen för barnet/ungdomen och Hemmaplansteamet fokuserar på behandling för föräldrar och andra viktiga personer i barnets/ungdomens liv.

Hemmaplansteamet bedriver främst behandling i hemmet. Minst en gång per termin erbjuder Hemmaplansteamet föräldraskapskurser enligt Connect. Arbetet är schemalagt till 08:00-16:30 Det finns möjlighet att arbeta helg. Journalföring sker i Journal Digital.

Kvalifikationer

Krav:

    Socionomexamen, beteendevetare, socialpedagog eller annan högskole- eller universitetsutbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
    Erfarenhet av behandlingsarbete med målgruppen ungdomar och deras familjer
    B-körkort för manuellt växlad bil
    Goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift

Meriterande:

    Vidareutbildning i behandlingsarbete eller samtalsmetodik ex KBT, FFT, IHF eller MST
    Erfarenhet av familjer med psykisk ohälsa, kriminalitet och neuropsykiatri
    Kunskaper i övriga språk utöver svenska

Då du dagligen möter många människor, såväl ungdomar och dess familjer som kollegor och andra aktörer krävs att du har god förmåga till samarbete och att skapa relation. Då en stor del av tjänsten innebär samordning och kontakt med flertalet aktörer krävs att du är strukturerad. Det är även viktigt att du är flexibel både när det gäller arbetstider, ändrade omständigheter och en vilja att testa nya arbetssätt.

Om arbetsplatsen

Hemmaplansteamet är en öppenvårdsverksamhet inom Arbetsmarknads- och socialförvaltningen och är organiserad inom IFO Insats, enhet Plattform Malmö, stöd och behandling. I sektionen arbetar en sektionschef och en samordnare, nio familjebehandlare.

Som anställd hos oss erbjuds du extern handledning, kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling, flexibel arbetstid samt möjlighet till semesterväxling och friskvårdsbidrag.

Vid Sveriges största arbetsmarknads- och socialförvaltning jobbar 2500 medarbetare varje dag för att stärka Malmöbor. Tillsammans med Malmöborna vill vi öka möjligheterna till egen försörjning, minska hemlöshet, bidra till att barn och unga ska få bra uppväxtvillkor och verka för att nyanlända ska få goda förutsättningar. Det är ett viktigt och roligt arbete, men långt ifrån enkelt. Sök jobb hos oss, du kommer att göra skillnad.

Malmö stads verksamheter är organiserade i 14 förvaltningar. Vårt gemensamma uppdrag är att skapa välfärd och hållbar samhällsutveckling. Tillsammans med Malmöborna utvecklar vi en ännu bättre stad att bo, verka och vara i; olikheter, livserfarenheter och talanger gör Malmö till en smart stad i hjärtat av Europa. Världens kunskap finns här.

Läs om Malmö stad som arbetsgivare här http://www.malmo.se/jobb

Information om tjänsten

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställningar. Omfattning: Heltid Antal tjänster: 2 Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.

Övrigt

Observera att vi i Malmö stad tagit bort det personliga brevet från ansökningsprocessen och ersatt det med urvalsfrågor, detta för en mer inkluderande rekryteringsprocess och en effektiv kandidatupplevelse för dig som söker jobb hos oss. Dina svar blir en viktig del i vårt urvalsarbete.

Innan anställning erbjuds behöver du visa upp examensbevis från socionomutbildning, id-handling (pass eller nationellt id-kort) samt utdrag ur belastningsregister.

Malmö stad strävar efter att medarbetarna ska representera den mångfald som finns i vår stad. Vi välkomnar därför sökande som kan bidra till att vi som arbetsgivare kan uppfylla Malmöbornas behov.

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Computer System Engineer - Project Manager
jobs.description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.

Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves  

Test Facilities Development is part of Engineering Operations (91000) within Volvo Cars Engineering. Our core responsibility is to develop, procure and install facilities for testing and prototype builds.







We provide advanced engineering services ranging from initial pilot studies to fully operational facilities, covering both minor equipment and large-scale installations. Most of our work is carried out in project form, in close collaboration with internal customers, purchasing department, consultants and external contractors.







The Test Facilities Development team consists of 19 employees, supported by consultants through bought services.

     What you'll do  

As a Project Manager/Computer System Engineer, you will be part of a team with primary focus on control and computer systems. You will be responsible for defining and leading projects and assignments aimed at delivering test solutions for our R&D test facilities.







Typical laboratories and facilities include battery labs, electrical powertrain and motor testing, crash testing, durability testing, pilot plant, concept centre and more.







Within our investment projects, you will be responsible as a project manager for computer systems, IT networks and control systems with the cyber security setup. The results from the test equipment consist of measurement data used in our car development projects.







Our work spans the test automation area, from early investigations to industrialization. The role requires participation in investment projects with responsibility for time, functionality and cost. This includes budget work, follow-up, planning and coordination of internal resources and suppliers.







Together with internal customers, you will gather requirements and create use cases to be used in requirement specifications. The role also includes installation, commissioning and acceptance testing of test equipment.







Key responsibilities include:



• Creating specifications and technical solutions together with relevant stakeholders, both in early project phases and in approved projects



• In collaboration with the purchasing department, managing requests for quotations and participating in procurement and project follow-up of test automation systems



• Participating in engineering, installation, commissioning, final testing, and coordination activities

     What you'll bring  

You would bring strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills as well as technical knowledge of cybersecurity principles, automation and test systems. You have clear and effective communication and interpersonal skills. You are highly organized and experienced in complex projects.







You carry a B.Sc./M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent. You would have at least five years of experience of data technology or industrial automation. You carry strong knowledge in data technology, industrial communication, data acquisition, requirements gathering, use case creation, process analysis and test automation architecture. You bring experience from testing and/or automation systems as well as acquainted with project-based work. You are fluent in both written and spoken English.







You are curious, eager to learn and driven to explore and innovate.  You are customer focused and committed to deliver high quality results. You are flexible and able to initiate tasks even when not all information is available at the outset. You are organized and structured, with excellent communication and documentation skills. You are able to build and maintain cross-functional networks, both within and outside your organization, to gain technical insights, drive learning, and improve ways of working. You have a balanced personality, being both team-oriented and self-motivated.

jobs.description:
Medvind Assistanse er i vekst og søker nå flere gode og fleksible BPA-assistenter på Senja. Vi søker assistenter sør på Senja og sentralt på Senja. Sentralt på Senja er det mulighet for opphold i assistentbolig, de dagene det jobbes.

Brukerstyrt personlig assistanse er et likestillingsverktøy, der assistenten skal bistå arbeidsleder med å være en aktiv deltaker på alle
områder i samfunnet. Som BPA-assistent skal en fungere som arbeidsleders forlengede armer/ben/øyne.

Er man BPA for barn skal man bistå barnet med å være barn, men samtidig være en trygg voksen som avlaster foreldre.

Som tilkallingsvikar kan du søke på ledige vakter, eller bli tilkalt ved behov. Du står fritt til å takke ja eller nei til vakter ut fra hva som
passer for deg. Det er likevel viktig at du er fleksibel og kan stille på kort varsel ved sykdom hos andre ansatte.

Vi har flere ledige stillinger, så det er stor fleksibilitet i å finne en match mellom deg og den du skal jobbe hos, og deres og din
timeplan.

Presiser derfor gjerne i din søknad:
Hvor stor arbeidskapasitet du har

Personlig pleie
Forflytning
Være med på aktiviteter og ærender Praktisk bistand
Være med på reiser Kjøre bil

Har gode norskkunnskaper Er noe praktisk anlagt
Kan arbeide selvstendig
Helst har førerkort klasse B

jobs.title: Kanskje det er akkurat deg jeg leter etter?
jobs.description:
Liker du gode samtaler, humor, en aktiv hverdag, og å gjøre en forskjell for et annet menneske? Da håper jeg du leser videre. Jeg søker assistenter til tilkalling med mulighet til fast på sikt. 

 Jeg er en mann i 70-årene som bor i egen leilighet. Jeg sitter i rullestol og er synssvekket og hører dårlig, og derfor trenger jeg litt hjelp i hverdagen. Samtidig er jeg en mann som har flere interessert og liker at det skjer noe slik at ikke hver dag blir helt lik. Jeg trenger ikke bare «et par ekstra hender». Jeg trenger personer som kan bidra til at jeg kan være aktiv, sosial og selvstendig, og som samtidig har lyst til å bli kjent med meg som person.

 

Hvem er jeg?

Jeg er sportsinteressert og liker å følge med på det som skjer innen sport. Jeg er også interessert i biler og politikk, og jeg liker å holde meg oppdatert på verden rundt meg.

Jeg setter pris på å komme meg ut på tur, trene, besøke venner og familie og ha gode samtaler. Jeg liker også å lese bøker gjennom lydbøker. Jeg har godt humør og setter pris på mennesker som er positive, hyggelige og har evnen til å se løsninger fremfor problemer.

 

Hva skal du hjelpe meg med?

Som assistent vil du være med på å gjøre hverdagen min enklere og mer innholdsrik. Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Praktisk og personlig bistand
  • Huslige oppgaver og holde orden hjemme
  • Matlaging og hjelp på kjøkkenet
  • Hjelp med av- og påkledning
  • Kjøre meg til og fra avtaler og aktiviteter
  • Bistå meg når jeg skal ut på tur
  • Bli med på besøk til venner og familie
  • Være en hyggelig samtalepartner
  • Bidra til at jeg kan gjøre tingene jeg ønsker i hverdagen

Noen ganger handler jobben om praktisk hjelp. Andre ganger handler det kanskje mest om å være til stede, ha en god samtale, le litt sammen eller bli med på noe jeg har lyst til å gjøre.

 

Hvem håper jeg å finne?

Jeg håper du er en person som er snill, omsorgsfull, pålitelig og ryddig. Du bør være komfortabel med å ta initiativ.


Det er viktig for meg at du:

  • Har førerkort klasse B
  • Behersker norsk godt, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Er tydelig i kommunikasjonen
  • Er et ordensmenneske
  • Er nysgjerrig og løsningsorientert
  • Har godt humør og en positiv innstilling
  • Er tålmodig, omsorgsfull og respektfull
  • Kan jobbe selvstendig og ta ansvar
  • Har politiattest og plettfri vandel

Jeg er synssvekket og hører også dårlig, så det er viktig at du snakker tydelig. Jeg bruker høreapparat.

Jeg søker flere tilkallingsassistenter med mulighet for fast på sikt som kan stille opp ved behov. Det kan være aktuelt med vakter på ulike tidspunkt, avhengig av behov og avtale.

Du trenger ikke nødvendigvis å ha erfaring fra lignende arbeid. Det viktigste for meg er hvem du er som person, hvordan du møter andre mennesker og om du har lyst til å bidra.

Arbeidstid og vilkår

Vi tilbyr forutsigbare rammer og gode vilkår, med fokus på både trivsel og kvalitet i tjenestene.

Hos oss får du:

  • Lønn etter tariff, med tillegg for kveld, natt og helg
  • God opplæring ved oppstart
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • En meningsfull og variert arbeidsdag
  • Fleksible løsninger innenfor turnus

Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg!

Ansettelser skjer fortløpende. 



Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Family medicine specialist opportunities across Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Family medicine specialist career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden has a growing demand for specialists in General Practice / Family Medicine within primary healthcare. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, physicians from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within Swedish primary care.

We collaborate with modern primary care centres across Sweden, from smaller community clinics to larger multidisciplinary healthcare centres. Our role is to help you find a position that matches your professional interests, preferred location and work-life balance.

Primary care physicians in Sweden play a central role in the healthcare system and work with a broad variety of cases, long-term patient relationships and close collaboration with other healthcare professionals.

Professional Development

General practitioners in Sweden work in a clinically focused environment with opportunities to develop areas of special interest. Many clinics also offer opportunities to participate in teaching or supervision of junior doctors, particularly in larger healthcare centres.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a major step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process from the first conversation to being fully established in Sweden.

Your personal advisor will assist with:

    medical licensing
    relocation planning
    practical matters related to moving and settling in

Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Support for Your Family

Many physicians relocate with their families. We therefore provide guidance regarding schools, childcare, housing and everyday life in Sweden.

We can also offer support for partners seeking employment, including opportunities within healthcare where relevant.

Language Training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required.

Dignus Medical provides intensive online Swedish language training with experienced instructors. The training is flexible and adapted to your schedule.

Language courses can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children to support their integration.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and excellent public services.

Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and family life.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children.

Requirements

We are looking for physicians who:

    Hold an EU-recognised specialist certification in General Practice / Family Medicine
    Have good communication skills in English
    Are motivated to learn Swedish and relocate to Sweden

Interested in learning more?

We’d love to hear from you. Submit your application or contact us today to explore current openings.

Let us help you take the next step in your career as a general practitioner specialist in Sweden!

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: People & Production Manager - Assembly & Delivery
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead a major production organisation and play a key role in shaping the future of one of Sweden's leading manufacturing businesses? At DOVISTA, you'll have the opportunity to drive operational excellence, develop leaders and make a lasting impact in an international industrial environment.

<img src="https://sae3ndp007.blob.core.windows.net/swe/4aa67c38-b348-4a74-81f8-9b8225ef9e06.jpg">

Your Opportunity

We are looking for a strong people and operations manager to take responsibility for our Assembly & Delivery operations, a critical part of our window manufacturing business. Leading approximately 200 employees through a team of six first-line managers and two process developers, you will play a key role in driving performance, strengthening the organisation and ensuring operational excellence across the organisation.

This role offers the opportunity to take responsibility for a large production area and make a significant impact on people, culture and operational performance. Whether you currently manage a production department, a manufacturing unit, or a sizeable operational team, you are motivated by driving results through others and developing strong leadership teams.

You will work closely with our Senior Director, Head of Operations Sweden, and be part of the production management team, contributing to both strategic direction and operational execution. This is a visible leadership position with significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on people, performance and culture. With around 600 colleagues at our Edsbyn site, you'll join a growing team in a company that's shaping the future.

Who You Are

You have a solid background in manufacturing or industrial operations and a track record of creating results through people, structure and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking responsibility for a larger operation, setting clear expectations, and creating accountability at all levels of the organisation. Just as important, you know how to engage people, develop talent and build a culture where performance and collaboration go hand in hand.

We believe you have:

    Proven experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment.
    Experience building strong teams and creating results through others
    A track record of driving operational improvements and delivering results
    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
    A university degree in engineering, production, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained through a successful leadership career in manufacturing.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
    To be considered for this position, you must hold a permanent work permit in Sweden.

Why Edsbyn?

Choosing to live and work in Edsbyn means embracing balance. You'll find proximity to nature, space for family life, and a welcoming community - all while making a real impact in a globally connected business. For the right person, this role offers a rare combination of significant leadership responsibility, long-term career opportunities, and a high quality of life in one of Sweden's most scenic regions.

Application



This recruitment is managed in collaboration with Jefferson Wells. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Recruitment Consultant Marjo Carlson at +46 70 377 06 64 or marjo.carlson@jeffersonwells.se.

Please submit your CV and a cover letter explaining your interest in the position and how your background, experience, and qualifications make you a strong fit for the role.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email. To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

Apply as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-09-23. Selection is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

About DOVISTA

DOVISTA is a leading European provider of vertical windows and exterior doors. With 13 distinctive brands and approximately 7,000 employees across 10 markets, the Group is locally strong and internationally connected, driven by a shared purpose to bring daylight and fresh air into people's everyday lives.

DOVISTA is built on a heritage rooted in Danish design, an entrepreneurial mindset and industry knowledge dating back to 1941. The company is part of the VKR Group and is wholly owned by VKR Holding A/S, a family- and foundation-owned company that includes a grant-giving Employee Foundation. Together, the VKR Group employs approximately 17,600 people in 38 countries.

About DOVISTA Sweden

DOVISTA Sweden brings together well-known brands such as Svenska Fönster, Mockfjärds Fönster, and VELFAC with local experts within a strong international group.

With approximately 700 employees, we are one of Sweden's leading window manufacturers. Together, we develop sustainable, high-quality solutions with a focus on our customers and the future.

jobs.title: Personlig Assistent i Bromma sökes - 100% med start omgående
jobs.employer: God Omsorg och Ledsagning i Storstockholm AB
jobs.description:
Ser du personlig assistans som ett serviceyrke snarare än ett vårdyrke?
Då tycker vi att du ska läsa vidare!
Personlig assistans handlar om att ge någon möjlighet att leva sitt liv på sina egna villkor - och du kommer att vara en viktig del i att göra det möjligt för oss. Arbetet innebär att ge stöd i vardagen, till exempel med hem och hushåll, personlig hygien och allt annat som hör ett helt vanligt liv till.
Om oss
Vi är två bröder mellan 25-30 år med omfattande funktionsnedsättningar. Med rätt assistans kan vi leva det liv vi vill - fullt av både aktivitet och lugna stunder.
Till vardags bor vi i en lägenhet i Annedal, Bromma tillsammans med våra två katter. Ibland är även två små, gulliga hundar hos oss, så det är viktigt att du inte är allergisk - och gillar du djur är det ett stort plus!

Tjänsten är på heltid (men kan göras till deltid med möjlighet till extrapass om rätt person önskar). Du arbetar dag/eftermiddag/kväll ELLER vaken natt. Arbetar du dag/kväll varvar du mellan oss båda, vilket ger variation i både tempo och arbetsuppgifter.

Vem är du?
Vi söker dig som vill ha ett långsiktigt uppdrag och som värdesätter relation, kvalitet och ansvar.
För att trivas hos oss tror vi att du är:

    Nyfiken och gillar att tänka utanför boxen
    Strukturerad och lösningsfokuserad
    Bra på att ha många bollar i luften
    Snabb i både kropp och knopp
    Intresserad av utveckling och att lära dig nytt

Du behöver tala och skriva svenska obehindrat, då arbetet även kan innebära stöd med AKK och TAKK. Erfarenhet är meriterande men inget krav. Din inställning till yrket personlig assistent är det viktiga!
Lite om vardagen hos oss
Vi gillar:

    Fart och fläkt - men också hemmamys
    Att bada, gå på museum, promenera och träffa kompisar
    Ordning och reda, och att ha det snyggt och fräscht hemma
    Att baka och fixa tillsammans

Vi söker dig som vill ge lite extra - och få mycket tillbaka
Hos oss får du ett arbete där din flexibilitet och ditt engagemang verkligen gör skillnad - och där du blir en viktig del av vår vardag.

Känner du igen dig i beskrivningen? Sök redan idag - vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!

Du blir anställd av God Omsorg, som värnar om våra kunders självbestämmande, frihet och delaktighet samtidigt som vi tror på att våra personliga assistenter kan uträtta stordåd.

jobs.title: Work as a GP in scenic Western Norway
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Europe. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Would you like to work in a well-organised GP practice with experienced colleagues, close access to specialist healthcare, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities?

On behalf of a municipality in Vestland County, we are recruiting a family medicine specialist for a permanent position in a modern and well-established GP practice.

This is an opportunity to join a supportive professional environment where quality of care, collaboration, and continuity for patients are highly valued. The practice is located in a scenic area of Western Norway, surrounded by mountains, lakes, and fjords, with easy access to both outdoor activities and urban amenities.

About the position

You will join a GP practice consisting of three experienced GPs and one resident doctor. The available patient list currently includes approximately 800 patients, with the possibility of gradually increasing the list size if desired.

The municipality places great emphasis on creating a positive working environment and maintaining a strong professional community with skilled colleagues and experienced support staff.

The position includes:

    Responsibility for your own patient list
    Diagnosis, treatment, and long-term follow-up of patients of all ages
    Preventive healthcare and chronic disease management
    Up to 20% municipal medical duties
    Participation in an organised out-of-hours emergency service rotation

Emergency care services

The municipality participates in an intermunicipal emergency care collaboration involving five municipalities. The emergency clinic is located next to the local hospital and operates from dedicated facilities.

    The service includes responsibility for:
    Out-of-hours emergency care
    Municipal acute care beds (KAD)
    Emergency medical communication centre
    The clinic is staffed by qualified healthcare personnel around the clock, providing a well-supported working environment during emergency shifts.

We offer

    Permanent full-time position
    Annual salary of approx. NOK 1.6 million for specialists, plus additional compensation for emergency service duties
    A well-established GP practice with experienced colleagues
    Strong professional support and collaboration
    Good opportunities for professional development and continuing education
    Assistance with relocation and practical arrangements when moving to Norway
    Free Norwegian language training
    Support throughout the authorisation process

About the area

The position is located in a municipality in Vestland County, one of Norway's most spectacular regions. The area is known for its fjords, mountains, glaciers, and excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, cycling, and fishing.

The community offers schools, cultural activities, sports facilities, and a wide range of local services. The location also provides good transport connections to larger towns and cities in Western Norway.

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who:

    Are specialists in family medicine / general practice (GP)
    Hold a valid medical licence and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
    Have good English language skills
    Are motivated to learn Norwegian
    Have good communication and collaboration skills
    Wish to establish a long-term career and life in Norway

Why Norway?

General practitioners play a central role in the Norwegian healthcare system and are responsible for the long-term follow-up of their own patients. Norwegian healthcare is characterised by high professional standards, collaborative working environments, and a high degree of professional autonomy.

Norway also offers excellent opportunities to combine a medical career with a balanced lifestyle, family life, and access to nature.

Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the position and life in Norway. Please contact us for a confidential conversation or send us your CV. We look forward to hearing from you!
