jobs.title: Assistant Professor - in Information Systems and Innovation Management
jobs.description:
The House of Innovation (HoI) at the Stockholm School of Economics (SSE) currently invites applications for one tenure-track position (Assistant Professor level).

Your profile and qualifications

Candidates are expected to have relevant background in Information Systems, Innovation Management or related fields. A research focus on Artificial Intelligence, Digital Health or Digital Resilience will be considered a plus. A PhD in a related field is required by the time of assuming the position.

Candidates are expected to have strong qualities in both research and teaching. In research, the candidates should exhibit the ability to publish in top-tier, peer-reviewed, international journals, as evidenced by a promising research and publication pipeline, a presence in the international research community, and publications in leading journals (if available). In teaching, experience with integrating GenAI into innovative teaching is a plus, as well as having designed and delivered university courses in management of digital technologies and/or innovation, and having coached student projects. Candidates will be expected to interact and collaborate with faculty from other disciplines and to exercise intellectual leadership in their discipline.

The position

The tenure track period is six years. The intended starting date for the successful candidate is September 1, 2027 (open to negotiation). Salaries are set on an individual basis. Tenure track faculty members are evaluated for tenure on a non-competing basis (i.e., based on individual performance).  

For these positions, course load is reduced from the regular 4 courses to 2 courses for the duration of the tenure track period.  

In teaching and research, there are ample opportunities to engage in collaboration with startups in the surrounding innovation ecosystem, as well as with a wide network of SSE partner organizations, including ABB, Accenture, Ericsson, H&M, McKinsey & Co, Scania, SEB and many others.

About the House of Innovation (HoI)

The House of Innovation provides an excellent, inter-disciplinary environment for research, education, outreach and venturing, with scholars working in Technology and Innovation Management, Entrepreneurship, Information Systems, Operations and Supply Chain Management, and adjacent fields. HoI collaborates with a broad, influential network of academics, corporations, government agencies, and civil society actors, with the aim to contribute to the advancement of society. HoI hosts an expanding group of international scholars with currently 8 professors, 5 associate professors, 13 tenure-track assistant professors, 17 PhD students and more than 35 research fellows and postdocs. Our researchers have access to important national research networks, such as WASP-HS, and are highly successful in publishing and grant acquisition, for example, with a recent major research grant on AI in healthcare.

HoI faculty members regularly publish in top journals, and serve on editorial boards, in editorial positions, and in academic leadership positions. They frequently receive substantial grants from leading Swedish and European funding institutions to conduct state-of-the-art research, and serve on national and international policy committees, thus contributing to the shaping of society and of innovation ecosystems. 

HoI encompasses the academic Department of Entrepreneurship, Innovation and Technology, the Jacob and Marcus Wallenberg Center for Innovative and Sustainable Business Development, the Scania Center for Innovation and Operational Excellence, The Center for Family Enterprise, The Center for Transformative Innovation, Center for Data Analytics, the research platform on innovation and sustainability within the House of Sustainable Society, and the Swedish Center for Digital Innovation (SCDI Sthlm). We also run the SSE Business Lab start-up incubator and coordinate SSE’s involvement in the Stockholm School of Entrepreneurship (SSES), a consortium with the six major universities in Stockholm providing innovation and entrepreneurship education across the wider Stockholm area and beyond.

How to apply:

To apply, please submit:

    A cover letter articulating your fit with the position description and the research diversity of HoI, and your research interests
    Teaching and outreach portfolio
    A curriculum vitae
    A separate document listing both published articles (if any) and articles submitted and under review with journals.
    Copies of representative research, including your job market paper.
    Names and contact information for three persons willing to provide references.

About the Stockholm School of Economics (SSE)

The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.

Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.

SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

jobs.title: Radiographers for long term opportunities in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

We are currently recruiting radiographers for a well-functioning radiology department in central Sweden.

The positions are available due to increased patient demand and upcoming retirements.

This is a long-term opportunity within a stable public healthcare provider offering modern equipment, a structured introduction programme, and a clear pathway toward Swedish professional authorization.

The department

The department consists of approximately 30 employees, including 15 radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and medical physicists. The unit operates in recently renovated facilities with newly upgraded CT, conventional X-ray, ultrasound and fluoroscopy equipment. An MRI replacement is planned.

Both acute and elective imaging are performed. The department collaborates closely with primary care, inpatient services, the emergency department, private healthcare providers, and other radiology units within the county. This ensures a varied and clinically broad workload.

Several radiographers have previously been internationally recruited and are now well established locally with their families, contributing to a supportive and inclusive working environment.

The hospital serves approximately 27,000 inhabitants locally and around 39,000 in the wider catchment area. The area offers a safe, family-friendly environment with access to schools, childcare, and extensive natural surroundings.

The role

The position includes standard duties as a licensed radiographer, primarily within:

    Conventional radiography
    CT
    MRI (may become part of responsibilities over time)

You will work with both emergency and planned examinations.

A structured introduction programme lasting 6–12 months is provided, depending on previous experience, to ensure competence in equipment, routines, and Swedish clinical standards.

Collaboration with a nearby radiology unit (approximately 40 minutes by car) may occur. Travel takes place during working hours.

Evening standby duty is included. Approximately once per week. You are required to be on site within 30 minutes when on standby duty. Therefore, it is necessary that you either hold a valid driver’s license and have access to a car, or live within close distance of the hospital.

Requirements

    Qualification in Radiography from an EU country
    The profession must be regulated in the country of qualification
    Currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
    Full legal right to practise independently as a radiographer
    Ability to work with CT and conventional radiography in acute and elective settings
    Good communication skills in English
    Willingness to learn Swedish – full support provided
    Qualification must be eligible for recognition by the Swedish National Board of
    Health and Welfare – we guide you through this application.
    Valid professional registration/license in the country of qualification
    Driving license/ B

Language and relocation

Swedish language training starts in your home country through individual online lessons with a private teacher. You study several hours per week alongside your current work.

Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.

After moving to Sweden, you begin working at 50% in a radiography assistant role while continuing your Swedish studies from B2 to C1. Work and language training are combined during this period, and the language education is provided and financed.

You begin working fully as a radiographer once Swedish authorization has been obtained.

Salary

    During the language completion phase (50% employment as Radiography Assistant): 30,800 SEK/month gross.

Estimated net salary is approximately 24,300 SEK/month, depending on individual tax rate.

    After obtaining Swedish authorization as a Radiographer: minimum 31,100 SEK/month gross.

Estimated net salary is approximately 24,500 SEK/month.

The salary after authorization is individually set and may be higher depending on experience, skills, and previous professional background.

The figures above refer to base salary. Additional compensation for standby duty, evening work, and shift-related supplements is not included in the stated amounts.

Application

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the final application date.

Submit your application today and include:

    CV / résumé
    Diploma and educational certificates/ Proof of professional license/registration
    Motivation letter
    References from at least one manager and one professional colleague

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Arbetsmarknadskonsulent - Vikariat
jobs.description:
Vi söker dig som vill vara en del av vår resa mot en bättre vardag, starkare framtid och ökad livskvalitet för invånarna i Perstorp. Hos oss får du en arbetsplats där arbetsglädje, engagemang och utveckling är en självklar del av vardagen. Vi tror på att tänka nytt, arbeta smart och hela tiden bli lite bättre tillsammans.

Perstorps kommun ligger i hjärtat av norra Skåne, mitt i den dynamiska Öresundsregionen – ett av Sveriges mest expansiva områden. Här kombineras småstadens närhet och trygghet med närhet till både naturupplevelser och större städer. Kommunen har cirka 7 300 invånare och omkring 560 medarbetare som tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt.

Vi är stolta över vårt starka näringsliv och vårt fokus på folkhälsa, hållbarhet och livskvalitet. Här finns goda möjligheter att påverka, utvecklas och göra skillnad varje dag.

Beskrivning

Arbetsmarknadsenhetens främsta uppdrag är att aktivt arbeta för att fler invånare blir självförsörjda och samtidigt hjälpa de lokala företagen att få rätt kompetens. Genom samordnade insatser stöttas invånare utan arbete till att stärka sin ställning på arbetsmarknaden, och genom arbete eller studier i slutändan stå för sin egen försörjning. Arbetsmarknadsenheten (AME) erbjuder olika arbetsmarknadsinsatser så som praktik, individuell vägledning, gruppvägledning och matchning mot offentliga såväl som privata arbetsgivare.

Samverkan är av största vikt för verksamheten. Framförallt med kommunens andra verksamheter men även med Arbetsförmedlingen, Försäkringskassan, sjukvården och de 11 kommunerna inom Familjen Helsingborg-nätverket. Projekt bedrivs också genom FINSAM NNV Skåne.

Arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker nu två arbetsmarknadskonsulenter till vårt team med huvudsakligt fokus på grupp- och individuell vägledning.  Tjänsterna omfattar allt förekommande arbete inom verksamheten med syfte att karltägga och utreda individens förutsättningar för arbete, och genom vägledning och insatskoordinering stötta individen till en hållbar förankring på arbetsmarknaden  Stort fokus ligger på arbete med klienter som anvisats från socialtjänsten och som uppbär försörjningsstöd.

Som medarbetare på Arbetsmarknadsenheten ingår du i ett team där vi genom engagemang, service och professionellt bemötande, arbetar tillsammans för att nå våra uppsatta verksamhetsmål. Vår verksamhet bygger på tillit, respekt och förståelse för varandra och en positiv anda.

Arbetet innebär bland annat:

    I samarbete med andra utreda, planera, koordinera och genomföra olika typer av arbetsmarknadsinsatser.
    Motivera, vägleda och stötta klienter till att stärka sin ställning på arbetsmarknaden, med slutmålet att bli självförsörjande.
    Höga krav på dokumentation och uppföljning, samt ett kvalitetsansvar genom hela processen.
    Samverkan med interna, externa och/eller anvisande aktörer kring gemensamma klienter.
    Kontakt med arbetsgivare för att vara behjälplig i rekryteringsprocessen och tillgodose de kompetensbehov som finns genom matchning mot deltagare.
    Du kommer vara delaktig i verksamhetens utveckling och har möjlighet att påverka processer.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig med adekvat utbildning på högskolenivå eller annan kompetens/erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig och relevant för tjänsten. Du har minst två års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet och även erfarenhet av relationsbyggande arbete i syfte att utveckla och upprätthålla goda relationer till olika samarbetsaktörer.

Personliga egenskaper

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du inneha följande egenskaper/förmågor:

    Lyhördhet och kommunikativ förmåga i mötet med klienter för att skapa och bibehålla en god och professionell relation.
    God samarbetsförmåga, där respekt, tillit och prestigelöshet är av största vikt.
    Administrativ förmåga och datorvana, utifrån höga krav på dokumentation i verksamhetssystem och omfattande digital kommunikation i rådande läge.
    Initiativtagande till att sätta igång aktiviteter, uppnå resultat och även slutföra det som påbörjats.
    God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift. Övriga språkkunskaper är meriterande men ej krav.

Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 1 år.

Inför rekryteringen har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringsvägar och publiceringskanaler, varför vi vänligen undanber oss all kontakt med försäljare i detta ärende.

jobs.title: Sjømannsprest/daglig leder i København
jobs.description:
Sjømannskirken i København har lange og rike tradisjoner, og vi søker nå etter en ny leder som får ansvar for å videreutvikle kirken og etablere en bærekraftig drift i tråd med Sjømannskirkens nye strategi. Du vil få gode muligheter til å sette ditt preg på arbeidet sammen med resten av staben, og skal lede arbeidet med å videreutvikle menighetsarbeidet og skape relevante møteplasser for barn og unge familier, expats og norske virksomheter i København. Stillingen gir stor grad av selvstendighet, ansvar og handlingsrom, i tett samspill med hovedkontoret, den lokale staben, kirkerådet og gudstjenesteutvalget.

Vi søker en relasjonssterk og utviklingsorientert leder som trives med endring og ser muligheter. Du har høy arbeidskapasitet, evne til å omsette ideer til handling og motiveres av å bygge fellesskap. Du er trygg i lederrollen, har god selvinnsikt og evner å bruke egne styrker samtidig som du er bevisst dine utviklingsområder.

Selv om det er kort vei geografisk fra Norge, kan det oppleves større avstand i kultur, humor og væremåte. Det fordrer at du har en nysgjerrighet og åpenhet for det livet de du møter lever, enten det er fastboende, studenter, ansatte i bedrifter eller turister som stikker innom for en vaffel eller grøt. Du evner også å møte ansatte, frivillige og kirkeråd på samme gode måten. Sjømannskirken i København har et vekstpotensiale. De fleste har på et tidspunkt besøkt byen København og har et godt bilde av hva den kan by på av avslappet dansk væremåte kultur, severdigheter, gatevandring, natur og andre opplevelser. Det er rike muligheter for en aktiv fritid, enten du reiser ut alene eller sammen med familie. 

Til denne stillingen bruker vi ikke søknadsfelt, men har heller noen konkrete spørsmål du må svare på. Skriv «ikke aktuelt» på spørsmål som ikke er relevant for å kunne gå videre til neste.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Dine ansvarsoppgaver blir å:

  • ha ansvar for gudstjenestearbeid og andre kirkelige handlinger
  • ha overordnet ansvar personalledelse, økonomistyring, administrasjon og drift av kirken, herunder stabsmøter, vaktplaner
  • ha ansvar for budsjett, regnskap, statistikk og rapportering til hovedkontoret i Bergen
  • være kontaktledd mellom staben,  kirkestyret og den operative ledelsen i Norge
  • bygge nettverk og representere Sjømannskirken i ulike fora- både formelle og uformelle 
  • håndtere beredskapsarbeid
  • kommunikasjonsarbeid
  • tilstedeværelse på kirken, i oppsøkende arbeid og gjennom nettverksbygging rettet mot nordmenn som bor i København og ellers i Danmark
  • ha sykebesøk, sosialsaker og sjelesorg
  • ansvar for det frivillige arbeidet
  • planlegge og gjennomføre større arrangementer ved kirken, blant annet julemarked og 17.mai
  • samarbeide med kirkeråd og stiftelse om drift og vedlikehold av kirkebygget og eiendommen
  • bidra i det praktiske og menighetsbyggende arbeidet i København
KvalifikasjonerVi ønsker å høre fra deg som:
  • er ordinert til prestetjeneste i Den norske Kirke, og helst har noen års erfaring som prest
  • har gode lederegenskaper og som forstår ledelse som samspill
  • gjerne har erfaring med å bygge lag og utvikle en stab
  • erfaring fra økonomi og administrasjon
  • trives med trosformidling i møte med mennesker med svært ulik bakgrunn
  • trives med å lede og møte engasjerte brukere og frivillige i alle aldre 
  • har erfart viktigheten av å få frivillige til å bidra og inkludere dem i det utvidede stabsfellesskapet
  • har gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper
  • har førerkort klasse B, ettersom det er nødvendig for tjenesten

 

Stilling for eventuell medreisende ektefelle

  • Det kan tilbys 100 % stilling som diakonal medarbeider for eventuell medreisende ektefelle, dersom den oppfyller kravene til en tilsetting.
  • Dette er en kirkelig stilling, der oppgavene avhenger av kompetansen og interessene til den som kommer inn i stillingen, og blir tilpasset de behov kirken har.
  • Erfaring med arbeid rettet mot barn og unge er en fordel.
  • NB: Vennligst legg ved CV og søknad hvis ektefelle ønsker å bli vurdert for stilling. Vi gjør en like grundig prosess med søkere til denne stillingen som for hovedstillingen, og punktene under gjelder også for denne stillingen.
Viktige tilleggskrav
  • Det vises til Sjømannskirkens formelle krav til ansettelse.
  • Søkere må kunne identifisere seg med Sjømannskirkens strategi. 
  • Hvis ikke søker eller ektefelle/samboer er medlem i Den norske kirke, vennligst opplys i søknaden hvilket kirkesamfunn.
  • Den som tilsettes vil bli bedt om å fremlegge tilfredsstillende politiattest (barneomsorgsattest) i medhold av Politiregisterforskriften § 34-1.
  • Kontraktsvilkårene for utstasjonerte er betinget av medlemskap i norsk folketrygd. Ansatte som på ansettelsestidspunktet mangler medlemskap kan bli vurdert til en ansettelse på særskilte vilkår (lokal kontrakt).
  • Sjømannskirkens stillinger i utearbeidet er faste stillinger med tre års bindingstid, og med fire måneders oppsigelse. Oppsigelse før utløp av bindingstiden vil kunne medføre at deler av flytteutgiftene må dekkes av den ansatte. 

Vi ser etter deg som 

  • er glad i mennesker, og evner å snakke med, møte og omgås mennesker, også de som er ulik deg selv
  • er god på samhandling og samspill med andre
  • evner å tenke selv, tar ansvar og tar grep når det kreves
  • har evne til å tilpasse deg nye situasjoner
  • er tilpasningsdyktig og har en fleksibel innstilling til arbeidstid og oppgaver, samtidig som du evner å sette nødvendige grenser
  • er god til å engasjere og inspirere andre, og til å bli engasjert selv
  • har evne og vilje til å drive med oppsøkende arbeid
  • har god kapasitet, slik at du kan stå på litt ekstra i perioder og kan ta det igjen i roligere perioder

    Hvis dette høres ut som deg, og en arbeidshverdag du kan trives i, er du hjertelig velkommen som søker!

 

Vi tilbyr
  • Lønn etter organisasjonens lønnsplaner for utstasjonerte.
  • Tariffestet pensjonsordning i Statens pensjonskasse.
  • Arbeidsveiledning (ABV).
  • En spennende og meningsfull lederstilling
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet og mulighet til å prege kirkens videre vekst i København
  • Det vil bli stilt møblert tjenestebolig til disposisjon. Se nærmere beskrivelse i bo- og levebeskrivelsen.

    Vi har samlet en del informasjon om hvordan det er å jobbe i Sjømannskirken. Les mer på Sjømannskirken sine nettsider for København.

    OBS! Alle må søke elektronisk gjennom lenken "Søk på stillingen" for å komme i betraktning. Fyll ut komplett søknad og skriv inn jobberfaring og utdanning i feltene i søknadsskjemaet. Vi godtar ikke søknader per e-post eller post. Legg ved eventuelle attester og bruk koblingen til Vitnemålsportalen for å legge ved eventuelle vitnemål som er relevant.
KontaktinformasjonEspen Ingebrigtsen, Operativ leder, 90294934, ein@sjomannskirken.no
Hildegunn Kvalsund Tjore, HR-rådgiver, 55552238, htj@sjomannskirken.no
ArbeidsstedVed Mønten 9
2300 København

Referansenr.: 5150432625
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sjømannskirken i København, Kong Haakons kirke, er et sosialt møtested, kulturelt samlingspunkt og en nærværende kirke for de nordmenn som bor i København og i Danmark.

Kong Haakons kirke er en tradisjonell og diakonal sjømannskirke, og stod ferdig i 1958. Kirken har et leseværelse, bibliotek, festsal, gymsal og kirkerom. Disse rommene fylles flere ganger i uken gjennom jevnlige gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger, kulturarrangementer og sosiale sammenkomster for alle generasjoner.

Den norske kolonien er mangfoldig – men vi ser flest barnefamilier, studenter og pensjonister. Vi har også et omfattende oppsøkende arbeid på skip, sykehus og på hjemmebesøk.

Arbeidet er variert og allsidig. Som ansatt får en brukt både sine praktiske, kreative og faglige evner. Vi arbeider både i team og selvstendig, og synes det er viktig med raushet, trygghet og fleksibilitet.

jobs.title: Pre-Commissioning Engineer, Frequent travel
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Commissioning Engineer, you will manage the onsite testing and validation of high-voltage power electronic systems. You will work closely with field teams and customers to ensure all systems meet performance standards and operate safely within the global grid.

You are offered
the opportunity to work at the forefront of green energy technology, providing significant international exposure and the chance to lead critical infrastructure projects globally.

Work tasks

You will be responsible for the hands-on execution of pre-commissioning and site acceptance testing for advanced power electronic systems, ensuring seamless grid integration.
- Lead and execute site acceptance testing (SAT) for high-voltage power systems.
- Perform hardware and system-level tests to verify design specifications.
- Identify and also resolve hardware and software defects during the commissioning phase.
- Act as the primary technical contact for customers during onsite walk-throughs.
- Prepare and archive accurate test reports and compliance documentation.
- Manage onsite task schedules and identify risks to project timelines.
- Provide technical guidance to installation contractors and local field teams.

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of electrical engineering principles.
- Practical experience in site commissioning or field testing of STATCOM, SVC, or HVDC systems.
- Proficiency using test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power analyzers, and Omicron.
- Strong ability to interpret technical schematics, circuit diagrams, and layout drawings.
- High willingness to travel frequently to international customer sites.
- Fluent in written and spoken English.

It is meritorious if you have
- Proven ability to make technical decisions in fast-paced site environments.
- Experience working independently at complex construction sites.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.description:
**Toimistoavustaja**

Etsimme huolellista, palveluhenkistä ja oma-aloitteista **toimistoavustajaa** monipuolisiin toimistotehtäviin. Tehtävässä huolehdit toimiston päivittäisen toiminnan sujuvuudesta sekä asioit työntekijöiden, asiakkaiden ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa.

Työ sopii henkilölle, joka pitää järjestyksestä, osaa ottaa vastuuta omista tehtävistään ja pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti erilaisissa toimistotilanteissa.

**Työtehtäviin kuuluu muun muassa**

- toimiston päivittäisten käytännön asioiden hoitaminen

- saapuvan ja lähtevän postin vastaanottaminen, lajittelu ja lähettäminen

- sähköpostien ja muiden toimistoviestien käsittely ja välittäminen

- puheluihin ja yhteydenottoihin vastaaminen sekä asiakkaiden ohjaaminen oikealle henkilölle

- asiakkaiden ja vierailijoiden vastaanottaminen ja neuvonta

- työntekijöiden kanssa kommunikointi ja heidän avustamisensa käytännön toimistoasioissa

- ajanvarausten ja tapaamisten käytännön järjestelyissä avustaminen

- kokousten ja tapaamisten käytännön järjestelyissä avustaminen

- muistiinpanojen tekeminen kokouksissa ja keskusteluissa sekä tietojen välittäminen eteenpäin

- asiakirjojen, lomakkeiden ja muiden toimistodokumenttien käsittely ja arkistointi

- tietojen syöttäminen ja päivittäminen järjestelmiin

- toimistotarvikkeiden tilaaminen ja varaston seuranta

- toimiston yleisestä järjestyksestä ja viihtyisyydestä huolehtiminen

- muut tavanomaiset ja kevyet toimisto- ja hallintotehtävät tarpeen mukaan

- tarvittaessa asioiden hoitaminen toimiston ulkopuolella ja työtehtäviin liittyvä liikkuminen.


**Edellytämme**

- sujuvaa **venäjän kielen** taitoa

- hyvää **englannin kielen** taitoa

- riittävää **suomen kielen** taitoa päivittäiseen työskentelyyn, asiakas- ja työyhteisöviestintään sekä kirjalliseen viestintään

- **voimassa olevaa B-luokan ajokorttia**

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- huolellista ja järjestelmällistä työotetta

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

- perustason tietoteknisiä taitoja ja valmiutta käyttää erilaisia toimisto-ohjelmia ja sähköisiä järjestelmiä

- joustavuutta ja palveluhenkistä asennetta

- valmiutta **työtehtäviin liittyvään matkustamiseen**.


**Työhön liittyvä matkustaminen**

Tehtävään kuuluu **ajoittaista työmatkustamista** ja liikkumista työtehtävien mukaan. Työ voi edellyttää matkustamista esimerkiksi asiakkaiden, yhteistyökumppaneiden tai muiden työtehtävien hoitamiseen liittyvien kohteiden välillä.

**Tarjoamme**

Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja käytännönläheisen toimistotyön, jossa tehtävät vaihtelevat päivittäisten tarpeiden mukaan. Työssä pääsee käyttämään ja kehittämään kielitaitoaan sekä työskentelemään eri kieliä puhuvien asiakkaiden ja työntekijöiden kanssa.

Tehtävässä korostuvat erityisesti **venäjän, englannin ja suomen kielen** käyttö, hyvät asiakaspalvelutaidot sekä kyky hoitaa useita käytännön asioita samanaikaisesti.

Sähköposti: info@8motors.fi

jobs.title: Power² Junior Lawyer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

You as Junior Lawyer will be part of Hitachi Energy business based in Europe (with the position located in Västerås, Sweden). We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Junior Lawyer to join our Legal team for a fixed term of 18 months. You will participate in our specialized learning program, aimed at developing the skills and knowledge necessary for a successful legal career within a global company.

You will be exposed to a variety of legal matters and projects, with opportunities to be involved in local, regional, and global projects. As a Junior Lawyer, you will be part of our Legal team reporting to the Regional Head of Legal, Europe. You will assist in the implementation of regional strategy and ensure full compliance with Group directives and local legal regulations.

How you’ll make an impact

    Assisting the Regional Head of Legal and Country Heads of Legal in providing legal advice and counselling to Hitachi Energy management across a broad range of legal issues or within a specialist area, and manage dispute and litigation matters as directed.
    Conducting legal research and prepare legal documents.
    Supporting contract review and negotiation, including frame agreements, contracts, and partnerships.
    Participating in the development and implementation of legal strategies.
    Supporting good corporate governance at the regional and country level.
    Supporting the implementation of the Code of Conduct and assist in ongoing integrity training.
    Ensuring compliance with company policies, local legal regulations, and Group directives; assist with the implementation of both local and group legal and integrity directives and instructions, and monitor ongoing integrity matters and executing due diligence.
    Contributing to the development and implementation of local and group legal and integrity directives.
    Managing and communicating with external service providers, including legal counsels.
    Participating in various local, regional, and global projects within the department.
    Engaging in continuous learning and development opportunities through the Legal and Integrity learning program
    Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background

    Graduate degree in law.
    0-2 years of experience.
    Demonstrated ability to be agile and keen to learn.
    Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
    Good communication and interpersonal skills.
    Strong interest in technology and process improvement.
    Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
    High level of integrity and ethical standards.
    Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
    Group life insurance and additional insurances.​
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
    Health care and wellness allowance​
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
    Psychological support program​​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application today. ​

Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Gustaf Hedström, gustaf.hedstrom@hitachienergy.com​

jobs.title: ICEYE : Senior Payroll Specialist (Fixed-term Contract)
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time, fixed term (3-6 months)

Location: Maarintie 6, 02150 Espoo, hybrid

Application deadline: 14.09.2026

ICEYE is looking for a **Senior Payroll Specialist** to join the Global Payroll team as an additional resource during an exciting period of growth.

This is a fixed-term position for approximately 3–6 months, and we hope you can start as soon as possible. We review applications throughout the application period and will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply sooner rather than later.

**What will you be doing?**

In this role, you will support global payroll operations across ICEYE's international organization, with a particular focus on Finland, one of the company's largest payroll entities. Working closely with the Senior Payroll Specialist based in Warsaw, as well as colleagues in HR and Finance and external payroll providers, you will help ensure accurate and compliant payroll operations while contributing to the continuous development of payroll processes.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

- Coordinating end-to-end payroll operations across approximately 12 countries together with external payroll providers

- Preparing, validating, and submitting payroll data to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing

- Ensuring payroll activities comply with local legislation and internal policies

- Supporting the onboarding of new legal entities and contributing to process development and automation initiatives

- Partnering with internal stakeholders and external vendors to continuously improve payroll operations


**What makes you a great fit?**

We hope you are a proactive and detail-oriented payroll professional who enjoys solving problems and improving ways of working. You thrive in a fast-paced international environment, communicate effectively with stakeholders across functions, and take ownership of delivering high-quality payroll services.

**We require you to have:**

- Around 3–5 years of experience in end-to-end payroll, ideally in an international or fast-paced environment

- Strong knowledge of Finnish payroll legislation and payroll processes, with experience supporting payroll across Europe

- Experience working with third-party payroll providers in a multinational environment

- Excellent Excel skills and experience working with payroll and HRIS systems

- A full working proficiency in English


**We consider as an asset:**

- Knowledge of local labor and payroll legislation outside Europe


**We can offer you:**

- A unique opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing New Space company operating globally

- Meaningful ownership in an international payroll environment supporting employees across multiple countries

- The opportunity to improve payroll processes and help shape future ways of working

- A collaborative and experienced team where your expertise is valued from day one

- Cozy office spaces in Otaniemi, Espoo


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and 3-6 months fixed term position. You will be employed as aTalent employee at ICEYE. We hope you can start as soon as possible. The role will be located in Espoo, and we hope you are able to work at the office at least a few days per week as part of a hybrid model. Salary in this position is 5200-5500 €/month (gross) depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**Sounds like you?** Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by the latest 14th of September via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/379777/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. You can familiarize yourself with ICEYE here: https://www.iceye.com/company. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Junior Recruitment Consultant Sofia Hyvärinen(+358 503613288, sofia.hyvarinen\[at\]atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Field support engineer (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Rejoignez Safran Aerosystems : leader international dans la sécurité aéronautique, la gestion des fluides et du carburant. Notre force ? Innover pour la sécurité des vols (oxygène, évacuation, flottabilité) et piloter la transition vers une aviation décarbonée grâce aux carburants durables. 6 200 collaborateurs, 7 pays et un seul objectif : un ciel plus sûr.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionStep into the world of aviation excellence by joining a global leader in aircraft seating innovation, trusted by prestigious airlines worldwide. At Safran Seats, you will play a vital role at the heart of the action, working closely with Emirates Airlines and traveling across the Middle East region to provide essential technical support where it truly matters.

Your mission:

As a key member of our Field Support team based in the United Arab Emirates, you will be on the frontline, ensuring the optimal performance and reliability of our products within Emirates Airlines' fleet. Your technical expertise and customer-focused approach will make you a valued

ambassador of the Safran brand in the region.

Key Goals:

o Serve as the central point of contact for customer technical support and product-related inquiries.

o Cultivate strong customer relationships, understand their needs, and monitor satisfaction levels

o Enhance the technical partnership with customers by providing valuable insights and promoting loyalty.

o Champion Safran Seats' products and corporate image



Primary Responsibilities:

o Ensure the optimal performance of Seats in service:

o Offer technical support, diagnostics, and configuration management to maintain equipment airworthiness and safety

o Assist in implementing and planning working parties linked to service bulletins, retrofit operations and programs

o Participate to Internal Entry Into Service reviews and preparation

o Trainings of operators' maintenance crews

o Facilitate effective communication between Safran Seats and operators:

o Clarify technical reference documents

o Organize and participate to Technical Review Meetings and aftermarket reviews

o Facilitate communication between operators and Product Support Teams

o Monitor and oversee technical actions carried out in collaboration with customers

o Support and promote Safran Seats products and services

o Contribute to product and service enhancement:

o Identify and capture operators' perceptions and requirements in the field.

o Propose corrective actions and improvement strategies.

o Data management:

o Maintain up-to-date information on the fleet, customers, and competitor fleets.

o Customer insight: Maintain a thorough understanding of customer operations

jobs.title: Senior Integration Lead - SAP BTP
jobs.employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
jobs.description:
Job ID: 4728



Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and direct Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank, and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and the Business Strategy.

We are looking for a Senior Integration Lead to take ownership of a complex enterprise integration landscape across HR. This is not only a development role. We are looking for someone who can review the existing integration setup, challenge inefficient patterns, define a migration roadmap, improve monitoring and supportability, and help build internal integration capability.

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

About our team

Meet the Group Functions Technology team. Our role is to provide end-to-end technology delivery and application ownership for Nordea's Group Functions, ensuring that functions such as People, Finance, Risk, Compliance and MarCom have secure, reliable and scalable technology solutions that support business operations, regulatory requirements and strategic transformation.

Main responsibilities in this role:

•  Take ownership of the integration landscape across HR and related business domains.

•  Review existing IBM DataStage and SAP BTP integrations, including data flows, schedules, message volumes, dependencies and failure points.

•  Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary data movement, including full-load patterns, duplicate interfaces and legacy batch processing.

•  Define and maintain a roadmap for migrating legacy integrations from IBM DataStage to SAP BTP.

•  Design, build and improve integrations using SAP BTP capabilities, especially SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration.

•  Work with SAP SuccessFactors, SAP RISE / S/4HANA-related integrations, APIs, file-based transfers and event-driven patterns.

•  Establish standards for integration design, naming, documentation, monitoring, alerting and incident handling.

•  Improve operational stability by strengthening logging, observability, error handling and support procedures.

•  Work closely with external consultants, internal IT teams, architects, application owners, HR, Finance and vendors.

•  Secure knowledge transfer from external parties and reduce long-term dependency on third-party vendors.

•  Support audits, compliance, access control and security requirements relevant to a regulated financial institution.

•  Act as a senior advisor on integration architecture, integration governance and platform evolution.

Who you are

This is the right role for you if you have strong hands-on experience and the ability to lead technical change in a complex enterprise environment.

Your background and skills include:

•  Solid experience with enterprise integration architecture and integration lifecycle management.

•  Hands-on experience with SAP BTP, preferably SAP Integration Suite.

•  Experience with SAP SuccessFactors integrations, APIs and HR data flows.

•  Experience with integration patterns such as batch, real-time, event-driven, API-led and file-based integrations.

•  Strong understanding of REST, SOAP, OData, XML, JSON, SFTP, certificates, OAuth and related security concepts.

•  Experience reviewing and improving existing integrations, not only building new ones.

•  Ability to analyse high-volume message flows and identify unnecessary, inefficient or risky integration patterns.

•  Experience with monitoring, alerting, logging, error handling and operational support of integrations.

•  Ability to create clear technical documentation, interface specifications and migration roadmaps.

•  Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

•  A pragmatic mindset: able to balance target architecture with business continuity and delivery constraints.

It would be ideal if you also have experience with:

•  IBM DataStage or migration away from legacy ETL platforms.

•  SAP RISE / S/4HANA integration scenarios.

•  Enterprise HR and Finance integration landscapes.

•  Banking, financial services or other regulated environments.

•  API Management, Event Mesh, SAP BTP Cockpit, Cloud Connector or related SAP BTP services.

•  Data privacy, access governance and audit requirements.

•  Integration cost optimisation and message-volume reduction.

What we offer

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

​Submit your application no later than 18/09/2026.

For union information, please contact finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACONordea@nordea.com.

jobs.title: McDonald's Otta søker deg som vil mestre høyt tempo sammen med gode kollegaer
jobs.description:
Er du lei av ulike stereotypiske holdninger? Vil du jobbe et sted hvor du kan være deg selv og bli satt pris på akkurat slik DU er? Hos McDonald's vet vi at ulike mennesker gjør det best i team, hos oss kan du selvsagt være deg selv!

Hva kan du forvente hos oss?

  • God opplæring: Du trenger ikke å kunne alt fra dag én. Vi lærer deg å håndtere stress, jobbe i team og levere kundeservice med et smil (ja, selv på en hektisk fredagskveld)
  • God oppfølging: Du får tilbakemeldinger som hjelper deg å bli enda bedre – og skryt når du fortjener det
  • Rettferdig lønn: Vi betaler tariff
  • Fleksible arbeidstider: Tilpasset deg og ditt behov
  • En meningsfull jobb: McDonald’s tar sosialt samfunnsansvar og jobber kontinuerlig med aktiviteter for en mer bærekraftig drift, som for eksempel at vi fjerner all plast fra emballasjen vår innen dette året
  • En arbeidsplass der alle får muligheten til å være seg selv: din personlighet betyr mer enn din CV
  • Fri når du har fri: Vi skjønner at du har et liv utenfor jobben

  • Du har sterke samarbeidsevner (teamwork er vår superkraft)
  • Du klarer å holde hodet kaldt under press (det er helt avgjørende når grillen streiker en fredagskveld)
  • Du elsker å lære og oppleve mestring (den følelsen du får når du klarer noe du trodde ikke var mulig)
  • Du er flink til å kommunisere og samarbeide, både med kollegaer og kunder (når det koker på kjøkkenet er din samarbeidsevne avgjørende)
  • Du trives med kundebehandling, matlaging, rydding og renhold (tiden går fort når du jobber hos oss)

Hos oss får du dette – og litt til.

Avec cartes et plans couvrant des représentations du monde, du Luxembourg et de ses territoires, cette collection se distingue comme l'une des plus remarquables du pays. jobs.title: Learning Experiences Creator
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is where millions of people learn to build software - and our documentation and learning content are where they get going or give up. We're taking ownership of that experience, and we're looking for a Learning Experience Creator who can make it worthy of the product: someone who turns product knowledge into experiences people actually use - clear written docs, guided learning, short video, interactive experiences - findable at the moment of need, accurate every time, and genuinely enjoyable.

You're a learning-experience creator first. You understand how people actually learn a product - what they're trying to accomplish, where they get stuck, what format serves each moment - and you move fluidly between writing a crisp help article, designing a hands-on walkthrough, and producing a short video. Underneath it all, you're a storyteller: you know how to earn attention in the first few seconds, hold it against real-world attention spans, and make ideas stick - and sometimes make something people can't help but share. You're also a builder: unafraid to try new formats and experiment, you read the data and listen to customers, and you continually improve and evolve with speed as our product evolves. You'll turn complex things into simple, useful experiences, and you'll own how well they land.

The Mission: help every user - external customers and internal teams - self-serve to reach their creative and business goals, with content so good, so current, and so findable that they don't need to open a ticket. Success looks like real ticket deflection, faster activation, and high CSAT.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - New documentation and learning content. You'll populate our documentation and learning surfaces with new, accurate, plain-language content - help articles, answer-first FAQs, goal-based tutorials, and rebuilt getting-started paths - prioritized by real reader and ticket data, made at volume with the help of our AI- native content tools.

 - The content lifecycle. Content isn't done when it ships. You'll keep the library current through every product launch - freshness reviews, launch-day updates, retiring what's stale - so nothing published contradicts the product. Our pipeline flags what's drifting; you own making it right.

 - Learning experiences across formats. Written first where reading serves best - plus short-form video, microlearning, interactive courses, quick walkthroughs, GIFs, and in-product tips. You pick the format that fits the job, not the other way around, and you bring a storyteller's instinct for attention and memorability to every one - learning content competes with everything else on someone's screen, and yours wins. You keep pushing into new, innovative experiences as our tools grow.

 - A content calendar built for effectiveness. You plan what gets made and when - covering the topics customers most need help with, sequenced for maximum impact, so the library actually answers the questions people are asking.

 - Findability. You make sure content is easy to discover - titled, tagged, and structured so people (and the AI assistants that read our docs) find the right answer through search, at the moment of need. Great content nobody can find doesn't deflect anything, and this is yours to own.

 - Engagement and outcomes. You care whether it worked - reader feedback, findability, completion and watch-through, self-serve resolution, deflection, CSAT - and you tune the calendar and the craft based on what the data and customers tell you.

 - A recognizable voice. A consistent, human style across docs, learning, and video that makes every piece feel like part of one connected experience, whether someone reads a single article or completes a whole course.

 


HOW YOU'LL WORK WITH THE TEAM

This role is a force-multiplier - it makes the whole team's knowledge reach people. You won't work alone:

• With our Technical Customer Education Specialist for accuracy and depth - they bring the technical truth; you turn it into clear, findable content people trust and enjoy.

• With our Sr. Learning Experience Lead on what content is needed and what's working - they own the learning platform, journeys, and measurement; you read the same effectiveness data to steer the calendar.

• With our docs and product partners on launches - so new features ship with accurate, ready content on day one, not weeks later.

• With the hiring manager and the wider team to scale our content capability together, so the sum is greater than the parts.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A proven learning-content creator. A portfolio of documentation, tutorials, courses, or product education that people actually used and learned from - across at least two formats, with written content among them. You understand clarity, structure, and story, and you can prove it.

• A strong writer. You make complex or dry topics genuinely clear and engaging in plain language, with warmth and a point of view. Docs people want to read are your craft.

• A gifted storyteller, across media. You understand hooks, pacing, attention spans, and what makes content memorable - sometimes shareable, occasionally viral - and you apply that craft to written, video, and interactive work alike. It shows up in a doc's first sentence as much as a video's first five seconds.

• A capable short-form video creator. Video is one of your formats - you understand watchability and modern platform sensibilities, and you're comfortable producing (on or off camera) with AI-assisted workflows.

• A builder and experimenter. You try new formats and ideas, take calculated content risks, glean insights from data and customers, and continually improve - determining the right approach even when the problem is ambiguous.

• Fast to learn a product. You get up to speed quickly and can represent it accurately to newcomers - you don't need to be a developer, but you make technical things make sense.

• Outcome-minded. You define what success looks like for your work, and you care about real results (deflection, activation, self-serve success, CSAT), not just output.

• A strong thought partner. You share ideas openly, seek other perspectives, and collaborate well across a small, fast team.

 


BONUS

• Experience writing or maintaining developer or product documentation (docs-as-code, Markdown-based platforms) - and a feel for content lifecycle at scale.

• Hands-on with AI-native build or content tools (Replit) and modern editing/production workflows.

• Instructional design fundamentals - you know why a checklist beats a paragraph and when a video beats both.

• A feel for discoverability and search - how people (and AI assistants) find content and how to help them.

• Experience running a content channel, editorial calendar, or creator program with an audience - bonus points if something you made really took off.

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

Acquisition : bonne compréhension des stratégies de génération de leads, conversion et retargeting. Tracking : bonne maîtrise du Meta Pixel, des événements de conversion et bonne compréhension de la Conversions API. Analytics : bonne connaissance de Google Analytics 4 et Google Tag Manager. Créatives : capacité à analyser les performances des créations et à formuler des recommandations sur les angles, messages, formats et contenus à tester. Performance : approche fortement orientée ROI et rentabilité, au-delà des simples métriques de visibilité ou d'engagement. jobs.title: Médecin militaire (m/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Armée luxembourgeoise est une force militaire moderne et professionnelle. Composée d'hommes et de femmes dévoués, elle a pour mission principale de défendre la souveraineté et l'intégrité du Grand-Duché, de contribuer à la sécurité nationale et internationale, et de participer aux opérations de maintien de la paix sous l'égide de l'OTAN, de l'Union européenne et des Nations Unies. Engagée dans un environnement multinational, l'Armée luxembourgeoise offre un cadre de travail où l'esprit d'équipe et le sens du devoir occupent une place centrale. Rejoindre l'Armée luxembourgeoise, c'est: Servir son pays dans un cadre porteur de valeurs fortes : droiture, engagement et fiabilité; Développer ses compétences à travers une formation continue et personnalisée; Évoluer dans une carrier/ière riche en opportunité et missions variées. Missions Le médecin militaire est le dernier maillon de la chaîne e sur le terrain des opérations, après le Combat Med et l'infirmier militaire; En mission, il est capable de prendre en charge des militaires blessés dans toutes les conditions; Sa formation lui permet d'appliquer ses compétences es dans un environnement militaire soumis à des contraintes tactiques et logistiques. Selon sa spécialisation, il peut exercer: En Role 1 : prise en charge visant à garantir la survie du patient dans des conditions dégradées, selon le principe du damage control resuscitation; En Role 2 : prise en charge incluant une capacité chirurgicale d'urgence, reposant sur le damage control surgery, privilégiant la rapidité et le contrôle des lésions vitales plutôt que leur réparation définitive immédiate; Pour entretenir ses compétences cliniques, le médecin militaire exerce également dans le domaine clinique civil. Profil Compétences techniques Être déployable pour toutes les missions et formations de l'Armée; Suivre les formations nécessaires; Maîtriser les outils bureautiques de base; Avoir de bonnes connaissances des opérations et missions de l'Armée luxembourgeoise; Avoir des connaissances de base en gestion des ressources humaines et logistiques. Compétences comportementales Faire preuve de sollicitude, de justice et d'impartialité; Donner l'exemple par la façon de se comporter et d'accomplir ses devoirs; Être ouvert aux relations interpersonnelles; Faire preuve de compétences de leadership; Faire preuve de professionnalisme; Adhérer aux valeurs-phares de l'Armée (engagement-droiture-fiabilité). Conditions d'admission Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master en Médecin spécialiste en traumatologie et médecine d'urgence ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Vous disposez de l'autorisation d'exercer la profession. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe de traitement A1.  Vous avez la  luxembourgeoise. Être reconnu ement et psychologiquement apte pour le service militaire. Avoir une présentation compatible avec l'exercice de la fonction et le port d'uniforme.   Examen-concours: Examen-concours au Centre militaire du  au  octobre  Épreuve sportive, épreuves de langues, tests psychotechniques, épreuve de connaissances générales, évaluation psychologique et entretien de motivation. jobs.title: Prévisionniste en météorologie (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Exercer une profession scientifique passionnant/ante ayant un impact direct sur la sécurité aérien/ienne ; Intégrer une administration moderne, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation ; Évoluer aux côtés de spécialistes reconnus dans leur domaine ; Bénéficier d'un parcours de formation de très haut niveau reconnu à l'échelle européenne ; Développer continuellement vos compétences dans un environnement international ; Partager les valeurs de l'ANA : Intégrité, Respect, Innovation, Engagement et Excellence. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez acteur...

jobs.title: Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP (H/F)
jobs.description: Harry Hope, cabinet de recrutement accompagne candidats et entreprises dans leurs recherches des meilleures opportunités en France et à l'international. Afin de mieux répondre à vos enjeux, tous nos consultants sont spécialisés par secteur d'activité et zone géographique. POSTE Notre client est un acteur reconnu au Luxembourg dans le domaine des solutions SAP et de la transformation digitale. Il accompagne des entreprises de toutes tailles dans la mise en oeuvre, l'évolution et l'optimisation de leurs systèmes d'information SAP. Dans le cadre du développement de son activité et de la conduite de projets stratégiques, notre client recherche un(e) Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP afin de piloter des projets à forte valeur ajoutée et d'assurer la satisfaction de ses clients. Vous rejoindrez une équipe d'experts passionnés et évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique, innovant et international. Vos missions En tant que Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP, vous serez responsable du pilotage de projets SAP, depuis leur lancement jusqu'à leur mise en production. Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivant/antes : Piloter des projets SAP (implémentation, migration, montée de version et évolution) dans le respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences qualité ; Assurer la coordination des équipes techniques, fonctionnelles et des différents partenaires du projet ; Être l'interlocuteur privilégié des clients tout au long du cycle de vie des projets ; Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins métiers afin de proposer des solutions adaptées ; Définir la gouvernance des projets, les plannings, les priorités et les indicateurs de suivi ; Identifier les risques, mettre en place les plans d'actions nécessaires et assurer leur suivi ; Garantir la qualité des livrables et le respect des engagements contractuels ; Superviser les phases de conception, développement, tests, recette, déploiement et accompagnement au changement ; Assurer le reporting auprès de la Direction et des parties prenant/antes ; Participer au développement de la relation client et identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'accompagnement. PROFIL Profil recherché Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en informatique, ingénierie ou gestion de projet, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative dans la gestion de projets SAP. Compétences indispensables : Expérience confirmée en gestion de projets SAP ; Excellente connaissance de l'écosystème SAP (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA ou solutions SAP) ; Maîtrise des méthodologies de gestion de projet (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall ou SAP Activate) ; Expérience dans la coordination d'équipes multidisciplinaires ; Bonne compréhension des processus métiers et des environnements ERP ; Excellentes capacités de communication et de gestion de la relation client. Compétences appréciées : Expérience sur des projets de migration vers SAP S/4HANA ; Connaissance de SAP BTP, SAP Fiori ou des solutions Cloud SAP ; Expérience dans des environnements internationaux ; Connaissance des bonnes pratiques ITIL ou des processus de Delivery Management. Certifications Les certifications suivant/antes constituent un réel atout : SAP Activate Project Manager ; Certifications SAP (S/4HANA ou solutions SAP) ; PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP ou certification Agile/Scrum. Langues Anglais professionnel obligatoire ; La maîtrise de l'allemand constitue un réel atout ; Le français est indispensable.

jobs.title: Expert en informatique et cybersécurité (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration du cadastre et de la topographie, sous la tutelle du Ministère des Finances, a pour missions principales : La gestion et mise à jour de la documentation cadastrale, incluant le cadastre foncier et le cadastre vertical ; La mensuration officielle ; La gestion et mise à jour de la documentation topographique ; La gestion du système géodésique de référence national ; La gestion du registre national des localités et des rues ; L'infrastructure luxembourgeoise de données géographiques (ILDG) ; La gestion et le développement du Géoportail National du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg, en conformité avec la directive européenne INSPIRE ; L'organisation du stage professionnel, de l'examen et de l'épreuve d'aptitude pour l'obtention du titre de géomètre officiel. Missions Pilotage stratégique et budgétaire: Contribuer à la définition de la feuille de route du service informatique, en alignement avec le plan de développement du CTIE et les enjeux métiers de l'administration; Élaborer et suivre le budget IT : allocation des ressources, priorisation des investissements (matériels, logiciels, services) et optimisation des coûts; Participer à la gouvernance IT : garantir la cohérence des choix technologiques avec les normes et standards étatiques (ex. : RGPD, référentiels ANSSI). Gestion des contrats et marchés publics: Superviser les contrats de maintenance des logiciels métiers : négociation, renouvellement et suivi des SLA avec les éditeurs/prestataires; Piloter des marchés publics pour l'acquisition de matériel informatique (appels d'offres, cahiers des charges, sélection des fournisseurs). Cybersécurité et conformité réglementaire: Cartographier et évaluer les risques cybersécurité spécifiques à l'ACT (Analyse des menaces et vulnérabilités, scénarios d'attaques, etc.); Mettre en œuvre la directive NIS2: Audit des systèmes existants et plan d'actions pour la conformité; Sensibilisation des équipes et coordination avec les parties prenant/antes (DSI, etc.); Gérer les incidents de sécurité : protocoles de réponse, communication de crise et retour d'expérience; Appliquer et faire évoluer les politiques de sécurité (PSSI, procédures internes, bonnes pratiques). Modernisation de l'infrastructure IT: Faire évoluer l'architecture technique: Cloud (govCloud) : migration, optimisation et sécurisation des environnements; Conteneurisation (Kubernetes) : déploiement, orchestration et monitoring des clusters; Infrastructure : serveurs s/virtuels, stockage SAN, sauvegardes et bases de données (Oracle, PostgreSQL et MariaDB). Déployer une solution de monitoring centralisée (supervision des performances, alertes, tableaux de bord); Maintenir la documentation technique à jour (schémas d'architecture, procédures, inventaires). Veille et innovation: Assurer une veille technologique et réglementaire (évolutions NIS2, menaces cybersécurité, tendances DevOps); Proposer des améliorations : automatisation, résilience ou nouvelles solutions alignées avec les besoins métiers. Profil Compétences techniques Compétences métiers: Savoir appliquer la matier/ière, la législation et la réglementation du domaine concerné ainsi que posséder des connaissances en matier/ière de protection des données; Savoir faire une analyse fonctionnelle et technique des systèmes informatiques; Connaître la méthodologie associée à la gestion des opérations informatiques (ITIL) (Information Technology Insfrastructure Library); Connaître les partenaires et intervenants dans les processus liés aux systèmes informatiques; Disposer de connaissances informatiques approfondies (réseaux, administration de systèmes, bases de données, applications web, développement, bonnes pratiques en matier/ière de sécurité, sauvegarde des données, etc.); Vous savez comprendre le fonctionnement des architectures et technologies IT, en apprécier les risques potentiels au niveau technique et assister à la mise en place selon les bonnes pratiques en termes d'hygiène informatique; Disposer de connaissances ou expériences pratiques dans les domaines liés à la l'exploitation de systèmes, réseaux et virtualisation; Connaître les outils Kubernetes, Rancher, Docker; Disposer de connaissances en sécurité informatique; Avoir une bonne compréhension des architectures SAN/NAS; Avoir une expérience en administration de systèmes Linux; Avoir une expérience en scripting (Bash/Python/Powershell) ainsi que disposer des connaissances des outils d'automatisation. Compétences support: Savoir travailler de façon autonome mais également en équipe pluridisciplinaire; Être un bon communicateur; Disposer de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et orales; Être doté de fortes compétences d'analyse et savoir gérer les priorités; Avoir les capacités d'appréhender et capacité d'analyse...

jobs.title: Chargé de la visibilité et de la valorisation des équipes éducatives et psycho-sociales des lycées (m/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Centre psycho-social et d'accompagnement scolaires (CePAS) Missions Missions : Les équipes éducatives et psycho-sociales des lycées jouent un rôle essentiel dans l'accompagnement éducatif, psychologique et social des dynamiques et de leurs familles. Pourtant, leurs missions, expertises et les services qu'elles proposent ne sont pas toujours suffisamment connus ou compris. Dans ce contexte, une communication claire, cohérente et accessible constitue un levier essentiel pour renforcer leur visibilité et en faciliter le recours ; Rattaché au Service Communication du CePAS, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le Centre de ressources et les professionnels des lycées afin de développer une communication institutionnelle cohérente, centrée sur les besoins des dynamiques, des familles et des partenaires. Par la conception et la mise en place de stratégies, de campagnes et de contenus de communication, vous contribuez ainsi à renforcer la visibilité et la compréhension des missions des Services psycho-sociaux et d'accompagnement scolaires (SePAS), des Services socio-éducatifs (SSE) et des internats scolaires, tout en valorisant les expertises des professionnels de terrain et les actions de prévention. Dans ce contexte, vous serez notamment amené à : Développer la visibilité et la compréhension des services ; Contribuer à la mise en œuvre d'actions de communication visant à renforcer la connaissance et la compréhension des services ; Concevoir des supports d'information facilitant l'identification des missions et des ressources disponibles ; Valoriser les projets, initiatives et bonnes pratiques développés dans les établissements scolaires ; Mettre en lumier/ière les métiers et expertises des professionnels à travers des contenus éditoriaux variés (portraits, interviews, témoignages, vidéos etc.).
