jobs.title: Continuous improvement (CI) Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

Are you the kind of engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges while driving a culture of continuous improvement? Someone who gets energized by troubleshooting automation systems, finding root causes, and keeping production running at its best – using brains over budget? Then this role is for you.

You will take technical ownership of a production line with a strong focus on automation systems, while maintaining and strengthening our continuous improvement (CI) processes. Your mission: maximize uptime, eliminate recurring failures, and drive equipment reliability through smart, hands-on engineering and structured CI methodologies.

How You Will Contribute

You will:

    Own the technical performance and availability of the production line – proactively identifying and eliminating recurring stops and disturbances
    Troubleshoot and resolve complex automation issues across PLC, HMI, VFDs, drives, sensors, servo systems, and industrial networking
    Diagnose and support mechanical systems (pneumatics, hydraulics, bearings) when needed as part of holistic troubleshooting
    Facilitate structured root cause analysis (RCA, 5-Why, Fishbone) to address chronic losses and departmental KPI scorecard gaps, and implement sustainable countermeasures
    Develop and drive preventive and condition-based maintenance strategies with a strong focus on automation reliability
    Provide training on CI tools, techniques, and autonomous maintenance (AM) to build first-line defense capabilities among operators and colleagues
    Support teams in data collection and analysis to drive CI activities and our daily management system (DMS)
    Establish new work standards to sustain improvements and document technical solutions that strengthen the team long-term
    Manage critical spare parts and proactively address component availability risks

What You Will Bring

A passion for automation, problem-solving, and continuous improvement, along with:

    Strong experience in troubleshooting and maintaining automation systems (PLC, HMI, VFDs, servo drives, sensors, industrial communication protocols) – Siemens or Allen-Bradley preferred
    CI and high-performance work systems experience, with application of Lean and/or TPM tools in a factory or operations environment
    Basic mechanical understanding to support holistic troubleshooting when needed
    Ability to manipulate and validate data in manual and automated systems; mastery of Excel and other data analytics tools
    Strong facilitation and communication skills to train operators, support CI discussions, and collaborate cross-functionally
    A creative, resourceful mindset – you find effective solutions even with constraints
    Structured and organized thinking to extract insights from data and sustain the DMS process
    Bonus: experience extending equipment life through smart automation upgrades and engineering strategies

Why You'll Love This Role

    High impact – your work directly drives production output and line performance
    Technical depth – you'll dig deep into automation systems and build expertise that matters
    Autonomy – you own the technical strategy for your line
    Visible results – every improvement you make is immediately measurable

We offer:

    Health & Benefits: Friskvårdsbidrag (Wellness allowance), on-site gym, health check-ups at age intervals, and subsidized on-site massage and chiropractor.
    Food & Shopping: Subsidized lunch in our canteen and favorable discounts in our staff shop.
    Easy Everyday Life: Fenced parking for all on-site employees and comprehensive employee support for health, work, and private life.
    Security: Collective agreement, contractual insurance, occupational health care, and extra compensation for parental leave.
    Community: art association and social activities.

More about this role

No Relocation support available

jobs.description:

Vergunningverlener Horeca, Evenementen en Bijzondere wetten
Gemeente Maashorst zoekt een Vergunningverlener Horeca, Evenementen en Bijzondere wetten
- Detachering via YER
De positie
Dit ga je doen
Als vergunningverlener speel je een sleutelrol in onze gemeente: je beoordeelt en toetst aanvragen voor horecavergunningen en evenementen op basis van de geldende regelgeving. Op basis van je uitkomst stel je een (exploitatie)vergunning op met heldere voorwaarden of motiveer je een (voorgenomen) weigering. Je behandelt dus vergunningaanvragen op het gebied van de Alcoholwet, APV en Bijzondere wetten. Daarnaast ondersteun je met betrekking tot de wet Bibob onder regie van de BIBOB coördinatoren van het team Veiligheid.
Je begeleidt ondernemers door het hele proces heen. Je legt helder uit wat er wél kan, wat niet kan en welke wet- en regelgeving daarbij hoort. Daarbij werk je veel samen met aanvragers, buurtbewoners en collega's uit verschillende teams. Daarnaast houdt je de administratie strak op orde en bewaakt elke stap in het vergunningproces. Zie je knelpunten? Dan pak je die op en maak je het proces beter. Komen er zienswijzen binnen van omwonenden, dan duik je in de situatie, breng je partijen bij elkaar en zoek je naar oplossingen die zowel juridisch als praktisch standhouden.
Je doet het samen met
Jouw collega's van het Team Veiligheid, ca. 35 mensen die actief zijn op een breed speelveld, van ondermijning tot aan evenementen. Jij bent onderdeel van een team met vier clusters, te weten Openbare Orde en Veiligheid (OOV), Markt, Evenementen en Horeca (MEH), de Boa's en de juristen OOV. Naast jou als vergunningverlener kent het cluster MEH nog een senior vergunningverlener, een administratief medewerker team Veiligheid, markt-en kermismeesters, een evenementencoördinator en een beleidsadviseur horeca en evenementen. Bij alle collega's kun je altijd terecht voor vragen of advies. En zeker ook voor hum...

Wil jij specialist worden in zinkwerk en werken aan mooie projecten in de buitenlucht? Of wil je dit vak juist leren van ervaren vakmensen? Dan is dit jouw kans.
Voor een specialistische organisatie in het zinkwerk zijn we op zoek naar een Zinkspecialist. Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen must. Belangrijker is dat je handig bent, technisch inzicht hebt en gemotiveerd bent om het vak te leren.
Je werkt samen met ervaren collega's die je de fijne kneepjes van het vak leren. Stap voor stap groei je door naar een zelfstandige rol, waarin je uiteindelijk met je eigen bus op pad gaat naar projecten.
Wat ga je doen?
Je werkt aan diverse projecten in de buitenlucht, vaak op daken of vanaf steigers. Geen standaard werk, maar maatwerk. Jij zorgt ervoor dat zinkwerk strak wordt aangebracht en perfect wordt afgewerkt.
Daarnaast: - Werk je samen met collega's op locatie. - Stem je af met opdrachtgevers en kantoor. - Zorg je voor kwaliteit en een nette afwerking. - Ben je het visitekaartje van de organisatie.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:
KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control.

Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants.

The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant.

What is Optimisation in Flex?
The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns.

The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies.

The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute.

Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine.

🚀 What you’ll own:
The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably.

This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. Ultimately, they maintain the technical vision for their specific area, ensuring services are appropriately owned, maintained, and aligned with Flex's sustainable growth.

  • Managing the leads.

  • Maintaining the technical vision for a given area.

  • The overall team architecture

  • Ensuring the services in that area are owned and maintained appropriately.

  • Ensuring that product features are built in a way that scales, is cost-effective, and is in line with the vision for a product area.

  • Ensuring the appropriate level of quality and resilience, with a specific focus on reducing system incidents and improving stability.

  • Ensuring appropriate tech debt is prioritised to support sustainable delivery.

  • Potentially managing a squad (team) as well.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:
You’ll be a strong fit if you have experience leading engineering teams across multiple squads, teams or product areas in a complex product environment.

  • A collaborative product and engineering mindset: you care about customer outcomes, product strategy, technical quality and the people needed to make the work real.

  • Strong judgement in ambiguity: you can separate urgent from important, make trade-offs explicit and help teams move without pretending all uncertainty has disappeared.

  • A track record of influencing beyond your reporting line and team, building trust with senior stakeholders and helping teams reach decisions when ownership is shared.

  • A bias for action and improvement: when you see a recurring issue, you turn it into the smallest useful action that starts making the system better.

You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy being at the center of global sales strategy. Whether that's preparing for board meetings, facilitating cross-functional alignment, or representing the sales organization with key stakeholders.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
Data Center Technician 2
jobs.description:
Advanced Micro Devices AB

THE ROLE

Join AMD's Data Center Operations team and help support the infrastructure powering next-generation computing technologies. In this role, you will work with customers, vendors, and AMD engineering teams to deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise-scale server and networking environments. This is an exciting opportunity to gain broad exposure to data center technologies, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to delivering exceptional operational and customer outcomes.

THE PERSON

You are a self-motivated and detail-oriented professional who enjoys solving technical challenges in fast-paced environments. You thrive in hands-on roles, take ownership of issues from identification through resolution, and are comfortable working both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

You possess strong troubleshooting skills, an analytical mindset, and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences. You are comfortable working with geographically dispersed teams and can adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a high level of quality and professionalism.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    Support deployment, maintenance, and sustainment activities within customer data center environments.
    Perform hardware break-fix activities on servers, networking equipment, and related infrastructure.
    Assist with incident management and technical troubleshooting to maintain service availability.
    Execute data center operational tasks including cabling, patch management, equipment replacement, configuration, and power-cycle activities.
    Participate in root cause investigations and failure analysis activities alongside customer engineering teams.
    Support asset management initiatives, inventory tracking, and data center floor audits.
    Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures.
    Provide technical assistance to team members and contribute to knowledge sharing across the organization.
    Assist with generating operational reports and providing updates to management regarding service performance and customer deliverables.
    Collaborate with customers, vendors, and AMD teams to ensure successful project execution and operational excellence.
    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

    Strong understanding of server hardware and system-level troubleshooting.
    Experience diagnosing component failures and participating in root cause analysis activities.
    Familiarity with server management software, firmware utilities, and OEM diagnostic tools.
    Working knowledge of Windows Server environments and Linux operating systems.
    Experience with data center deployment technologies such as PXE, WDS, DHCP, and FTP.
    Understanding of server provisioning, system imaging, and operating system deployment processes.
    Experience supporting large-scale data center operations or enterprise infrastructure environments.
    Exposure to networking concepts, hardware installation, and structured cabling practices.
    Demonstrated attention to detail and a methodical approach to troubleshooting complex technical issues.
    Ability and willingness to perform physical work in a data center environment, including lifting and moving server hardware when required.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS

    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related field preferred.
    Equivalent industry experience will also be considered.
    CompTIA A+ certification preferred.
    CompTIA Server+ certification preferred.
    Microsoft certifications such as MCP or MCSE are desirable.
    Additional data center, server, networking, or infrastructure-related certifications are advantageous.

jobs.description: Project Manager - Cantieri navali Nuove Costruzioni L'Azienda Il nostro cliente è uno storico cantiere navale genovese con un consolidato know how nella riparazione e costruzione navale. Il ruolo Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del business delle nuove costruzioni, siamo alla ricerca di un Project Manager che segua la realizzazione delle commesse dalla fase di avvio fino alla consegna finale, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi contrattuali, tecnici, economici, temporali e qualitativi. Opererà come principale punto di riferimento verso Direzione, Cliente e funzioni interne, coordinando in modo strategico e gestionale tutte le attività necessarie alla corretta esecuzione del progetto. Principali responsabilità Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita della commessa di nuova costruzione, dall'avvio alla consegna finale dell'unità. Pianificare e monitorare il programma generale di commessa, assicurando milestone e scadenze contrattuali. Coordinare funzioni interne e stakeholder (Ufficio Tecnico, Produzione, Procurement, Qualità, HSE, AFC/Controllo di Gestione). Gestire la parte economica della commessa: predisposizione e monitoraggio di budget/forecast, controllo costi, cash flow, analisi scostamenti e azioni correttive a tutela della marginalità. Selezionare e gestire fornitori/subappaltatori/partner: valutazione offerte, controllo prestazioni e gestione criticità/ritardi. Gestire la relazione con Cliente/Armatore/Classifica/Autorità: governance, riunioni di avanzamento, comunicazioni e reporting. Facciamo parte di Gi Group, una delle principali realtà a livello internazionale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. Per cliente leader di mercato, posizionato a Bologna, ricerchiamo un/una CLOUD OPERATION/SPECIALISTA PIATTAFORMA GEN AI La risorsa fornirà supporto alle operazioni e alla governance delle piattaforme aziendali di IA generativa (ad esempio, Microsoft Azure, Copilot Studio), garantendo l'affidabilità, la sicurezza e la qualità del servizio degli agenti di IA in produzione. l ruolo, all'interno dell'area di Enterprise Systems Management, lavorerà a stretto contatto con i team di IA, i team di Technology Enterprise Solutions & Services e Cloud Operations, contribuendo all'abilitazione operativa delle piattaforme GenAI, al monitoraggio dei servizi e al miglioramento continuo dei processi operativi. Responsabilità - Gestire la configurazione operativa delle piattaforme GenAI (Azure / Copilot), comprese le impostazioni dei tenant, i servizi, le integrazioni e le connessioni necessarie per l'adozione degli agenti di IA; - Supportare i team di IA durante le fasi di onboarding e configurazione, fornendo indicazioni sui prerequisiti tecnici, sulle configurazioni e sulle migliori pratiche operative; - Collaborare con i team di sicurezza e conformità per mitigare i rischi legati all'accesso ai dati tramite gli agenti di IA; - Contribuire alla distribuzione degli agenti AI, garantendo la prontezza operativa, le checklist di go-live e il supporto nella definizione di SLA/SLO; - Implementare e gestire le attività di monitoraggio e osservabilità (metriche, dashboard, avvisi), supportando l'analisi delle anomalie e del degrado del servizio; - Partecipare alla gestione del ciclo di vita operativo (incidenti, problemi, modifiche, rilasci), in linea con i processi aziendali di IT Operations; - Collaborare con i team Cloud Ops / FinOps sulla pianificazione della capacità e la consapevolezza dei costi, monitorando le tendenze di utilizzo e i potenziali rischi; - Mantenere e aggiornare la documentazione operativa (runbook, procedure, FAQ tecniche), favorendo la condivisione delle conoscenze. Requisiti - Esperienza in ruoli legati alle operazioni IT, alle operazioni cloud in contesti aziendali o multinazionali - Buona conoscenza di Microsoft Azure (gestione tenant/identità, servizi di base, registrazione e monitoraggio) e familiarità con le piattaforme Copilot 365 / Copilot Studio; - Buona conoscenza di Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps); - Esperienza nelle operazioni di servizi IT: gestione degli incidenti, risoluzione dei problemi, analisi delle cause alla radice (RCA) e gestione degli SLA; - Mentalità collaborativa e orientata al servizio, con la capacità di lavorare con team interfunzionali e tradurre le esigenze tecniche e aziendali in azioni operative; - Approccio strutturato, con particolare attenzione alla stabilità del servizio e al miglioramento continuo. Competenze gradite - Esperienza operativa di base con AWS o ambienti multi-cloud; - Familiarità con strumenti di osservabilità (ad es. Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights o soluzioni simili); - Conoscenza dei principi SRE / di affidabilità del servizio (SLO, indicatori di qualità del servizio); - Esperienza con piattaforme low-code, automazione dei flussi di lavoro o piattaforme di IA/agenti, anche al di fuori di contesti puramente di sviluppo. Sede di lavoro: Bologna con possibilità di smart working. Si offre: Contratto a tempo indeterminato CCNL applicato: CCNL Commercio Livello di inquadramento: 1°-2° Fascia di retribuzione prevista: 50/55.000 € lordi annui Sono inoltre previsti premi di risultato, ticket restaurant Wyser (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) #LI-RR

jobs.title: informatore medico scientifico/informatrice medico scientifica
jobs.description: Per Azienda Farmaceutica italiana che sviluppa e commercializza farmaci, integratori alimentari e dispositivi medici ricerchiamo: Informatore Scientifico del Farmaco - Firenze Il nostro cliente è un'azienda Farmaceutica italiana, dedicata allo sviluppo e alla commercializzazione di specialità medicinali, integratori alimentari e dispositivi medici. Da oltre un decennio fa parte di un gruppo industriale italiano leader mondiale di principi attivi, rafforzando ulteriormente il proprio impegno nella ricerca e nello sviluppo di prodotti di alta qualità. A riporto dell'Area Manager il/la candidato/a prescelto/a sull'area di lavoro assegnata gestirà le seguenti attività: Promozione scientifica: fornire informazioni scientifiche e aggiornate a MMG, specialisti (cardiologi, otorini, pediatri) e farmacisti sui farmaci, integratori o dispositivi medici. Evidenziare caratteristiche terapeutiche, indicazioni, controindicazioni ed effetti collaterali dei prodotti Supporto tecnico e consulenza: rispondere a domande ed esigenze dei professionisti sanitari relative ai prodotti trattati. Fornire supporto nell'utilizzo e nella comprensione dei prodotti Analisi e pianificazione: pianificare le visite giornaliere presso i medici secondo un calendario organizzato e ottimizzato. Analizzare i bisogni dei clienti e proporre soluzioni mirate Aggiornamento professionale: rimanere aggiornati su normative vigenti, farmaci in commercio, novità scientifiche e protocolli sanitari. Frequentare corsi di formazione e aggiornamento organizzati dall'azienda Partecipazione a eventi scientifici: prendere parte a congressi, seminari e workshop per ampliare la rete di contatti e raccogliere nuove informazioni utili Interfaccia con l'Area Manager per condividere feedback dal mercato e sviluppare strategie per migliorare le performance di vendita. Partecipare a riunioni e briefing aziendali per definire obiettivi e piani d'azione Monitoraggio dei propri risultati Requisiti Laurea in discipline scientifiche abilitanti per il ruolo di Informatore Scientifico del Farmaco ai sensi del D.L. 219/06 art. 122 Orientamento al risultato, flessibilità e affidabilità, ottime capacità organizzative Possesso di P.IVA o disponibilità ad aprirla Possesso della patente B e disponibilità di auto propria Si valutano positivamente anche candidati neolaureati con forte motivazione e interesse per il settore Offerta Contratto in P.iva o di Agenzia in monomandato. Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it ) la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, nonché una delle principali realtà a livello mondiale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. Il nostro Gruppo è attivo nei seguenti campi: lavoro temporaneo, Permanent e Professional Staffing, Ricerca e Selezione, Consulenza HR, Formazione, Outsourcing, supporto alla ricollocazione e attività complementari. Siamo presenti in più di 30 Paesi in Europa, Asia e America con un team di oltre 6000 persone. I valori che ci contraddistinguono: attenzione, passione, apprendimento continuo e innovazione, collaborazione, sostenibilità, responsabilità. As an Inbound Account Executive – Netherlands, you'll work with inbound leads from the Dutch market, guiding small and medium-sized businesses through their first steps with SumUp and helping them choose the right solutions for their needs.

💬 Engage with inbound leads generated by our marketing team in the Netherlands — qualify, consult, and convert

✔ Have experience in a phone-based or customer-facing role (sales, support, retail, hospitality, etc.)

✔ Feel confident engaging business owners and decision-makers

✔ Are curious about fintech and motivated to understand the Dutch SMB landscape

✔ Thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Bonus points if you speak Dutch!

This isn't just a sales role — it's your opportunity to build commercial expertise in fintech while owning an important European market.

If you're excited about fintech, love working with people, and want to grow your career in an international environment, apply now and join us in London.

jobs.title: Senior Business Developer - Marketplace
jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Business Developer to join our Marketplace Sellers team. At Atolls, your role will be instrumental in growing our Marketplace Sellers business globally, managing direct relationships with sellers and vendors on Amazon and other marketplaces. As a key part of our team, you'll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys. Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Drive and manage key accounts and media partnerships with global marketplace sellers, vendors, and media agencies to expand our business reach.
  • Lead the full sales cycle, from prospecting to successfully onboarding high-priority strategic partners.
  • Direct the execution of high-profile partner campaigns across diverse international markets to ensure success.
  • Unlock new revenue streams through innovative campaign design and cross-vertical initiatives.
  • Develop insightful campaign reports and data-driven analysis to guide long-term strategic growth.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with commercial experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation.

  • 5+ years of experience in business development, account management or sales.
  • Fluent in English. Any additional languages such as German, French and/or Chinese is a plus.
  • Experience in e-commerce, online marketplaces, performance marketing, affiliate marketing is a plus.
  • Proven ability to build, maintain, and grow strong, long-term partnerships with key accounts and media partners on a global scale.
  • Demonstrated experience in leading complex contract negotiations, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements that drive revenue and align with strategic goals.
  • Skilled in translating complex data into compelling narratives and actionable insights for partners and internal stakeholders, highlighting value and opportunities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to pitch to high-priority partners and coordinate effectively with internal teams.
  • Proven ability to work well under pressure, capable of proactive problem-solving to resolve issues before they escalate.
  • Intercultural awareness and the ability to work effectively in a dynamic, cross-functional matrix organization.

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

#LI-CT1

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. jobs.title: Content Designer (Contract)
jobs.description:
TL;DR — We're looking for a contract Content Designer who can write both inside the product and across the website. You'll own the words in onboarding, empty states, and error messaging, and partner with PMM and our external design partner on the copy and structure of lovable.dev. This is a full-time engagement.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.

We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in content design or UX writing, with a portfolio that shows work on both sides: copy shipped inside a product, and marketing pages you wrote or restructured

  • Real in-product examples. Onboarding flows, empty states, error messaging, upgrade moments - the words people hit when something is confusing or has gone wrong. Tell us what changed as a result

  • Real web examples. Pages where the copy carries the argument, not just the headline.

  • The ability to look at an already-designed page and say precisely where the message gets lost on a skim, then rewrite it

  • A clear point of view on voice. You can describe a brand's voice and point to copy where you delivered a message in it

  • Comfort working at the pace of a design team that ships daily, in Figma, alongside product designers and PMs rather than downstream of them

  • Comfort partnering with an external design agency as well as internal marketing and design stakeholders

  • Genuine full-time capacity for the length of the contract. We move fast and this needs to be your primary focus

  • Ideally - content strategy chops. Strategy and SEO aren't the core scope here, but the instincts show up in the work

If you're strong on only one side of this, apply anyway. We know we're describing a rare combination. If you're exceptional at in-product writing and have never touched a marketing site, or you're a brilliant web writer who has never written an error message, we still want to see your work. Tell us which side you're great at and we'll take it from there.

What you'll do

In one sentence: Make Lovable sound like one company, in the product and on the website.

  • Own the copy in the moments that decide whether someone sticks: first run in the editor, empty states, failed and partial builds, upgrade and credit prompts

  • Name things - features, surfaces, settings - so the product's own vocabulary holds together

  • Write copy for new and refreshed marketing pages with PMM, making sure current GTM messaging is actually reflected on the site

  • Work with our external design partner on content hierarchy, categorization, and the top-level navigation. You'll shape it with them rather than own it alone

  • Diagnose and fix pages that are already designed but not landing, focusing on hierarchy, scannability, and messages that have to work fast

  • Sit embedded with marketing and design, with full context on how messaging decisions get made across the business

How we hire

  1. Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.

  2. Send us two pieces of work: ideally one from inside a product and one from the web, or two from whichever side you're strongest on.

  3. Walk us through your process and craft in a small number of interviews with the marketing and design team.

  4. In some cases, we may opt to do paid, trial work.

About your application

  • Please submit your application in English - it's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join

  • We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested please apply through our careers portal

Ready to join us?

Help us unlock human creativity and build the future of software creation.

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Our engineering team is expanding rapidly, and we’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to sit at the heart of it, driving delivery across our engineering portfolio. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast, and can bring order to multiple complex, multi-disciplinary hardware projects without slowing them down.

You'll be responsible for planning, tracking, and de-risking delivery across products at varying stages of maturity - from early-TRL prototypes through to fielded, mission-ready systems - and from field-ready energy systems to autonomous surface and sub-surface platforms.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own project planning and delivery tracking across concurrent engineering projects and work streams (firmware, electronics, mechanical, testing), translating product strategy and portfolio priorities into executable projects with clear milestones, owners, and outcomes.

  • Convert ambitious commercial and operational deadlines into realistic, resourced delivery plans — holding the line on both ambition and delivery discipline.

  • Maintain visibility across work streams, dependencies, risks, decisions, and resourcing gaps, managing technical risk and dependency mapping across products at different Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) and adjusting project rigour and testing requirements accordingly.

jobs.title: Telecom Lead (m/f)
jobs.description:
Telecom Lead

Role Summary

The Telecom Lead is responsible for leading and growing OQ Technology's telecom engineering team and for the technical direction of the end-to-end telecommunication system that underpins the Company's 3GPP-based 4G/5G Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN). The role brings together the Core Network, physical-layer/DSP, and protocol-stack disciplines into a single, coherent engineering roadmap, and holds ultimate accountability for the architecture, quality, and delivery of the telecommunication stack from research and prototyping through to operational deployment on the Company's satellite missions.

The Telecom Lead manages the Senior Core Network Engineer, Core Network Engineer, DSP Algorithm Engineer, Telecom Engineer, and any other engineers assigned to the telecom function, setting priorities, allocating work, developing technical talent, and acting as the primary point of technical and people- management accountability for the team. The Company may assign the Employee to any other job or tasks if it believes it is in its best interests to do so.

Key Responsibilities

The list below is representative and not exhaustive of the tasks and responsibilities of the role.

• Lead, manage, and grow the telecom engineering team, providing day-to-day direction, coaching, and performance management.
• Plan resourcing and recruitment for the team, define roles and career paths, and build the technical bench
strength required to deliver the Company's telecommunication roadmap.
• Foster a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture across the core network, DSP/physical layer, and protocol-stack disciplines, and ensure effective knowledge-sharing between them.
• Own the technical onboarding of new engineers and ensure consistent engineering standards, coding practices, and design-review discipline across the team.

Technical Ownership and Architecture

• Hold overall technical authority for the architecture and evolution of OQ Technology's telecommunication
system, spanning the Core Network, the physical layer/DSP chain, and the NB-IoT/LTE/NR protocol stack adapted for NTN.
• Define the technical roadmap and research strategy for new functions, algorithms, and system architectures for 4G/5G communication over Non-Terrestrial Networks, and align it with the Company's product and mission timelines.
• Review and approve system-level designs, ensuring consistency and interoperability across core network, baseband/DSP, and protocol-stack workstreams, and across the space, ground, and user segments.
• Set and enforce engineering standards, design-review practices, and quality gates for networking architectures and control algorithms against latency, high-availability, and Quality of Experience requirements, from prototype through operational deployment.
• Own system performance models and lead cross-functional systems-engineering activities related to end-to end system performance optimisation.
• Guide the design and implementation of microservices-based, real-time and near real-time applications, and of DSP algorithms and baseband processing for the telecommunication payload and user terminals.
• Oversee the development, optimisation, and continuous upgrade of the protocol stack(s) supporting current and future missions, ensuring features are delivered against space and product team requirements.
• Approve subsystem budgets and specifications, and confirm regulatory and mission compliance in coordination with the systems engineering team.

Delivery, Testing, and Operations

• Direct the full development lifecycle across the team, from concept, prototyping, and proof-of-concept experimentation through implementation, verification, integration, and deployment.
• Ensure rigorous validation of telecommunication software and hardware features through simulation, lab testing, and end-to-end testing in simulated NTN environments.
• Oversee the maintenance, upgrade, and improvement of the internal telecommunications and RF lab, and ensure appropriate configuration control and version management of all deliverables.
• Support the space team with authoritative technical inputs for the design, optimisation, and maintenance of Operational and Demo Missions, including mission needs, expected performance, dependability, and safety goals.
• Own the resolution of escalations and cross-team technical blockers, and ensure timely, transparent reporting of progress and risks to senior management.

Stakeholder, Partner, and Standards Engagement

• Lead technical discussions and negotiations with external suppliers, MNO/MVNO partners, contractors, and research institutes, including evaluation of designs and acceptance of deliverables.
• Represent the Company in standardisation bodies and lead the Company's technical contributions to relevant standardisation activities.
• Own or contribute to technical documentation for project reviews, including ESA-related deliverables, and defend designs at formal project and customer reviews.
• Work with and support teams across OQ Subsidiaries and manage technical interfaces with external partners and contracting organisations.

Planning and Reporting

• Participate in project management and planning activities, including proposals, roadmaps, budgets, and resourcing for the telecom engineering function.
• Provide regular reporting on team progress, technical risks, and delivery status to the Head of Engineering / CTO and other stakeholders.
• Ensure proper documentation of all technology development undertaken by the team and maintain traceability for audits and project reviews.

Requirements

Education

• Master's degree (or higher) in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. A PhD is a plus.

Experience

• Significant professional experience (typically 8+ years) in telecommunications engineering, spanning at least two of the following domains: core network (EPC/5GC), physical layer/DSP, or protocol stack development.
• Proven experience leading or mentoring engineering teams, including performance management, technical coaching, and resource planning.
• Hands-on experience with 3GPP-based 4G/5G systems; experience with Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) or satellite communications is highly desirable.
• Experience engaging with standardisation bodies (3GPP, GSMA, ITU) and managing relationships with external suppliers, MNO/MVNO partners, or research institutes.
• Track record of taking systems from research/prototype through to operational deployment, including verification and validation in lab and field environments.

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge of Core Network architecture and functions (MME, SPGW, HSS, OAM, IREG, IPX, BCE) and of NFV/microservices-based network applications.
• Solid understanding of physical-layer and DSP concepts (modem design, baseband processing, transceiver architecture) and of the NB-IoT/LTE/NR protocol stack.
• Proficiency with relevant development and simulation tools (e.g. C/C++, MATLAB, VHDL) and with CI/CD and version-control tools (e.g. Git).
• Familiarity with systems-engineering practices, including requirements derivation, performance modelling,and subsystem budgeting (e.g. RF link and power budgets).

Leadership and Personal Skills

• Excellent leadership, coaching, and people-management skills, with the ability to develop technical talent and build a high-performing team.
• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, able to engage effectively with senior management, external partners, and standardisation bodies.
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, able to balance strategic technical direction with hands-on problem-solving when required.
• Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.
• Willingness to travel occasionally for partner, supplier, or standardisation meetings

jobs.title: Associate - Corporate Secretarial Services (m/f)
jobs.description:
Associate - Corporate Secretarial Services

Co-Sec - Centre of Excellence - CD0404 - Senningerberg, Luxembourg (Hybrid)

Waystone is a leading asset-servicing solutions provider of institutional governance, administration, risk and compliance services to financial institutions. With over 25 years' experience and a comprehensive range of specialist services to its name, Waystone helps our clients structure, operate and grow through our expertise, innovation and digitisation, backed by the operational scale to support global expansion.

This role will support the day-to-day running of the Distribution Support team. This is a client-facing role that requires you to work closely with colleagues across functional and geographic boundaries to carry out distribution activity across the EEA for a number of our key clients within a clear regulatory framework.

Summary:

The Associate – Corporate Secretarial Services will be an integral part of the team's success. This role is responsible for working on a single client relationship, with a complex portfolio of underlying client entities (ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, overseeing corporate documentation and supporting board governance processes) and assisting with the delivery of services within a team. Key responsibilities include maintaining statutory records, managing company lifecycle events and operations. The role is client facing and also involves contributing to strategic initiatives such as project work and process improvement.

Key responsibilities:

• Be responsible for a portfolio of clients, within a single client relationship;
• Assist and complete operations within that portfolio, assisting with operations for the wider client portfolio;
• Maintain and update client files and corporate records in accordance with regulatory and internal standards;
• Manage administrative tasks including regulatory filings, RBE register updates, RCS deposits, document execution and safekeeping and legalisation processes;
• Support company lifecycle events such as formations, dissolutions and annual obligations (AGMs, EGM) as well as ad-hoc corporate secretarial matters (e.g., changes to directors, registered office and share capital);
• Take full ownership of delegated tasks and contribute actively to team success;
• Demonstrate knowledge of fund corporate governance and regulatory filing requirements, staying informed of relevant changes;
• Draft, finalise and manage resolutions and other corporate documentation;
• Prioritise workload effectively, identifying and escalating scheduling conflicts or delays as needed;
• Monitor task tracking systems to ensure timely completion of responsibilities;
• Exhibit strong attention to detail and excellent communication skills;
• Be flexible and willing to take on additional responsibilities as required;
• Assist with and complete board support activities, including meeting organisation, coordination with attendees, preparation and distribution of materials, drafting minutes and managing post-meeting actions;
• Provide support to colleagues when capacity allows and communicate availability to management;
• Assist with inbox monitoring and task processing during team absences;
• Participate in team projects as directed by management;
• Professionally and independently liaise with fund service providers and clients;
• Maintain accurate company registers;
• Adhere to current Waystone policies and procedures and contribute to the development of jurisdiction-specific policies as needed.

Requirements:

• You (preferably) hold a degree in Business or Law or equivalent experience with a focus on company secretarial services
• You have a minimum of 2 years of experience in company secretarial roles.
• You have a strong knowledge of Luxembourg corporate and fund regulations.
• You are highly organised, proactive, accurate and have a sense of responsibility and priority management.
• You are able to work independently in an environment under pressure and with tight deadlines.
• You are fluent in English (written and spoken).
• You are proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams).

jobs.title: 3D Imaging Specialist – Collection Digitisation (m/f/d)  (Kaufmann/-frau - Digitalisierungsmanagement)
jobs.description:
**3D Imaging Specialist – Collection Digitisation (m/f/d) **

Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following two positions in the Department of Palaeontology & Historical Geology and the Department of Messel Research and Paleobiology at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as of 01 January 2027

3D Imaging Specialist – Collection Digitisation (m/f/d)

(full time / part time)

Location: Frankfurt (Hesse)

Organizational units:

Department of Palaeontology & Historlcal Geology, Section Amber Research

Department of Messel Research and Paleobiology, Section Palaeomammalogy

Department of Palaeoanthropology, Section Mammalogy

Employment scope: Full-time / Part-time

Type of contract: Project-based, fixed-term for three years

Remuneration: Collective agreement of Hesse, TV-H E 9

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.

Within the framework of the project "SCRE3NED: Senckenberg Collection's RarEst – 3-dimensioNal Enhanced Digitisation", type specimens of exceptional scientific value (holotypes, paratypes and lectotypes) from various collections of the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt (amber, extant and fossil mammals, Messel fossils) are digitised using micro-computed tomography (μCT), synchrotron radiation-based micro-computed tomography (SRμCT), and digital photography. The aim is to produce high-quality, standardised and FAIR-compliant 2D and 3D datasets for research, collection management and science communication.

Your tasks

- Performing and documenting μCT scans in accordance with established quality standards
- Supporting the preparation and execution of SRμCT scanning campaigns at external research facilities
- Reconstruction, segmentation and quality control of 3D image datasets
- Contributing to the implementation of photography-based digitisation methods
- Creation, maintenance and management of metadata in accordance with the FAIR principles
- Preparation and integration of digital datasets into the collection databases (DINA, SeSam/AQUiLA)
- Further development, optimisation and standardisation of workflows for the 3D digitisation of a range of different object groups
- Ensuring consistent data and file organisation as well as long-term archiving
- Collaboration with curators, scientists, IT specialists and external project partners

Your profile

- Completed vocational training in a technical or scientific field (e.g., technical assistant for natural history museums and research institutes, biological or medical laboratory technician, photographic technical assistant, preparator) or a completed university degree (Bachelor's/Master's) in biology, earth sciences, medical engineering, computer science, engineering, media technology or a related field, or a comparable qualification with relevant professional experience
- Practical experience with imaging techniques, preferably computed tomography
- Confident use of software for 3D image processing and segmentation (e.g., Avizo/Amira, VGStudio MAX, Dragonfly, 3D Slicer).
- Good IT skills and a willingness to familiarise yourself with new software environments
- Knowledge of digital data management and data organisation
- Careful and responsible handling of unique and sometimes fragile objects
- Valid category B driving licence
- A structured, independent and solution-oriented approach to work, combined with the ability to work well in a team
- Good written and spoken German and English

Desirable skills

- Experience in operating and working with computed tomography systems
- Knowledge of 3D printing techniques and of preparing models for printing
- Experience with photography-based digitisation methods, in particular photogrammetry
- Familiarity with the FAIR principles and experience with repositories for 3D data (e.g., MorphoSource) or with collection databases
- Interest in natural history collections, biodiversity research and digitisation
- Basic knowledge of vertebrate and insect morphology

We offer

- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply?

Please submit your application electronically as a single PDF file, including a cover letter, CV, and relevant certificates and references by 04.10.2026.

If you are viewing this vacancy on an external job platform, please visit our career page (https://www.senckenberg.de/en/stellenanzeigen/ ) and apply via the corresponding "Apply" button. Applications submitted by email cannot be considered.

Contact

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung
Senckenberganlage 25
60325 Frankfurt am Main

For specific questions about this role, please contact Dr. Mónica M. Solórzano Kraemer monica.solorzano-kraemer@senckenberg.deandDr. Thomas Lehmann thomas.lehmann@senckenberg.de

jobs.title: Experienced ASIC Analog Layout Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Company Description

At AUMOVIO, we own what we do: Developing and producing hardware, software, and services that shape the future of mobility. But what truly sets us apart are our people. People who thrive in our winning culture, driven by bold ideas. People who take a leap and create meaningful difference—together. Because we believe that the future belongs to those who own it. That’s why we foster a culture where you own every step of the way.
Own your career, your growth, your skills, and your impact. Join us and own what’s next.

Advanced Electronics & Semiconductor Solutions (AESS) organization has been established in AUMOVIO to develop and manufacture semiconductors in a fabless model to fulfilling strategic internal semiconductor demands.

Job Description

As an ASIC Layout Engineer (m/f/d), you will be responsible for the top-level integration of analog and mixed-signal ICs. You will drive the layout development process, ensuring robust, DRC-compliant designs with optimal area utilization. You will collaborate closely with analog circuit designers and other layout engineers to deliver high-quality silicon.

Key Responsibilities:

- Responsibility for top-level layout integration of analog/mixed-signal chips (analog on top)
- Defining toplevel floorplan, padframe design and bonding diagrams in coordination with other domains
- Coordinating with other layouters and drive floorplans according to the chip top level
- Generating and integrating analog layouts at block and chip level
- Performing pin placement, parasitic extraction, and layout optimization
- Responsibility for compliance with DRC, LVS, and support tape-out activities
- Collaborating with design engineers to meet speed, area, power, DFM, ESD, and EMC requirements

Qualifications

- Academic degree in electrical engineering, microelectronics, physics or comparable qualification
- Longterm experience in analog layout design
- Proven experience in top-level layout integration
- Strong expertise in BCD technologies (65nm to 180nm)
- Deep understanding of deep submicron effects (parasitics, coupling, matching)
- Proficient in layout tools for design, DRC, LVS, and extraction
- Knowledge of analog circuit design
- Fluent English language skills (written and spoken), German language skills are a plus

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

- Next to the interesting daily work the region around Regensburg is offering a high recreational value and quality of life.
- Profit from extensive benefits at the location such as different canteens and cafeterias, a continuing education and training, health management, physiotherapy and much more.
- We offer an attractive salary as well as the possibility of hybrid and cross-border mobile work.
- For an improved work-life balance we support you with various initiatives for a better compatibility of family and career such as flexible work time model, part-time option, sabbatical, etc.
- You can expect a highly motivated team as well as diverse topics and projects in the global environment of the automotive industry.
- We are promoting lifelong Learning combined with personal and professional development.
- You are looking for an individual working time model? We support part-time work.

You would like to learn more about our additional services? Click here (https://www.aumovio.com/en/career/why-join-us.html) .

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. ​Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

- Du entwickelst und pflegst automatisierte Tests für unsere unternehmenseigenen Webanwendungen, die zentrale Geschäftsprozesse von TOI TOI & DIXI unterstützen - von der Kunden- und Auftragsverwaltung über die Fakturierung bis hin zur Tourenplanung und Disposition.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner (m/w/d) (HR Business Partner)
jobs.description:
Wir sind Körber - ein internationaler Technologiekonzern mit rund 13.000 Mitarbeitern an über 100 Standorten weltweit und einem gemeinsamen Ziel: Wir setzen unternehmerisches Denken in Kundenerfolge um und gestalten den technologischen Wandel. In den Geschäftsfeldern Digital, Pharma, Supply Chain und Technologies bieten wir Produkte, Lösungen und Services, die begeistern. Auf Kundenbedürfnisse reagieren wir schnell, Ideen setzen wir nahtlos um, und mit unseren Innovationen schaffen wir Mehrwert für unsere Kunden. Dabei bauen wir verstärkt auf Ökosysteme, die die Herausforderungen von heute und morgen lösen. Die Körber AG ist die Holdinggesellschaft des Körber-Konzerns.
Ihre Rolle in unserem Team

Als HR Business Partner sind Sie lokal in Markt Schwaben in einem kollegialen HR Team, das viel Spaß an der Arbeit hat, verantwortlich für die personalwirtschaftliche Beratung der Geschäftsführung und der Führungskräfte und Treiber aller relevanten Aspekte des Personalmanagements. Sie sind aktives Mitglied der HR Community des Körber Konzerns und tragen zur erfolgreichen Zusammenarbeit der HR Funktionen innerhalb der HR Matrixorganisation bei. Die Aufgaben umfassen unter anderem:

- Erster Ansprechpartner für die Geschäftsführung und die Führungskräfte eines festen Betreuungskreises bei strategischen und operativen Personalthemen
- Betreuung der Führungskräfte bei der Durchführung personenbezogener Einzelmaßnahmen unter Berücksichtigung der aktuellen Rechtsprechung sowie bei Arbeitszeitregelungen
- Sie koordinieren und führen die Auswahlgespräche im Rahmen des Recruitings am Standort
- Sie arbeiten mit dem Employee Service Center in allen administrativen HR-Prozessen zusammen
- Sie beraten die Payroll in allen relevanten Themen des ausgewählten Betreuungskreises
- Sie erstellen das HR Reporting im Rahmen des Monatsabschlusses
- Durchführung des jährlichen GPS und Talent Review Prozesses, Sicherstellung einer Aktionsplanung für Key Talents und einer Nachfolgeplanung für lokale Schlüsselpositionen
- Sie gestalten die strategische Personalplanung bis hin zu organisatorischen Veränderungen mit
- Proaktive Beratung der Führungskräfte bei der Durchführung der Mitbestimmung sowie Verantwortung für die vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit dem Betriebsrat und Behörden
- Umsetzung von HR-Projekten und -Initiativen sowie aktive Unterstützung von Veränderungsprozessen innerhalb des Körber Konzerns
- Weitere Aufgabenfelder sind z. B. die Durchführung von Performance Management, Analyse von HR-Kennzahlen, Talent Management, Succession Planning, allgemeine sowie individuelle Gehaltsüberprüfung / Compensation & Benefits, lokales Employer Branding

Ihr Profil

- Abgeschlossenes Studium, z.B. in den Bereichen Wirtschaft mit Schwerpunkt Personal oder vergleichbare Wissenschaften
- Idealerweise mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als HR Business Partner oder in ähnlichen Positionen
- Fundierte Erfahrung in der Beratung von Führungskräften sowie eine hohe Kommunikationskompetenz und gute Kenntnisse im Arbeits-, Betriebsverfassungsgesetz, Steuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht
- Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Tarifverträgen sind von Vorteil
- Versiert im Umgang mit IT Systemen und Lösungen (z.B. SuccessFactors, SAP, Interflex, MS Office)
- Eigeninitiative und Lösungsorientierung sind für Sie selbstverständlich
- In herausfordernden Situationen agieren Sie souverän und sind belastbar

Ihr Arbeitsumfeld bei Körber

Am Körber-Standort in Markt Schwaben werden seit 1895 hochwertige Maschinen für die pharmazeutische Industrie gebaut. Wir entwickeln neue Inspektionstechnologien, Automatisierungslösungen zur Steuerung komplexer Fertigungs- und Verpackungslinien für pharmazeutische Produkte. Als Teil des Teams helfen Sie mit, Inspektionsmaschinen für Medikamente qualitätsgesichert zu produzieren. Möchten Sie einen ersten Eindruck unseres Standortes in Markt Schwaben gewinnen und Ihre Kollegen virtuell treffen? Hier geht es zur Xperience.

Ihre Vorteile

- Offenes, kollegiales und internationales Umfeld
- Zukunfts- und krisensichere Branche mit einer über 125-jährigen Firmenbeständigkeit
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten (z.B. Gleitzeit) 
- Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten sowie Remote Work Abroad  
- Konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten 
- 30 Tage Jahresurlaub sowie 2,5 zusätzliche Urlaubstage gemäß Betriebsvereinbarung
- Sonderurlaubstage und anlassbezogene Sonderzahlungen
- Vielfältige Mitarbeiterevents (z.B. Ski-Ausflug, Triathlon, Grillfest)
- EGYM Wellpass mit erhöhtem Arbeitgeber-Zuschuss
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksame Leistungen 
- Kostenlose Mitarbeiterparkplätze sowie sehr gute ÖPNV-Anbindung
- Möglichkeit zum Fahrradleasing

jobs.description:
Vier Länder. Ein See. Die Alpen vor der Haustür. Das ist unsere Bodensee-Region: ein breites Freizeitangebot im Sommer wie im Winter sowie starke Industrien mit Weltmarktführern.

Stellenbeschreibung

Verantwortung übernehmen - Technik mitgestalten.

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Softwareentwicklung, Systemintegration und Projektkoordination und prägst aktiv die Funktionalität moderner Motorsteuergeräte.

Was Dich erwartet:

- Du koordinierst Softwareentwicklungsteams zur Sicherstellung effizienter Abläufe und technischer Qualität
- Steuerung der Erstellung funktionaler Anforderungen für Motorsteuergeräte in enger Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen
- Übernahme der Rolle als Software Lead bei der Integration und Weiterentwicklung von Steuerungsfunktionen
- Review und Bewertung von Softwareanforderungen für Motorreglerfunktionen hinsichtlich technischer Machbarkeit und Vollständigkeit
- Abstimmung technischer Anforderungen mit Stakeholdern außerhalb der Elektronikentwicklung, z. B. aus Mechanik, Versuch oder Projektleitung
- Überwachung der Softwareimplementierung durch externe Partner und Dienstleister
- Koordination der Entwicklung von Source Code sowie der zugehörigen Entwicklertests
- Sicherstellung der Durchführung von Modultests zur Qualitätsprüfung einzelner Softwarekomponenten
- Organisation und Begleitung von Geräte- und Systemtests sowie weiterer Testphasen im Entwicklungsprozess
- Verantwortung für die Freigabe von Software-Releases und deren Dokumentation

Bereit, die Zukunft gemeinsam mitzugestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich!

Profil

Das bringst Du mit:

- Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit JIRA zur Nachverfolgung von Softwareentwicklungsaufgaben und Release-Management
- Kenntnisse in der Planung und Koordination von Epics und User Stories auf Teamebene
- Vertrautheit mit Versionsverwaltungssystemen wie SVN, GIT sowie idealerweise mit PTC Integrity
- Sicherer Umgang mit Anforderungsmanagement-Tools und Methoden
- Praxiserfahrung als Embedded Softwareentwickler mit Fokus auf hardwarenahe Programmierung
- Kenntnisse von CAN-Bussystemen und Protokollen wie J1939
- Erfahrung in der modellbasierten Entwicklung mit MATLAB/Simulink sowie im Testen von Modellen mit TPT
- Programmierkenntnisse in C im Embedded-Bereich
- Vertrautheit mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden wie Scrum
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für die sichere Kommunikation im internationalen Umfeld
- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, sicheres Auftreten und ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit

So bringst Du genau die richtigen Fähigkeiten und die Motivation mit, um bei uns durchzustarten!

Das Angebot

Das bieten wir Dir - mehr als nur einen Job:

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Supply Chain - Quick Commerce (Product-Lifecycle-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Product Management

Stellenbeschreibung:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

- Lead and grow the team. You manage a team of Product Operations Specialists and are accountable for the results and impact of their work – setting priorities, coaching them into owners of their own market and product portfolios, and building the bench for the next layer of ownership.
- Set direction for the function. You contribute to the supply chain strategy and priorities for Dmarts, own multiple key results end to end, and align on shared strategic goals with central and regional leadership.
- Lead the Supply Chain target setting process. Set availability, fill rate, days on hand and spoilage targets per market, negotiate them with regional leadership, and hold the business accountable to them.
- Own the central demand planning framework across 40+ countries and develop the standards and guardrails markets plan against
- Drive the regular business planning alongside commercial and supplier management teams, establish the long-term capacity plan, and track forecast accuracy to translate our growth ambition into concrete network, inventory and supplier requirements.
- Achieve outcomes through others. The majority of your time goes to stakeholder management – aligning senior regional supply chain, store operations and commercial leaders, resolving misalignment before it escalates, and moving markets without formal authority over them.
- Influence product strategy and roadmaps. You are the business voice in the central product team: preparing business cases, aggregating and challenging feature requests from markets, and protecting roadmap focus by resolving what doesn't need engineering.
- Own rollouts and adoption end to end – pilot design, market readiness, training and hypercare – and be accountable for how well countries actually use our products, measured on adoption depth rather than deployment count.
- Own the market support model. The intake, triage and escalation path your team runs on features, bugs and questions, pulling in your product counterparts only where genuinely required.
- Be the supply chain subject-matter expert in the central team – the person regional teams consult when a problem has no obvious owner – and define the SOPs and streamline processes that turn what works in one market into a standard for the rest.
- Own business reporting and impact measurement. Standard KPI reporting, ad-hoc analysis and post-launch measurement of what our products moved, delivered through your team.

Qualifications

- 7+ years in supply chain planning or operations, ideally in Quick Commerce, grocery retail or FMCG – fast-paced, high-volume, imperfect data.
- People management experience. You have led specialists or analysts, delegate real ownership rather than tasks, give direct feedback, and take accountability for your team's results as your own.
- Senior stakeholder management. You are comfortable with regional functional heads and market leadership, build trust quickly across cultures and time zones, and can tell a market its numbers are wrong in a way that makes the correction stick.
- Deep, end-to-end understanding of how a grocery/FMCG supply chain works: demand planning, replenishment, supplier management, DC operations, inventory health.
- A track record with product and tech teams – writing requirements, building business cases, running multi-market rollouts, and driving adoption after go-live.
- Product and data fluency. You know our tools well enough to spot where they break the business, you can interrogate data yourself (SQL/BigQuery, advanced Sheets, Looker/Tableau), and you set the standard for how your team analyses and visualises – you don't need to build every dashboard, but you know when one is wrong.
- Process standardisation across markets – SOPs, playbooks and governance that survive after you leave the room.

Additional Information

- Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.
- Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Yoga, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- Look up and go for it. We will support you in developing yourself and your career: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Online Canteen, Corporate Discounts

Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

jobs.title: (Junior) Projektingenieur (m/w/x) (Ingenieur/in - Automatisierungstechnik)
jobs.description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

Arvato ist ein innovativer und global führender 3PL-Dienstleister im Bereich Supply Chain Management und E-Commerce. Mit 20.000 Teammitgliedern an über 100 Standorten fokussieren wir uns auf die Branchen Consumer Products, Tech, Healthcare, Automotive and Publisher.

Sei Teil des Teams, das Logistik-Exzellenz liefert und globale Lieferketten gestaltet. Denn Arbeiten bei Arvato heißt: Together, we’re on it.

Stellenbeschreibung

Du begeisterst dich für smarte Logistiklösungen, Automatisierung und moderne Technologien und möchtest gemeinsam mit anderen wachsen? In dieser Rolle gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft unserer Intralogistik, übernimmst Verantwortung und lieferst gemeinsam mit dem Team verlässliche Ergebnisse. Verstärke unser Engineering-Team als (Junior) Projektingenieur (m/w/x) an unserem Standort in Gütersloh und begleite spannende Logistikprojekte mit echtem Impact. Are you on it?

- Technisches Projektmanagement in der Intralogistik:
Du unterstützt bei Neu- und Umbauprojekten von der Konzeptphase über die Detailplanung bis zum Go-Live und übernimmst schrittweise eigenständige (Teil-)Projekte in Time, Budget und Qualität.
- Gestaltung automatisierter Logistiklösungen:
Gemeinsam mit Operations, IT und weiteren Schnittstellen definierst du Anforderungen an moderne Intralogistiksysteme wie Fördertechnik, Robotics, Shuttle- oder Goods-to-Person-Lösungen.
- Lastenhefte & Lieferant:innensteuerung:
Die Erstellung und Pflege technischer Lastenhefte sowie die Begleitung von Ausschreibungen und Umsetzungen mit nationalen und internationalen Partner:innen gehören zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich.
- Projekttransparenz & Reporting:
Durch strukturiertes Projekttracking, klares Reporting und offene Kommunikation schaffst du Transparenz, adressierst Risiken frühzeitig und arbeitest lösungsorientiert an Verbesserungen.
- Standardisierung & Innovation:
Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung technischer Standards mit, behältst Trends in Automatisierung, Digitalisierung und AI im Blick und bringst eigene Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Logistikstandorte ein.

Qualifikationen

- Qualifikation:
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Ingenieurwesen, in der Technischen Logistik, im Maschinenbau, in der Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation; alternativ eine technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum:r Techniker:in oder Meister:in mit hoher Logistikaffinität.
- Erste Projekterfahrung:
Idealerweise konntest du bereits erste Praxiserfahrungen im (Teil-)Projektmanagement oder in der Intralogistik sammeln, auch durch Praktika, Werkstudierendentätigkeiten oder den Berufseinstieg.
- Technisches Verständnis:
Grundkenntnisse in Materialfluss-, Förder- oder Automatisierungstechnik sowie erste Berührungspunkte mit Lagerverwaltungssystemen oder SPS-Umgebungen sind von Vorteil.
- Sprachkenntnisse:
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation im nationalen und internationalen Umfeld.
- Arbeitsweise & Persönlichkeit:
Du arbeitest strukturiert, teamorientiert und verbindlich und bringst Neugier für neue Technologien mit. Du hast Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Ergebnisse zuverlässig zu liefern sowie Bereitschaft für Dienstreisen zu nationalen und internationalen Standorten.

Zusätzliche Informationen

- Verantwortung & Entwicklung von Anfang an:
Vom ersten Tag an bist du ein vollwertiges Teammitglied, übernimmst eigene Aufgaben im Projektkontext und kannst mit einer steilen Lernkurve sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich wachsen.
- Internationales Netzwerk & spannende Projekte:
Nutze die Vorteile unseres weltweiten Bertelsmann-Netzwerks und arbeite in nationalen wie internationalen Logistikprojekten mit – ob Automatisierung, Robotic oder AI-basierte Lösungen.
- Gestaltungsspielraum & Innovation:
Bringe deine Ideen aktiv ein, teste neue Ansätze in der Intralogistik und arbeite in einem Umfeld, das Neugier fördert, Fortschritt wertschätzt und offene Fehlerkultur lebt.
- Weiterbildung & Karrierepfade:
