jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ODGOJITELJICA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“ br. 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22., 101/23., 145/23., 145/24., 146/25. i 22/26.), članka 42. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića Gustav Krklec Krapina i Odluke Upravnog vijeća Dječjeg vrtića Gustav Krklec Krapina od 28. kolovoza 2026. godine (KLASA: 601-04/26-01/06, URBROJ: 2140-37-02-26-07), Dječji vrtić Gustav Krklec Krapina raspisuje NATJEČAJ za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto ODGOJITELJ – 1 izvršitelj/ica na neodređeno vrijeme, u punom radnom vremenu UVJETI: osim općih uvjeta za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, kandidati moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvijete prema čl. 24. i čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“ br. 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22., 101/23., 145/23., 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26.), čl. 2. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (NN 145/2024 i 62/25) i čl. 9. točci 2.5. Pravilnika o unutarnjem ustrojstvu i načinu rada Dječjeg vrtića Gustav Krklec Krapina. stručna sprema: sveučilišni diplomski studij ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja sveučilišni prijediplomski studij ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja stručni prijediplomski studij ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja. Uvjete za rad u skladu s odredbama Pravilnika ispunjavaju i osobe koje su završile odgovarajući studijski program prema ranijim propisima te stekle odgovarajuću kvalifikaciju i akademski naziv u skladu s odredbama Zakona o visokom obrazovanju i znanstvenoj djelatnosti, Zakona o akademskim i stručnim nazivima i akademskome stupnju te Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju. Ako se na natječaj ne javi osoba koja ispunjava prethodno navedene uvjete, poslove odgojitelja može obavljati osoba koja je završila učiteljski studij i to: specijalistički diplomski stručni studij ili integrirani preddiplomski i diplomski studij ili četverogodišnji diplomski stručni studij primarnog obrazovanja, uz uvjet da u roku od dvije godine od dana zasnivanja radnoga odnosa stekne kvalifikaciju odgojitelja temeljem priznavanja stečenih ishoda učenja na studiju za učitelja i razlike programa za prekvalifikaciju ili dokvalifikaciju učitelja u svrhu stjecanja kvalifikacije odgojitelja Zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova (dokaz o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta dostavit će izabrani kandidat po dostavljenoj obavijesti o izboru, a prije sklapanja ugovora o radu). Podatci o plaći: Plaća radnika Dječjeg vrtića Gustav Krklec Krapina propisana je Kolektivnim ugovorom za djelatnost predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja za Dječji vrtić Gustav Krklec Krapina. Plaću radnika čini umnožak koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta i osnovice za obračun plaće, uvećan za 0,5% za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Koeficijent složenosti poslova predmetnog radnog mjesta iznosi 2,01 uz osnovicu za izračun plaće u iznosu od 1,025,00 eura bruto. Na natječaj se, pod ravnopravnim uvjetima, mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola, sukladno članku 13. stavku 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova („Narodne novine“ br. 82/08. i 69/17.), koji ispunjavaju propisane uvjete, a izrazi koje se koriste u ovom natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj, potrebno je priložiti sljedeće dokumente (preslike):
  • životopis;
  • dokaz o državljanstvu;
  • dokaz o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja ;
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak sukladno čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“ br. 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22., 101/23., 145/23., 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26.), izdano u svrhu zapošljavanja u dječjem vrtiću koje ne smije biti starije od datuma objave natječaja;
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak sukladno čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“ br. 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22., 101/23., 145/23., 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26.), izdano u svrhu zapošljavanja u dječjem vrtiću koje ne smije biti starije od datuma objave natječaja;
  • potvrdu nadležnog područnog ureda Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad, sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“ br. 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22., 101/23., 145/23., 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26.), da osobi nije izrečena mjera žurnog izdvajanja djeteta iz obitelji ili mjera za zaštitu osobnih prava i dobrobiti djeteta u nadležnosti suda.
Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Uz prijavu na natječaj, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja, dužni su priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu. Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti: - skladno čl. 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ br. 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dostaviti sve potrebne dokaze iz članka 103. navedenog Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju dostupni su na internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf - sukladno čl. 47.-50. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ br. 84/21.), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf - sukladno čl. 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ br. 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca. U nastavku je poveznica na dokaze koje kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti trebaju priložiti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf - sukladno čl. 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ br. 157/13., 152/14., 39/18., 32/20.), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici, a prije sklapanja ugovora predočit će se izvornik. Prijave na natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se osobno ili poštom na adresu: Dječji vrtić Gustav Krklec Krapina Magistratska ulica 11/1 49000 Krapina (Za natječaj – odgojitelj – ne otvaraj) Rok za podnošenje prijava na natječaj je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave i prijave zaprimljene elektronskim putem neće se razmatrati. Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatrat će se samo osoba koja podnese pravovremenu i urednu prijavu sa svim prilozima te ispunjava formalne uvjete natječaja. Osobe koje nisu podnijele pravodobnu ili potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatraju se kandidatima prijavljenim na natječaj te se njihove prijave neće razmatrati. O rezultatima provedenog natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku od osam (8) dana od dana donošenja odluke o odabiru kandidata na sjednici Upravnog vijeća Vrtića putem mrežne stranice i oglasne ploče Vrtića. Nakon provedenog natječaja ne mora se izvršiti izbor te se u tom slučaju donosi odluka o poništenju natječaja. Sukladno Uredbi Europske unije 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. te Zakonu o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine, br.42/18) prijavom na natječaj smatra se da je kandidat dao suglasnost za obradu podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a koja će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja ovog natječajnog postupka. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i Dječjeg vrtića Gustav Krklec Krapina dana 1. rujna 2026. godine i traje do 9. rujna 2026. godine.

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for an experienced attorney to join our Commercial Counsel team. This senior role will help build and support Notion’s rapidly evolving Enterprise customer sales motions, bringing deep expertise in negotiating complex AI SaaS agreements with enterprise customers, as well as acting as an advisor and coach to our account teams and cross functional partners. Notion is scaling rapidly, and we need people who work well as a tight-knit team with a passion for driving revenue deals to conclusion. If you enjoy using your deep industry and technology transaction expertise to support revenue generating functions, this role is for you.


Our Commercial Legal team sits at the center of Notion’s growth. We simplify how customers contract with us, take clear and unambiguous positions on AI, privacy, and security, and drive revenue deals to a fast, predictable close. That means exercising real judgment and finding creative, pragmatic paths forward through complex customer requests and requirements.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Have broad responsibility for negotiating SaaS AI agreements and providing practical day-to-day commercial legal support - primarily in the Americas region - for the sales, marketing, channels, and customer success teams with a focus on supporting the Enterprise segment

 - Collaborate with Product Legal team on product and operational items that impact customer agreements and go-to-market initiatives

 - Draft and negotiate complex agreements regarding privacy, security, and AI regulatory matters

 - Identify and independently pursue process improvements for buy-side supporting motions

 - Develop and revise contract templates and playbooks as necessary, based on changes in our product offerings, organization, and law




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Admitted to the California State Bar, New York State Bar, or Registered In-House Counsel in good standing

 - 10+ years of combined experience practicing as a commercial attorney within a law firm or software technology company

 - 2+ years in-house experience at a SaaS and/or AI technology company

 - Privacy and artificial intelligence subject matter expertise, including privacy regulations (GDPR, e-Privacy Directive, CCPA, etc.) and AI regulations (EU AI Act) with the ability to incorporate evolving requirements into the customer facing agreements

 - Experience driving commercial transactions, SaaS, and enterprise B2B transactions

 - Strong negotiation skills, including ability to explain nuanced legal concepts to internal and external parties and tailor approach to the audience

 - Excellent drafting, written and verbal communication skills and ability to adapt legal requirements in balanced, creative and pragmatic ways to facilitate communication at all levels of the organization

 - Ability to directly interact and build meaningful relationships and trust with internal and external clients and leaders

 - Demonstrated curiosity about AI and a willingness to adopt AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and deliver better results. Developing your personal AI fluency is required for this role

 - Resilience, resourcefulness, and the ability to make recommendations and decisions with imperfect facts

 - Independent and strategic thought combined with excellent team player qualities and a willingness to take on additional responsibilities




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Certified Information Privacy Professional or equivalent

 - Prior experience with a fast growing technology company

 - Experience supporting channel and reseller partnerships

 - Experience supporting customers in the financial services industry

 - Familiarity using Notion



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $280,000-340,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: (Associate) Vice President  (f/m/d) - Siemens Advanta (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:

- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.
- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.
- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.

What you bring:

- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.
- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.
- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.
- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.
- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.

What we offer you

- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .

At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent)Portugal

Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: International Advocacy Advisor
jobs.description:
RFSL is seeking an International Advocacy Advisor to advance international advocacy for LGBTQI rights in Ukraine. You will play a key role in working in close partnership with Ukrainian LGBTQI organisations and activists to identify priorities, develop advocacy strategies and create opportunities for locally led influence, while contributing RFSL’s resources, networks and international advocacy experience where these add value.

About RFSL and our international work

RFSL (the Swedish Federation for Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer, and Intersex Rights), founded in 1950, is one of the world’s oldest non-profit organisations working to advance LGBTQI rights.

RFSL’s international work supports LGBTQI movements in Eastern Europe, Asia and Africa through regranting, partnerships, knowledge exchange, organisational support and advocacy. We work closely with local partners to support locally led movements, strengthen their agency and influence, and contribute to enabling environments for LGBTQI rights at national, regional and global levels.

Russia’s war against Ukraine, including the 2022 full-scale invasion continues to threaten lives and rights of Ukrainians, disproportionately affecting LGBTQI persons. But the country’s broader political and social developments, as well as EU accession, have new opportunities for LGBTQI civil society. Against this backdrop, RFSL works with LGBTQI organisations and activists in Ukraine to make sure that international advocacy on Ukraine and LGBTQI rights is defined and led by Ukrainian voices, supporting their priorities and strengthening their influence at national and international levels. RFSL contributes resources, networks and international advocacy experience where these add value, while supporting partner autonomy and locally led advocacy.

Your role with us

As an International Advocacy Advisor, you will work closely with LGBTQI partner organisations and activists, primarily in Ukraine. The role focuses on facilitating international advocacy, with partnership support, knowledge exchange, travel scholarships  and programme support contributing to this work.

Your work will be aimed at ensuring that Ukrainian partner organizations have access to crucial international advocacy spaces, and that they have adequate capacity to impactfully engage with them. You will work with partners to identify advocacy priorities, develop strategies and engage with relevant decision-makers, institutions and human rights mechanisms. You will draw on RFSL’s international networks and experience where relevant, while ensuring that partners’ agency, priorities and expertise remain central. You will also coordinate and strengthen advocacy efforts in Sweden related to Ukraine, working closely with relevant colleagues and partners. Internally, you will coordinate with RFSL’s communications colleagues to ensure that advocacy and communications efforts are aligned and mutually reinforcing.

You will contribute to advocacy towards institutions such as the EU, UN, OSCE, Council of Europe and other relevant actors, supporting Ukrainian partners to participate in and influence these spaces where appropriate. You will also monitor political, legal and security developments together with partners, using this analysis to identify advocacy opportunities and adapt approaches as needed.

You will work closely with the Head of Program, International Program Managers, other Advocacy Advisors and colleagues across RFSL’s international work and will be based in Stockholm.

Who are you?

You are a structured, solution-oriented and collaborative professional with a strong commitment to LGBTQI rights, international advocacy and locally led movement strengthening in Ukraine. You understand that effective advocacy depends on strong relationships, partner-led priorities and attention to security, safeguarding and organisational needs.

You are comfortable working with activists, grassroots groups and established civil society organisations, adapting your approach to different partners and contexts. You separate between your personal views and relationships from your professional duties. You recognize the leadership of partner organizations in defining work and priorities. You work effectively in complex and politically sensitive environments, providing safe, accountable and flexible support while respecting partners’ knowledge, priorities and autonomy.

You understand the situation in Ukraine, region, its political and social context. You are aware of power dynamics in international partnerships and approach collaboration with humility, recognising that international organisations cannot replace local leadership or expertise. You combine strong organisational and administrative skills with the ability to build trusted relationships, manage practical implementation and contribute to advocacy strategies developed together with partners.

You are politically aware, analytical and a strong communicator, able to represent RFSL professionally with civil society organisations, government representatives and international institutions.

For full description of the role, key responsibilites and desired qualifications, please see our job ad on RFSL’s careers page.

Employment terms

    Employment type: This is a permanent position, starting with a six-month probationary period.
    Location: RFSL office in Stockholm, with some hybrid work possible. International travel several times per year is expected.
    Start date: As agreed
    Contract terms: Covered by the Collective Agreement for Nonprofit Organizations

Our offer

RFSL offers a dynamic and inclusive workplace that values professionalism, learning, and social impact. We provide competitive conditions, including occupational pensions and parental benefits, and an opportunity to work closely with committed colleagues and partners in a value-driven organisation.

How to apply

Applications should be submitted by September 20th, 2026. This recruitment process will be conducted in English.

For inquiries about the position or the recruitment process, please contact HR Partner Tobias Jensen at tobias.jensen@rfsl.se.

As a feminist and anti-racist organisation, RFSL strives to be an inclusive workplace for everyone, regardless of sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, sex characteristics, religion, race, ethnicity, country of origin, disability status, age, or other grounds of discrimination. Candidates with diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Expert, Science and Technology (F/M/D)
jobs.description:
1 Expert, Science and Technology (F/M/D) Job ID: REQ-10085657

As an Expert in the Method Development Team in Process Analytical Sciences (PAS), you will be responsible for physicochemical method development, optimization, and robustness testing in late-phase pharmaceutical drug development. Using state-of-the-art technologies and scientific expertise, you will support Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP) process development within a multidisciplinary project team. We are seeking an experienced scientist with strong analytical expertise, proficiency in data and digital tools, and comprehensive knowledge of DS and DP process development.

The role combines experimental laboratory work with technical documentation. The ideal candidate should therefore be comfortable working both in and outside the laboratory.

This position is limited to an 18-month fixed term.

Standort: Österreich / Schaftenau

This role is based in Schaftenau, Austria. Novartis cannot offer relocation support; please apply only if the location is accessible to you.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities

· Plan, organize, perform, and document physicochemical method development, including HPLC and CE, in compliance with internal quality and HSE standards.
· Use chromatographic, statistical, and other software tools to increase efficiency.
· Support the implementation, handover, and transfer of analytical methods
· Collaborate with PAS laboratories, Analytical Experts, and cross-functional teams to ensure effective analytical workflows.
· Design and execute physicochemical analytical approaches for DS, DP, and process intermediates in accordance with Quality by Design principles.
· Interpret analytical results and apply data and digital solutions to improve efficiency.
· Author and review scientific reports, support regulatory submissions

A propos du poste

Dans le cadre de la modernisation globale de ses infrastructures, notre client migre ses workloads actuellement hébergés sur des serveurs physiques RKE en fin de vie en Chine vers des services managés d'un cloud provider chinois. Ce projet stratégique d'une durée estimée à 12 mois vise à concevoir une architecture cible moderne, automatisée et hautement disponible.

Contrat : CDI de projet ou contrat Freelance, projet d'une durée initiale d'une année (atterrissage prévu été 2027).

Rattaché(e) à l'équipe technique de la DSI, vos responsabilités seront les suivantes :

- Cadrage et Chiffrage : Réaliser l'étude technique de faisabilité, définir l'architecture cible et présenter le chiffrage détaillé au DSI courant septembre.

- Build de l'Architecture : Concevoir et construire l'infrastructure sur un cloud provider chinois (type Alibaba Cloud) en privilégiant les services managés.

- Automatisation & Déploiement : Reproduire les mécanismes d'automatisation existants sur GCP à l'aide de Terraform et déployer les nouveaux clusters via Helm.

- Résolution des points de friction : Concevoir les architectures réseau (SD-WAN, cross-border line) pour maintenir la connectivité API avec Google, gérer l'interopérabilité de l'authentification (Google Identity) et définir les politiques de sécurité équivalentes à Cloud Armor.








Talent recherché

Expérience : Track record avéré et obligatoire sur un cloud provider chinois (idéalement Alibaba Cloud).
Nous recherchons un profil ayant à minima 5 années d'expérience en tant que Consultant DevOps et Cloud ou Architect Cloud et ayant déjà participé à des phases de cadrage et de chiffrage.

Compétences techniques :
- Compétences Cloud Chinois (Alibaba Cloud ou autre)

- Maîtrise de l'écosystème Kubernetes managé, des bases de données managées et du stockage objet.

- Expertise sur Terraform et Helm.

- Solides compétences en architecture réseau internationale et connectivité cross-border.

- Compétences GCP

- Connaissance des solutions de sécurité (WAF/Cloud Armor) et de gestion des identités (SSO/Google Cloud Identity).

- Utilisation de l'IA au quotidien

Soft Skills :

- Esprit de synthèse et pragmatisme pour concevoir des solutions simples à exploiter au quotidien.

- Autonomie et force de proposition pour guider le client sur ses choix stratégiques (ex. alternatives à PubSub).

- Capacité à communiquer facilement avec des équipes transverses

Langues : Anglais fluent (contexte international), Français, Mandarin serait un très gros plus








Processus de recrutement :

- Entretien initial avec notre recruteur et le responsable de la structure qui est ingénieur en informatique.
- Présentation de votre candidature à notre client (suite à un accord commun).
- Rencontre avec le client et ses équipes pour échanger sur le poste et les attentes.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter | GTM Expansion
jobs.description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

At Ramp, people are the single biggest lever on our trajectory, and the bar for who joins this team gets higher every quarter, not lower. We are hiring our first dedicated Recruiter for GTM Expansion, based in London: someone who can map a market, identify the operators who will outperform their peers and run a full-cycle process that wins them.

The UK is the immediate mandate. You will partner with local and US-based leaders to turn an ambitious growth plan into a real commercial team, from first conversation through offer close. You will also help us build the recruiting approach, market knowledge and candidate networks that support Ramp's expansion into new GTM markets over time.

The recruiters who do this best combine craft on the front end, research, identification and calibration, with execution on the back end, closing, candidate experience and pipeline discipline. We are looking for both.

What You'll Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting for priority GTM Expansion hiring, starting with UK roles across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships and Customer Success.

• Build a sharp point of view on the UK market and future expansion markets: the companies producing strong talent, the people who outperform their peers and the communities that matter.

• Use research, data and AI as part of your everyday craft to identify and qualify exceptional candidates. We expect a written market point of view, not just a slate of profiles.

• Run thoughtful, personalised outreach grounded in the candidate's actual background, commercial motion or recent work. We care more about quality, replies and conversion than send volume.

• Partner with GTM leaders to turn ambitious hiring plans into a clear profile, credible process and realistic compensation strategy. Surface hard market truth early and push back constructively when needed.

• Own the candidate experience from first conversation through offer close: fast follow-up, clear communication, strong process discipline and a tailored closing plan for the candidates we most want.

• Build real presence for Ramp in London through the right relationships, referrals and targeted community activity. The point is pipeline and credibility, not events for their own sake.

• Work tightly with the wider GTM Recruiting team on calibration, sourcing support, insight and operating rhythm, while bringing strong local judgment.

• Help improve how Ramp recruits for expansion by capturing what works in the UK and applying it thoughtfully as we enter new markets.

What You Need

• 5+ years of full-cycle GTM or Sales recruiting experience, ideally in a high-growth technology company where quality and pace both mattered.

• Strong knowledge of the UK technology talent market and a credible local network, or clear evidence that you can build one quickly.

• A track record of finding and closing exceptional people, not simply running inherited processes. You can point to candidates you identified who became strong hires.

• Excellent sourcing and research instincts. You can explain why someone is genuinely differentiated, not only that they have the right title at the right company.

• Experience hiring across several GTM functions, such as AEs, Sales Leadership, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships, Customer Success or RevOps.

• Strong candidate-closing judgment. You listen closely, understand what each candidate is weighing and can build conviction against serious alternatives.

• The confidence to influence senior leaders, challenge a mis-scoped search and make a hiring process better without creating unnecessary friction.

• Comfort using data to understand funnel health, diagnose problems and hold an honest conversation about what needs to change.

• High ownership. You book the next step while you have the candidate, chase what is stuck and do not wait for a detailed brief to get useful work moving.

• Specific, sharp written communication. Your outreach and candidate updates should never feel template-driven.

Nice to Have

• Experience recruiting for a fintech, SaaS, infrastructure or similarly complex B2B product.

• Experience joining a company as the first recruiter in a new geography, or helping to scale an international business.

• Experience building an AI-augmented recruiting research workflow.

Why this Role

You will have unusual ownership over one of Ramp's most important growth priorities, with the support of an established Talent team rather than the isolation of a one-person recruiting function. The work is practical and high impact: build the UK commercial team, help leaders make better hiring decisions and raise the bar for how Ramp recruits as it enters new markets.

In this role, you’ll help us build relationships with new Chinese restaurant partners across London and surrounding cities, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Commercial negotiation skills: Strong commercial acumen with the ability to handle negotiations, understand marketplace economics, and structure profitable, sustainable deals.

  • Autonomy and field-based resilience: A self-motivated, tenacious approach with the ability to work independently and spend significant time out on the road meeting prospects.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Business Operations
jobs.description:
About Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Team

BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next, for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day.

We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large.

Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it.

We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked.

The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast.

The Role

Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office).

This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer.

You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier.

Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?”

  • Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions.

  • Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams.

  • Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone.

  • Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language.

  • Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm.

  • Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions.

  • Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others:

  • Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential.

  • Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.

  • Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view.

  • Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations.

  • Driven, hard-working, and agile. BizOps sits at the centre of a fast-growing business; we move quickly to scale at pace.

  • London-based, with a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale: work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

  • 🌱 See your impact, fast: ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership: take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

  • 🌎 A culture built for builders: high standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.

  • 💰 Share in the success you help create: competitive salary and equity, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine; our interview typically includes 3 to 4 stages.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits across areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific; please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are: your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. If you have a disability or long-term health condition, or require any reasonable adjustments to apply or fairly participate in the interview process, please let us know; we'll make every effort to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

jobs.title: GRC Analyst
jobs.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we're building out our governance, risk and compliance capability with people who enjoy creating structure from scratch and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

We're building out a dedicated Governance, Risk & Compliance function — moving from a mix of individual ownership and external consultancy support to a resourced team that scales with the business. As GRC Analyst, you'll project manage our compliance programme end-to-end, working alongside a Principal Security Engineer who owns the technical security posture.

This is a builder's role. You won't be inheriting a mature, fully-documented programme — you'll be creating and automating the processes, evidence trails and tracking that don't fully exist yet. You'll have senior guidance close at hand, both internally and through Brookfield's governance frameworks, but you're the one who makes the programme run day to day.

As Radiant's obligations grow — spanning business continuity, AI governance, and an expanding footprint into owned and operated data centre and powered-land infrastructure — this role will grow with them.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end project management of the compliance programme: support ISO 27001 / SOC 2 audits, manage the policy lifecycle, and handle customer security questionnaires and KYC onboarding

  • Manage data protection operations and training, with UK GDPR at the core

  • Build and continuously improve how we work — automate manual, currently ad hoc processes (evidence collection, policy tracking, questionnaire responses) rather than running them from scratch each time

  • Coordinate business continuity: BCP/DR obligations and ownership of the Major Incident process, including testing and evidencing

  • Support our AI governance work — our internal AI and engineering AI policies — and help us keep pace with a fast-moving regulatory backdrop (including the EU AI Act), covering data handling, human oversight and vendor assessment

  • Coordinate health & safety compliance as we expand into physical premises and data centre operations, helping build a proper H&S management system where none currently exists

  • Partner closely with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, particularly on KYC, Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC) evidence, and technical control documentation

  • Help benchmark and align our Code of Conduct and policies with Brookfield's

  • Contribute to the wider roadmap as our footprint grows: precious and conflict-minerals due diligence, export controls, and ESG/energy governance

What You'll Bring

  • Solid UK GDPR and data protection experience

You will need strong hands-on experience in credit control, collections, or recurring payment recovery, ideally within a subscription, professional services, or other high-volume customer environment.

jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Remote / 20% Travel

 

About forgd

forgd is the consultancy partnering exclusively with Anthropic to help enterprises build AI-native businesses. We start with engineering — helping organizations move from individual developers using Claude Code to entire teams shipping together with AI-native workflows — and expand into agentic solution delivery and broader business transformation.

Our conviction is that engineers are uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. The strongest mental model for designing, deploying, and governing AI agents in production lives in software engineering. The teams that change how their organization builds software are the same teams equipped to shepherd the rest of the business into this new world.

We embed and co-build with customer teams. Cycles are short, delivery is iterative and accountable to clear outcome goals.

 

About the Role

As an FDE, you embed with enterprise customers and own the technical work across the full customer journey — initial demos, short proof-of-value engagements, and multi-week implementations. The work moves customers from interesting prototypes to production capability.

Most engagements start in engineering. You'll work with customer engineering teams adopting Claude Code and redesigning their SDLC — code review, requirements, testing, documentation, and governance. From there, the work expands: co-building agentic applications and modernizing legacy systems on the Claude developer platform, and partnering with business stakeholders to deploy agents into core operations like sales, customer service, and finance.

You're the expert in the room on how engineers work with Claude Code, what an agentic application looks like in production, and what has to change in an organization to sustain either. You build prototypes, ship code, run workshops, write specs, and make the calls that move customers from demos to deployment.

Collaborate directly with Anthropic on customer engagements — joint working sessions, early access to product changes, and a direct line to their product and engineering teams.

 

Responsibilities

Enable

  • Take customer teams from beginner to power user across Claude Code, Claude for Work, Cowork, and the developer platform

  • Codify deployment patterns and feed them back to forgd's methodology and Anthropic's product teams

Transform

  • Lead discovery into customer environments — engineering toolchains and workflows, business operations, and organizational dynamics — and turn that into clear technical plans

  • Advise on how AI-native development changes existing engineering practices: issue management, branching, testing, code review, and security

  • Guide adoption programs that scale Claude across engineering organizations and into business teams

Build

  • Scope engagements: assumptions, risks, milestones, and dependencies

  • Embed with customer teams to co-build agentic applications on the Claude developer platform

  • Build technical artifacts — evaluation frameworks, MCP servers, sub-agents, and deployment configurations — tailored to the customer's stack

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers move from proof-of-value to production

  • Engineering teams measurably change how they ship software

  • Customers become references

  • Accounts expand on the strength of the work

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • 3–5 years in a customer-facing technical role — Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Consultant — or in a hands-on engineering role as a Software Engineer or Product Engineer

  • Software development experience in a high-scale startup or enterprise environment; you know what it takes to write, ship, and operate production code

  • Production experience with LLMs — prompt engineering, agent design, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Power user of Claude Code or equivalent AI coding assistants; you live in AI-native development yourself

  • Familiarity with enterprise development toolchains, CI/CD, and modern SDLC practices, and cloud-native deployment on AWS, GCP, or Azure

  • Communication skills that work across the room — individual contributors, engineering leadership, and business stakeholders

  • High agency and comfort with ambiguity; you operate autonomously in customer environments

Nice to Have

  • Background in professional services or consulting

  • Track record leading developer productivity or developer experience at scale

  • Vertical experience in financial services, healthcare, or other regulated industries

  • Experience driving organizational change

What We Offer

  • Founding team: You shape how we work and grow as we scale

  • Remote: Fully remote across North American and European time zones

  • Compensation and benefits: Competitive salary, equity, and full benefits

How to Apply

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. Research shows people from underrepresented groups often hesitate unless they meet every requirement, and we don't want you to exclude yourself prematurely. If you're excited about AI-native engineering and want to help enterprises change how they build software, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate
jobs.description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Owning a portfolio of fleet customers end to end, from onboarding through to renewal, with clear accountability for keeping them

  • Handling inbound policy queries from customers and brokers by phone and email, resolving them quickly and helping people self-serve where that suits them better

  • Running quarterly reviews with fleet managers and brokers, then tracking the actions that come out of them, and supporting broker onboarding with the Distribution team

  • Delivering safety and claims interventions when our telematics data flags a risk, working with the Claims and Underwriting teams on triggers and follow-up

  • Working across Underwriting, Finance and Product to investigate and resolve the trickier issues, including policy referrals and connectivity troubleshooting with our telematics partners

  • Capturing customer feedback and raising process, automation and self-serve suggestions so our service keeps improving

  • Using Flock's AI tools every day to prepare customer insight packs, draft follow-ups and keep your book organised

 

What you'll need

  • A background in customer service, customer success or account management. The sector does not matter to us; the quality of your service does

  • Rapport that comes naturally. Our customers should genuinely like dealing with you

  • Hunger to learn and real coachability. We will teach you the insurance and the telematics

  • Clear written and spoken communication, with a knack for making complex things easy to understand, and the confidence to present to clients

  • A proactive attitude to getting the job done, even when the answer takes some digging

  • Organisation across a busy and varied workload, with the accuracy and attention to detail to match the pace

  • Evidence you already use AI tools to work better, or a genuine appetite to build that habit fast

  • Desirable, not required: time working with fleets, or exposure to motor insurance

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that's a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

jobs.title: Head of Migrations
jobs.description:
Head of Migrations

Location: Our offices are in Central London, along with several of our customers. Travel to our customer sites is required, the frequency of which will vary from customer-to-customer. You need to be able to travel onsite to London up to 3 days per week, although onsite requirements will vary week-to-week and customer-to-customer from 0 to 3 days.

Salary: Competitive (DOE)

 

Defence/SC Clearance Requirements:

SC clearance is required for our customer facing teams. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance. DV clearance may be required for certain roles, so the ability/willingness to pass DV clearance is advantageous but not essential.

About the role

We are hiring a Head of Migrations to lead all migration work across the business. You will be the single accountable owner of our migration pipeline, created in direct response to the volume of AWS Migration Acceleration Programme (MAP) engagements now running across our client base.

The remit goes wider than MAP workload migrations. You will lead data centre exit programmes and landing zone migrations too, building a repeatable set of methodologies and delivery assets for each rather than running every engagement bespoke.

This is a role that grows with the offering. You start by proving demand and defining how we deliver. Once the investment case lands, you recruit and lead the team. In time you own a standalone unit with full profit and loss accountability. The person does not change as the offering matures. What changes is what you are accountable for.

What you will do

  • Own Cloudscaler's MAP relationship, making sure engagements are registered, funded and tracked through Assess, Mobilise and Migrate, with funding claims that are accurate, evidenced and defensible.

  • Lead data centre exit programmes end to end, from estate discovery and dependency mapping through to decommissioning and contract exit.

  • Own our end-to-end migration methodology: portfolio discovery, application assessment using the 7 Rs, wave planning, execution and post-migration validation.

  • Own the migration assessment tooling as subject-matter expert, defining what it captures, how findings map to migration patterns, and how a business case is built from the output.

  • Support the commercial team on proposals, workshops and MAP funding conversations, and build trusted adviser relationships with client CTOs and infrastructure leads.

  • Deliver against a six-month revenue plan, report monthly KPIs from month one, and build the investment case for a ring fenced team.

  • Recruit, lead and develop that team once the case is approved, working to a team gross profit model.

  • Drive AI and automation across the migration lifecycle to cut manual effort and improve the accuracy of migration business cases.

  • Represent Cloudscaler publicly through speaking, blogs, white papers and partnership activity with AWS.

What we are looking for

  • Proven leadership of large-scale AWS migration programmes, with real accountability for outcomes.

  • Working knowledge of AWS MAP, including funding, credits and the evidencing discipline the programme demands.

  • Experience of data centre exit and landing zone migration, not just application moves.

  • The ability to build a TCO model and a migration business case that convinces both an architect and a board.

  • Commercial fluency: revenue, gross profit, utilisation and pipeline are part of the job, not someone else's problem.

  • Credibility with senior client stakeholders and a track record of building trust through delivery.

  • Experience hiring and leading delivery teams, and setting the standard for quality.

  • Comfort working without an established playbook. You will write it.

  • Taking an organisation through AWS competency attainment.

  • Regulated sector experience: financial services, public sector, utilities, healthcare or defence.

  • Modernisation delivery, including containerisation and server-less refactoring.

  • P&L ownership for a practice or business unit.

  • Productising delivery assets into reusable, versioned intellectual property.

  • Hands-on use of AI tooling to accelerate discovery, assessment and reporting.

Benefits

  • Discretionary bonus

  • Discretionary security clearance bonus for those holding certain clearance

  • Periodic offer of share options schemes

  • 25 days’ annual leave

  • 5 additional days per year towards training, certifications, or charity work

  • Option to buy additional annual leave up to 5 days per year

  • Public holidays opt-out scheme, the option to work on public holidays creating the flexibility to enjoy your time off when it suits you

  • Certifications and training expensed

  • Life Assurance

  • Long Term Disability cover

  • Employee Assist Programme for employee advice and support (including legal and counselling helpline)

  • Health, Mental Health, Wellbeing, Financial and Legal support

  • 24/7 GP access

  • Pension auto-enrolment and contribution

  • Employee referral scheme

  • Client referral scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Travel expenses policy

The Role

This is a highly dynamic role focused on solving important operational and commercial problems across the Dealer journey. You will focus strictly on the B2B/Dealer side of our marketplace, acting as a key driver for improving our post-sale experience.

You will combine strong analytical thinking with practical execution. That means identifying opportunities through data and observation, developing clear hypotheses, and then driving cross-functional initiatives that deliver measurable outcomes.

The role is intentionally broad. You will work across teams including Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and commercial functions—as well as partner third parties—to solve complex problems and implement scalable solutions. In this role, you will have consistent exposure to Leadership, including our Director of Dealer Services and our COO.

Motorway moves quickly and operates in an environment that is constantly evolving. This role suits someone who thrives in ambiguity, is naturally curious, demonstrates high agency, and enjoys taking ownership of messy problems and turning them into structured solutions. We’re looking for someone who instinctively looks for smarter ways to get things done, whether that is redesigning a process, automating manual work, or using AI / Tooling to solve gnarly problems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Enhance the Dealer Post-Sale Experience: Identify operational and commercial improvement opportunities across our Dealer journey, dedicating significant focus to elevating our transport (Motorway Move) and payments (Motorway Pay) products and services.

  • Drive Stickiness and Retention: Identify friction points in the dealer journey and execute improvement strategies to boost platform stickiness and directly reduce cancellation rates.

  • Spearhead AI and Automation: Streamline operational workflows by embedding AI to handle routine tasks, taking license to explore creative ways to use AI tools to build faster, leaner, and better operational frameworks.

  • Innovate Novel Post-Sale Areas: Beyond Move and Pay, research, test, and implement new improvements and services that deliver continuous value to our dealers.

  • Lead Cross-Functional Projects: Drive projects from idea through to implementation, partnering with teams across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and external partners.

What We Are Looking For

  • High Agency & Problem Solving: Strong problem-solving ability with high agency, thriving in an environment with a wide span of control and proactively diving deep into ambiguous problems.

  • B2B / Dealer Empathy: A strong understanding of the complexities of B2B relationships and empathy for dealer workflows to build better post-sale experiences.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Experience analysing data to look at the big picture and identify high-opportunity areas.

  • Clear & Structured Communication: The ability to structure ambiguous problems and simplify complex operational topics into clear, digestible written and verbal communications for leadership and stakeholders.

  • Tech-Forward & AI-Curious: An eager approach to learning and experimenting with emerging AI tools to automate workflows, analyse problems, and improve productivity.

  • Adaptable Team Player: Comfortable collaborating across Sales, Product, Marketing, and Leadership teams to ensure operational improvements align seamlessly with company goals.
