jobs.title: Software Engineer (Data)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Software Engineer (Data), you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements.

You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way.

What you’ll be working on

  • Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them.

  • Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks.

  • Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services.

  • Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring.

  • Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time.

  • Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions.

  • Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

Behind the scenes

Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS.

Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements.

We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies.

Your skills and experience

  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.

  • A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on.

  • Comfortable with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS.

  • A good grasp of ETL/ELT and orchestration.

  • Experience building or running data integrations and connectors, especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on.

  • You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data.

Nice to have, not essential:

  • Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format

  • Experience with MCP server development, or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers.

We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it.

Why join us?

Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork.

At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them.

You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries.

Our Compensation & Benefits

It's important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. You'll have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, with the full offering here.

💰 Competitive base salary + equity, so you own what you build

⭐ Bonus scheme designed to reward and recognise high performance

💳 £100 monthly personal Ben Balance: for whatever works for you, whether that's Netflix, Spotify, or a really expensive cup of coffee! This allowance will increase by £50 for each year of service until you reach £250

🍔 Weekly lunch provided in office so you can spend quality time with the team over some tasty food!

🏖 28 days of holidays a year plus bank holidays, and an option to buy or sell 5 days per year. Your holiday entitlement increases to 30 days at your 3rd year of service!

❤️ Comprehensive Private Medical Insurance

💌 Funded Life Assurance cover with the option to voluntarily increase. This also includes an annual health check

🧠 Comprehensive mental health support and professional coaching through a leading provider

  • Confidently interpret performance data and reporting to highlight areas for change and realise cost efficiencies.

  • Take full responsibility for complaints data accuracy and reporting to the regulator and white-label partners.

  • Ensure any identified risks are mitigated, actions are owned and delivered to plan, and drive accountability to promote a well-controlled function.

Required Qualifications

  • Deep, practical knowledge of FCA regulatory requirements and DISP rules.

  • Proven ability to manage and influence key influencers and decision-makers.

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • A track record of prioritising and delivering in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

  • A self-starter who is willing to dive into the details of the team's work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in the motor industry or handling automotive finance complaints is highly desirable.

  • Previous experience in a "unicorn" or rapidly scaling fintech environment.

  • Fluency in modern digital tools and an interest in AI-driven operational solutions.

Life at Lendable

jobs.title: Head of Key Account Management (m/f/d) - EMEA
jobs.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About the role

This is one of the most important leadership hires in the EMEA business. The Head of KAM — EMEA will own Statista’s most strategically important accounts and lead the team that protects and grows the commercial relationships that underpin our 2026 stability and 2027 acceleration.

You will report directly to the VP Sales EMEA and sit on the EMEA commercial leadership team. This is not a steady-state account management role. It is a transformation mandate — to rebuild the KAM function into an enterprise-grade strategic account motion that moves our most important clients from users of data to institutional partners embedded in Statista’s AI and intelligence infrastructure.

What success looks like - First 12 months

• GRR stabilised across the KAM book through structured renewal discipline, early intervention on at-risk accounts, and a clear early-warning system.

• Every KAM account has a live account plan — org map, stakeholder map, expansion roadmap, and renewal forecast.

• Economic buyer engagement across the top tier — conversations at VP, Director, and C-suite level, not just with research and insights teams.

• Connect adoption initiated in strategically important accounts — from licence conversation to embedded data infrastructure.

• KAM team assessed, coached, and operating to an enterprise standard — structured QBRs, value realisation conversations, and expansion plays running consistently.

• Investment case for FY27 KAM expansion — headcount, coverage model, and tooling — presented to the CCO.

Your tasks

Lead and Transform the KAM Team

• Own the day-to-day leadership, coaching, and performance management of the EMEA KAM team.

• Assess each KAM against the enterprise motion requirements and build individual development plans. Not everyone will be on the same journey — that is a leadership decision, not a management failure.

• Build a coaching standard grounded in enterprise selling: consultative discovery, multi-stakeholder navigation, C-suite engagement, and business case construction.

• Develop the team’s ability to move from user-level relationships to economic buyer access — and to carry a complex, multi-product conversation with credibility.

• Install a peer coaching culture where KAMs learn from each other under a clear standard, not only from you.

Protect GRR in 2026

• Own the renewal and churn-prevention motion across the KAM book.

• Build an early-warning system for at-risk accounts — usage signals, stakeholder changes, competitor activity, budget cycles — with clear escalation and intervention protocols.

• Partner with Customer Success leadership to ensure joined-up coverage across adoption, value realisation, and renewal.

• Conduct and coach structured QBRs that demonstrate ROI and surface expansion signals — not renewal conversations dressed up as business reviews.

Drive the Enterprise Account Motion

• Build and embed the account planning standard across the KAM team — org mapping, stakeholder matrix, commercial roadmap, and expansion sequencing.

• Lead the movement from user-level selling to economic buyer engagement across the top-tier KAM book.

• Own the Connect and Statista+ expansion motion — identifying accounts where data infrastructure conversations are ready to open, and coaching KAMs to run them.

• Build the institutional knowledge that makes Statista’s largest accounts structurally difficult to displace.

Drive NRR Growth

• Own NRR targets across the KAM portfolio. Define the expansion plays that unlock commercial headroom in existing accounts.

• Identify accounts where Connect’s consumption-based model opens a new commercial conversation with a new buyer — technical, commercial, and C-suite.

• Create structured handoffs with the Customer Success and Scale teams to ensure expansion signals are acted on, not lost.

• Champion the full OneStatista platform — core, Connect, Statista+, and IQ roadmap — in every strategic account engagement.

Shape the Commercial Operating Model

• Define the KAM coverage model — which accounts receive full KAM attention, at what intensity, and how that changes as the portfolio evolves.

• Partner with the VP Sales EMEA on the FY27 KAM investment case — headcount, tooling, and the team structure required to operate an enterprise motion at scale.

• Represent EMEA KAM in global commercial leadership forums — bringing regional evidence and recommendations to shape global strategy and playbooks.

• Work closely with New Business leadership to ensure the accounts being landed are the right accounts — and that the handoff from new business to KAM is clean.

Your profile

Essential

• Substantial enterprise account management or key account leadership experience — managing strategic relationships at VP, Director, and C-suite level, with deals at £100k+ ACV.

• Evidence of building or materially improving a KAM or enterprise account function — account planning, coverage models, QBR standards, and expansion playbooks.

• Proven track record of protecting GRR and growing NRR in a subscription-based model.

• Commercial instinct for the enterprise motion — value discovery, business case construction, multi-stakeholder navigation, and land-and-expand execution.

• Experience developing and coaching account managers to raise the quality of their commercial conversations — not just their activity levels.

• Ability to lead change in a team that is transitioning from a transactional to an enterprise model — without losing the team in the process.

Desirable

• Experience in data, intelligence, research, information services, or AI-adjacent platforms.

• Familiarity with consumption-based or usage-based commercial models.

• Exposure to enterprise procurement, legal, and compliance conversations in regulated industries.

• Experience working across multiple European markets in a matrixed organisation.

Why join Statista?

• The most strategically important leadership role in the EMEA commercial organisation. What you build here defines Statista’s growth trajectory.

• Direct line to the VP Sales EMEA and CCO — your commercial judgement will shape decisions at the top of the business.

• A product story that is only getting stronger — Connect, Statista+, and StatistaIQ give you a genuinely differentiated platform to build enterprise relationships around.

• The mandate to rebuild for enterprise — with CEO and board alignment behind the direction. The strategy is set. The opportunity is to execute it.

• Real runway. Build this well in 2026 and you will own the enterprise account engine for one of the most recognised data platforms in the world.

Working Model and Compensation

• Hybrid working from our London office, with regular travel across EMEA and to Hamburg HQ.

• Competitive base salary commensurate with senior enterprise leadership — range shared at initial screen. Above-band compensation considered for exceptional candidates.

• Performance-linked OTE. Pension, private healthcare, and core benefits.

Recruitment Process

Shortlisted candidates will move through a structured process:

• Initial screen with Talent Acquisition.

• In-depth conversation with the VP Sales EMEA.

• Panel interview with CCO and a commercial peer.

• Strategic account plan presentation and live exercise.

Inclusive Application

Statista is committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from candidates with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We recognise that strong candidates may not meet every listed criterion. If the role interests you and your experience is relevant, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to discuss reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

 

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
We are now looking for a Head of People to join us on a 12 month contract.

This is a key leadership role overseeing HR and the Craft Manager group across the studio for a 12 month period, temporarily assuming the people responsibilities currently held by our Chief of Staff.

Reporting to the CEO, you will directly lead the Craft Managers and HR Business Partners across the studio. You will ensure that recruitment, people processes, performance management, and day to day people leadership operate smoothly and consistently. At the end of the contract, you will oversee a clear and well documented handover to the permanent Chief of Staff.

Who you are:

You are an experienced HR leader who is equally comfortable leading the HR function and developing managers. The right person can distinguish great from good and sets the bar accordingly. You bring sound judgment to sensitive situations such as employee relations cases, union matters, compensation decisions and know how to handle and document them properly. You build trust quickly. You can step into an existing organization, understand how it already works, and lead its people functions without a long ramp-up.

You combine strategic leadership with a practical approach and are comfortable taking an active role in performance cycles, compensation processes, and recruitment when needed. You have high integrity, strong communication skills, and a genuine desire to help both people and the organization succeed.

What you'll do:

As Head of People, you will lead HR and the Craft Manager group, with all Craft Managers and HR Business Partners reporting directly to you.

In short, the Head of People will:

    

Lead, prioritise, and develop the HR team.

    

Lead and align the Craft Manager group, making sure they are equipped, supported, and held accountable.

    

Own workforce planning, talent management, and organisational design, working closely with studio leaders.

    

Lead performance management cycles, including ratings, reviews, performance improvement plans, and development plans.

    

Handle and support employee relations cases, including documentation and follow-through

    

Lead compensation processes, including salary reviews and profit share elections.

    

Represent the studio in union negotiations and statutory employee representation meetings, including preparing for and participating in these discussions.

    

Shape and reinforce the studio’s culture by promoting effective collab oration and recognising the behaviours and contributions we value.

    

Set strategic priorities and oversee workload planning for HR and the Craft Manager group, reporting progress to senior management.

What we're looking for

    

An experienced HR leader who can quickly take responsibility for an established people function and provide direction to both HR professionals and people managers.

    

Sound judgement and discretion, with the confidence to navigate complex employee relations, union, performance, and compensation matters.

    

A collaborative and credible communicator who can build trust and influence stakeholders at every level of the studio.

    

A practical, adaptable approach and the ability to make a meaningful impact within a 12 month assignment while preparing for a smooth handover.

    

Professional fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

jobs.description:
L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements, 1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité - nous recherchons un**-**e Software Engineer senior aussi bien à l'aise avec Django que React pour nous aider à accélérer, se connecter à plus de fabricants et améliorer l'impact de l'application. Tu seras au cœur de son développement sur toutes les plateformes web/iOS/Android.
Chez Hello Watt, nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeur. Nous cherchons des ingénieurs enthousiastes à l'idée d'explorer et de définir, ensemble, les contours de ce que sera demain notre nouveau métier de développeur.
Tes missions :
- Implémenter de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android)

- Développer les intégrations api de pilotage d'appareil : onduleurs solaires, thermostats, bornes de recharge de véhicules électriques

- Intégrer des fonctionnalités de flexibilité énergétique et d'effacement (programmation intelligente, pilotage selon les signaux de production solaire/tension du réseau, etc.).

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes, des tests solides et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Contribuer activement à l'outillage et aux workflows IA de l'équipe : prompts et conventions partagés, garde-fous, quality gates et boucles de feedback pour améliorer en continu la qualité du code généré

- Concevoir l'évolution de l'architecture de la plateforme

Profil recherché
À l'ère où l'IA accélère la production de code, nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.

jobs.title: Group Climate & Circularity Manager
jobs.description:
At Foxway, we don't just talk about circularity. We've built our business around it.

Our sustainability work

It is by driving circular tech at scale that Foxway has the biggest contribution to a sustainable development while securing the long-term competitiveness of the company. Circularity sits at the core of our strategy, in our commercial offering and our service model, and we are committed to sustainable business practises in our operations, people practices and throughout our value chain.

Foxway is committed to climate action in line with the 1.5-degree target and we transparently disclose our group wide CO2 emissions and climate work. We have set near-term and net-zero science-based targets, validated by the Science Based Targets initiative, and formalise our climate action work in our climate transition plan.

The Group Sustainability team develops and drives Foxway's sustainability work at a strategic level with a strong commercial focus. We have a commercial focus and support the business in leveraging circular business opportunities, monitor our sustainability progress, work cross-functionally with other key functions, and drive initiatives that build sustainability knowledge across the organisation to further accelerate our impact.

We are now looking for a Group Climate & Circularity Manager to become the Group's primary climate and circularity expert: owning and driving this work at group level together with the business. As thought leader on circularity and the scaling of climate solutions, you will be representing Foxway externally.

About the Role

You will join our Group Sustainability team and report directly to our Chief Sustainability Officer. This is a hands-on specialist and individual contributor role with Group-wide ownership and broad exposure across our business. You will be a natural point of contact for climate and circularity, working across strategy, product and service development, commercial initiatives, customer dialogues and reporting.

At the core of the role is to drive initiatives to further embed climate and circularity in strategy, product and service development, and commercials, including tenders. You own and drive Foxway's climate transition plan group-wide, supporting progress against the Science Based Targets. You continuously develop the methodology behind our carbon accounting, our Product Carbon Footprint assessment for refurbished devices, and develop relevant impact metrics on circularity and climate.

You will also contribute to Foxway's external thought leadership, representing our climate and circularity work in customer dialogues, industry forums, conferences and other relevant settings.

The role will be based at our HQ in Stockholm (Solna) with a strong focus on in-person collaboration. The role involves regular travel across our markets for customer meetings, conferences and industry events.

What you will do

    Own and further develop our climate transition plan, science-based targets, and carbon accounting.
    Own our Product Carbon Footprint assessment, including methodology, and relevant use cases in communication, sales and customer level reporting.
    Further develop our circularity strategy, targets and metrics, activities, and reporting in line with emerging frameworks and best practice.
    Provide input to our sustainability reporting process and the data gathering behind our CSRD report (ESRS E1 and E5).
    Drive the CDP disclosure process and engage key stakeholders on the development areas.
    Drive internal initiatives and cross-functional projects, together with business lines and group functions, that improve our climate and circularity performance.
    Be part of building external thought leadership on climate and circularity through conferences, panels, and industry forums, positioning Foxway as a leading voice on circular tech.

We believe you have

    Around 3-5 years of relevant professional experience, with climate and circularity forming a meaningful part of your work.
    Practical experience with GHG Protocol, carbon accounting and climate transition planning, CDP disclosure, with enough technical understanding to assess and challenge methodologies and external expertise.
    Knowledge of lifecycle assessments and Product Carbon Footprint methodologies, ideally including avoided-emissions calculations, claims or related standards.
    Understanding of circularity principles, frameworks and emerging best practices.
    Strong analytical and numerical skills, combined with the ability to translate technical and scientific concepts into clear business implications.
    Experience driving projects and coordinating stakeholders across different functions, ideally in an international or multi-stakeholder organization.
    A relevant Master's degree, preferably in economics, sustainability, or engineering.
    Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the confidence to communicate technical topics to non-specialist audiences.

Meritorious

    Swedish proficiency is an advantage but not required.
    Experience with CSRD/ESRS, Double Materiality Assessment, TCFD, supply-chain sustainability or AI-supported analytical workflows is advantageous, but we don't expect you to tick every box.
    Experience from the tech/ICT sector, circular business models or climate solutions is also beneficial, but not a prerequisite. What matters most is the depth of your climate/circularity expertise and your ability to apply it in a business context.

This is how you will succeed in this role

You can translate technical and scientific climate and circularity concepts depending on the situation and audience and build and own processes rather than just follow them, and you use AI as a natural element and accelerator in this work. You build long term relationships with key stakeholders and take responsibility over your deliveries with high quality and in a timely manner.

Above all, you understand the role technology and circularity can play in a more sustainable future and are motivated by turning that potential into measurable business and sustainability impact.

For the selected final candidate

Foxway will conduct a background check as part of our recruitment process, in accordance with applicable local legislation and our internal screening policy. The scope of the check depends on the position and the country in which it is based. You will be informed of the details, and your approval will be requested before any check is initiated.

jobs.title: Produktion av reklamställ, mässmonterbyggnation samt slutbehandling av tryck och förpackning
jobs.description:
Produktionsmedarbetare till TETRIX – för dig som gillar att kunna lite av allt

På TETRIX bygger vi mässmontrar, displaysystem, ljuslådor, reklamställningar och speciallösningar för företag. En del produkter tillverkar vi om och om igen. Andra har vi aldrig byggt tidigare.

Därför söker vi inte nödvändigtvis någon som redan kan allt. Vi söker dig som **gillar att lära dig nya saker, lösa problem och få saker färdiga.**

Vad gör man då hos oss?

Aluminiumkonstruktionerna till våra produkter tillverkar vi i vår egen aluminiumverkstad. Där kapas lätta aluminiumprofiler, lås och beslag monteras och det förekommer borrning, gängning och enklare maskinarbete.

Du behöver inte kunna det från början. **Vi lär dig.**

Eftersom vi gör mycket kundanpassat dyker det regelbundet upp saker som inte riktigt finns i någon manual. Då behöver man kunna fundera:

_Hur löser vi det här på ett enkelt och smart sätt?_

Ibland finns svaret redan hos någon av oss. Ibland får man mäta, prova, fundera och prova igen.

Vi producerar också storbildsgrafik till våra mässmontrar och reklamställningar. Våra storbildsplottrar skriver ut bilderna, varefter grafiken ska renskäras, efterbehandlas och anpassas till systemen.

När alla delar är klara testbygger vi ofta produkten. Den ska passa ihop, fungera och se ut som den ska innan kunden får den.

Sedan packas den för transport – eller så åker vi ut och bygger upp hela lösningen hos kunden.

Ena dagen aluminium – nästa dag något helt annat

Det här är alltså inte jobbet för dig som helst vill göra exakt samma arbetsmoment varje dag.

En dag kan du kapa aluminium och montera beslag.

Nästa dag kanske du skär storbildsgrafik, packar en mässmonter som ska till Sverige, letar fram delar från lagret eller försöker lista ut hur vi ska bygga en specialkonstruktion som någon har ritat.

Och ibland står en mässa runt hörnet, transporten går snart och **allt ska bli klart.**

Då behöver vi arbetsmyran i dig.

Den som inte ger upp när det blir bråttom utan istället börjar fundera på vad som måste göras först, vad som kan göras samtidigt och hur vi tillsammans får allt över mållinjen.

Bråttom betyder däremot inte att det får bli dåligt. Kunden ska fortfarande få rätt delar, snygg grafik och en produkt som fungerar.

Vi tror att du passar hos oss om...

Du är lite av en **tusenkonstnär**.

Du behöver inte vara aluminiumexpert, grafiker, montör, lagerarbetare och uppfinnare redan när du kommer genom dörren. Det viktiga är att du är nyfiken nog att lära dig.

Du behöver inte heller vara någon maskinexpert. Men det är ett stort plus om du inte blir nervös av tanken:

_"Den där maskinen har jag aldrig använt. Visa mig."_

Vi visar. Du provar. Snart kan du den.

Du bör också ha ett naturligt öga för detaljer. Ser du att något sitter snett, ligger på fel plats eller borde städas undan är tanken att du fixar det – inte väntar på att någon ska skriva en arbetsorder.

Hos oss hör ordning faktiskt till produktionen. Delarna ska gå att hitta, lagret ska hållas i skick och arbetsplatserna ska vara sådana att nästa jobb går snabbt att starta.

Det viktigaste är hur du fungerar

Nästan alla enskilda arbetsmoment hos oss är ganska enkla när man väl har lärt sig dem.

Utmaningen ligger istället i **variationen och helheten**.

Du behöver kunna växla mellan olika uppgifter, tänka själv, fråga när du inte vet och efter hand lära dig att se vad som behöver göras utan att någon hela tiden pekar ut nästa arbetsmoment.

Vissa dagar behövs uppfinnaren.

Andra dagar behövs problemlösaren.

Och ibland behövs helt enkelt arbetsmyran som bestämmer sig för att:

**Det här ska bli klart.**

Vi uppskattar människor som vågar prova. Gör man många speciallösningar kommer inte första idén alltid att vara den bästa. Det viktiga är att kunna tänka om och hitta en bättre lösning.

Praktiskt

Du behöver **B-körkort**, eftersom arbetet ibland innebär transporter eller montering hos kund.

Vi arbetar med kunder på flera språk. Kan du svenska och finska är det utmärkt. Engelska är också mycket användbart eftersom både kunder, leverantörer och instruktioner kan vara internationella.

Erfarenhet från produktion, aluminium, snickeri, reklamproduktion, montering, lager, byggande, maskiner eller liknande är naturligtvis ett plus.

Men rätt inställning väger tungt.

**Kan du inte – lär vi dig. Förstår du inte – frågar du. Finns ingen färdig lösning – försöker vi hitta en.**

Det är ungefär så vi jobbar på TETRIX.

Så om du gillar praktiskt arbete, teknik, problemlösning och variation – och helst vill ha ett jobb där du fortfarande kan lära dig något nytt nästa år – då kan det här vara rätt plats för dig.

jobs.title: Workday Integration Lead

Your responsibilities

    

Lead the design and redesign of Workday integrations.

    

Define integration architecture, standards, and best practices.

    

Build scalable, secure, and maintainable integration solutions.

    

Act as a technical advisor and support key architecture decisions.

    

Collaborate with implementation partners, architects, business analysts, and application teams.

jobs.title: Clothing Team worker, Lapland Safaris Olos
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Clothing Team workers for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the Christmas season 2026. We are looking for Clothing Team workers to work in Saariselkä, Hetta and Olos.**

As a Clothing Team worker, you will assist guests to get properly dressed for winter activities for their entire holiday. Safari clothing includes overalls, woolen socks, boots, gloves, balaclava, and a hat if needed. After the safaris guests return the clothes and the clothing team is responsible for the washing and organizing of the clothing. The team also ensures that the customer premises are clean and organized. Work is an important part of the success of safari excursions.

You are the person we are looking for if you are customer service-oriented and have a positive attitude towards your work. We value diligence, initiative, teamwork skills, and conscientiousness in our employees. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

Due to the busy nature of seasonal work, we require flexibility in working hours and the ability to withstand pressure brought by the demands and challenges set by the work. Work is often physically demanding. Sometimes the working days can be long, and the work is done on weekdays, weekends, and Christmas holidays.

Communication with guests is conducted mainly in English. Your English language skills do not have to be excellent, but you need to be able to give instructions to our guests in English and at least briefly answer their questions or direct the questions to another colleague. Other language skills, especially Spanish and French, are also useful in our fell destinations. Previous experience of similar tasks in the field of tourism is considered advantageous, as well as experience driving a large van (class B drivers license) in arctic conditions.

**In Hetta** our Clothing team workers also work as Outdoor Activity Instructors for our Christmas-themed activities.

**In Olos** our Clothing team workers are responsible for distributing and maintaining the clothing of Charter guests in Lapland Hotels Olos area.

**We offer you:**

- A great team to work with

- Versatile and variable working days

- An easy way to start working in the field of tourism in Lapland

- Numerous leisure opportunities

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will begin at the end of November 2026 and will last approximately until the end of December or beginning of January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 10,10 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish public holidays are paid double. Except for Rovaniemi, accommodation is arranged; in shared rooms at a rent that is reasonable compared to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

**In order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.** If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

jobs.title: Chef, Restaurant Aihki, Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland
jobs.description:
**Join the team at Restaurant Aihki in Pyhätunturi!**

We are looking for a **Chef** to join Restaurant Aihki for the winter season 2026 - 2027, as part of Sunday Morning Resort in Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland.

Restaurant Aihki is known for its high-quality modern Nordic cuisine, where pure, locally sourced ingredients take centre stage. Our restaurant has twice been recognised among **Finland's Best Restaurants** by _Kauppalehti Optio_ (2022 & 2023, rating 16+).

As a Chef at Restaurant Aihki, you will work as part of our professional kitchen team and take an active role in daily food preparation and service. You will work with high-quality ingredients and help ensure that every dish leaving the kitchen meets Aihki's high standards.

This position is ideal for a chef with a few years of professional kitchen experience who is looking to develop their skills in a high-quality restaurant environment. Experience in à la carte, fine dining or Nordic cuisine is considered an advantage, but most importantly, we are looking for a professional attitude, a strong team spirit and a genuine passion for great food.

**Your responsibilities include:**

- Preparing and presenting dishes according to Restaurant Aihki's standards

- Working across different kitchen stations during daily service

- Preparing and handling ingredients

- Following Aihki's recipes, procedures and quality standards

- Ensuring the quality, proper storage and rotation of ingredients

- Following kitchen hygiene, food safety and self-monitoring procedures

- Keeping your workstation clean, organised and ready for service

- Working closely with the rest of the kitchen and front-of-house teams


**We are looking for someone who has:**

- Approximately 2-3 years of professional kitchen experience

- A relevant culinary qualification or equivalent practical experience

- Experience in an à la carte restaurant; fine dining or Nordic cuisine experience is considered an advantage

- Strong fundamental cooking skills and an interest in high-quality ingredients

- An organised, responsible and proactive approach to work

- The ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment

- Good teamwork and communication skills

- Good spoken English; Finnish and other languages are considered an advantage

- Motivation to learn and continue developing professionally

- Above all, a positive attitude and genuine passion for high-quality food


**We offer you:**

- The opportunity to work in one of Finland's highly regarded restaurants

- The opportunity to develop your skills in modern Nordic cuisine

- An inspiring working environment surrounded by the beautiful landscapes of Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland

- The support of a welcoming, professional and international team

- Comprehensive onboarding before your employment begins

- The possibility of staff accommodation close to the workplace

- Comprehensive occupational healthcare and local employee benefits

- Access to shared company season passes for Pyhä Ski Resort

- Employee benefits for selected activities

- The opportunity to work for a Sustainable Travel Finland certified company

- An excellent location close to Pyhä Ski Resort and local services

- A competitive salary based on your experience and skills, with the MARA collective agreement as the basis for salary


**Employment**

The position begins in **mid-November 2026** and continues until the **end of March 2027**.

This is a **full-time seasonal position**, approximately **40 hours per week**, with two days off per week. Shifts are mainly scheduled in the afternoon and evening.

Working a winter season in Pyhä also means experiencing the Arctic winter, snowy fells and the unique atmosphere of Finnish Lapland right outside your workplace.

**About us**

**Sunday Morning Collection is a Finnish family-owned tourism company** offering high-quality accommodation, dining and activity experiences in the breathtaking surroundings of Pyhä-Luosto National Park.

Sustainability is at the heart of what we do. We are committed to developing tourism responsibly, respecting the unique nature of Lapland and working closely with local businesses and partners.

As an employer, we believe in a positive working atmosphere, open communication, strong team spirit and opportunities for professional growth. With us, you'll work with international guests in the beautiful surroundings of Pyhätunturi as part of a skilled and close-knit team.

Restaurant Aihki is the restaurant of Sunday Morning Resort, combining the flavours and local ingredients of Lapland with contemporary Scandinavian influences. Throughout the season, we also organise themed dining events and guest chef evenings.

Discover Restaurant Aihki on Instagram **@restaurantaihki** and at **sundaymorning.fi/restaurant-aihki**.

**Interested?**

Please send your application with the subject line **Chef Aihki / \[Your Name\]**, together with your CV and salary expectation.

Tell us about your background, professional experience and why you would like to spend the upcoming winter season as part of the Aihki team.

We review applications throughout the recruitment period, so we encourage you to apply early.

**Applications and enquiries:**

- rekry@sundaymorning.fi

- sundaymorning.fi

Ravintola Aihki on laadukkaan ja modernin pohjoisskandinaavisen ruoan ravintola Pyhällä. Haluamme tarjota vieraillemme elämyksiä paikallisista raaka-aineista Lapin luontoa kunnioittaen. jobs.title: Pædagogisk leder til Børnehaven Ridemandsmøllevej
jobs.description:
Dagtilbud Svenstrup søger Pædagogisk leder til Børnehaven Ridemandsmøllevej.

Drømmer du om at stå i spidsen for en fantastisk børnehave, hvor du sammen med medarbejdere og forældre er medskaber af de bedste rammer for børnenes trivsel, udvikling og læring?

 

Dit nye job

Som pædagogisk leder træder du ind i et spændende og varieret job, hvor hverdagen er fyldt med mange forskellige opgaver – en hverdag hvor du bevæger dig mellem at være i pædagogisk praksis sammen med børn og medarbejdere, administrative opgaver, tværfagligt samarbejde og håndtering af bygningsmæssige opgaver. I Børnehaven Ridemandsmøllevej bliver du leder for en fantastisk personalegruppe, der er optaget af at videreudvikle pædagogisk praksis og skabe høj kvalitet med deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn. 

Dine vigtigste opgaver som pædagogisk leder på Ridemandsmøllevej bliver:

  • At understøtte den fælles pædagogiske retning, herunder den daglige struktur og organisering samt en stærk evalueringskultur.
  • At skabe følgeskab igennem tydelige forventninger, fælles ansvar og engagement i kerneopgaven.
  • At understøtte en kultur præget af psykologisk tryghed.

 

Din nye arbejdsplads

Børnehaven Ridemandsmøllevej er en børnehave normeret til 40 børn i alderen 3-6 år fordelt på to aldersintegrerede stuer. Børnehaven ligger som nabo til Lyngbjerggaardskolen i Godthåb midt i et stærkt lokalområde og med skøn natur, sportsplads m.v. indenfor gåafstand.

I Børnehaven Ridemandsmøllevej er vi optagede af nærværende relationer og af at skabe udviklende læringsmiljøer, som inspirerer børnene til leg. Vi arbejder med at skabe en mere ensrettet pædagogisk tilgang til hverdagens struktur og læringsmiljøerne med henblik på at sikre forudsigelige rammer omkring børnene. 

Vi vægter et godt forældresamarbejde højt og har en engageret forældregruppe, som gerne vil inddrages og bidrage. 

Se yderligere information på børnehavens hjemmeside Børnehaven Ridemandsmøllevej

Som pædagogisk leder i Dagtilbud Svenstrup bliver du en del af et lederteamet, som består af 10 pædagogiske ledere og dagtilbudsleder. Du bliver tilknyttet en erfaren lederkollega som mentor, og du bliver en del af et forpligtende samarbejde med fokus på at skabe de bedste rammer for alle dagtilbuddets børn, familier og medarbejdere.

I Dagtilbud Svenstrup arbejder alle institutioner med udgangspunkt i ICDP og NEST. Gennem vores NEST forløb har vi skærpet vores fælles blik på deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn igennem arbejdet med bl.a. visuelle støttesystemer og den voksnes facilitering af udviklende læringsmiljøer ude som inde. Vi har to indsatspædagoger, som løbende understøtter dette helt ude i praksis.

Som pædagogisk leder får du mulighed for løbende faglig og personlig udvikling, herunder diplomuddannelse i Ledelse.

 

Vores ønsker til dig

Vi arbejder ud fra Børn og Unges fælles vision - Aalborg Kommune og Et dagtilbud i balance - en grundfortælling - Fagfolk. Vi søger derfor en pædagogisk leder, som tør sætte sig selv i spil i praksis, som trives i samarbejde på tværs og som ikke er bange for at igangsætte samtaler om både det gode og det svære. Du vil blive mødt af høje forventninger og en høj grad af frihed og mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på udviklingen i institutionen.

Vi forventer at:

  • Du er uddannet pædagog og har erfaring fra dagtilbudsområdet. Din uddannelse er gerne suppleret med en lederuddannelse eller du har som minimum mod på at påbegynde en.
  • Du har høje ambitioner for den pædagogisk praksis, går forrest og skaber følgeskab.

Description of Employment Allpro Security Services Ireland Limited is seeking experienced Painters to carry out interior and exterior painting and decorating work on residential and commercial construction projects. Duties and Responsibilities Read and interpret drawings, specifications and work instructions. Inspect and prepare surfaces by cleaning, scraping, sanding and filling as required. Apply primers, undercoats, paints and protective or decorative finishes using brushes, rollers or spray equipment as appropriate. Comply with all site health and safety requirements. Work effectively with other trades and site management. Requirements and Skills Minimum five years' verifiable relevant experience in painting. Valid Safe Pass and Manual Handling certification, or the ability to obtain them before commencing work. Ability to prepare surfaces and apply finishes accurately to a high standard. Ability to work as part of a team with strong communication skills. No formal education requirement; relevant trade experience is essential. Location(s) of Employment The employment will be carried out at various residential and commercial construction sites in Dublin and other locations in Ireland, as required by the employer. Employer office address: 12A Westlink Commercial Park, Oranmore, Co. Galway, H91 Y00V. Hours of Work Offered 39 hours per week. Minimum Annual Remuneration €48,144.72 gross basic salary per annum (€23.74 gross per hour, based on 39 hours per week over 52 weeks). How to Apply Please send your CV and cover letter to hr@allpro.ie and quote "Painter" in the email subject line.

jobs.title: Responsable adjoint parc de loisirs (H/F)
jobs.description:
Profil recherché :

- Ancien directeur de centre de loisirs
- Responsable d'équipement de loisirs ou de camping
- Membre du bureau d'une association sportive ou agent de développement de club sportif
- Diplômé en management du sport et des loisirs
- Formateur aux métiers du sport et de l'animation

Compétences et expérience :

- Encadrement et accueil de tout public (enfants, parents, partenaires)
- Gestion de projet, service client et gestion des conflits
- Notions de commerce, marketing et communication
- Management et formation d'équipe
- Gestion, entretien d'un équipement et sécurité/réglementation ERP
- Maîtrise des outils de caisse et informatique de base
- Gestion de stock et tenue d'un snack (normes HACCP indispensables)
- Premiers secours (PSC1 ou SST requis)
- Bricolage léger (maintenance de premier niveau : structures gonflables, karts)
- Animation et événementiel

Qualités recherchées (Soft Skills) :

- Esprit "Comique" : Souriant, énergique, dynamique, créatif et convivial.
- Esprit "Protecteur" : Responsable, rigoureux sur la sécurité, avenant et empathique.
- Autonomie & Polyvalence : Investi et débrouillard, capable d'anticiper les tâches et d'alterner rapidement entre la caisse, la préparation au snack et l'entretien du site.

Missions et champs d'action :
En tant que véritable bras droit du gérant, l'objectif est d'assurer la sécurité et la satisfaction des familles.

Pendant la saison (Gestion opérationnelle du parc et du snack) :
- Ouverture et fermeture sécurisée du site (mise en place et vérification des équipements).
- Surveillance des structures (notamment le nouvel accro-filet).
- Accueil physique/téléphonique, billetterie et encaissement.
- Préparation et service au snack lors des heures d'affluence.
- Coordination de 1 à 2 saisonniers en l'absence du gérant.

Hors saison (Collaboration sur le développement) :
- Stratégie marketing, communication, commercialisation et prospection.
- Événementiel, gestion RH et maintenance des locaux.
- Optimisation de la relation client et des outils de gestion.
- Gestion globale du snack (offres, achats, tarification).

Conditions de travail :

- Contrat : CDD de 12 mois à temps plein (septembre à août), avec temps de travail annualisé/modulé.
- Rémunération : Classification CCN ELAC. Au démarrage : Niveau III - Échelon 2 - Coefficient 215 (Assistant Confirmé).
- Évolution : Passage possible au Niveau IV - Agent de Maîtrise (Coefficient 250) après confirmation d'une autonomie totale.

jobs.title: Redovisningskonsult – föräldraledighetsvikariat till teamet för skandinaviska kunder
jobs.description:
Rantalainen är Finlands ledande och snabbväxande expertorganisation inom ekonomi- och löneadministrativa tjänster. Vi finns på över 100 kontor i Finland, Sverige och Norge. Vi erbjuder företag i alla storlekar ett brett utbud av tjänster inom ekonomi- och löneadministration, HR samt företagsbeskattning för att stötta deras affärsverksamhet och framgång. Våra närmare 45 000 kundföretag har tillgång till kompetensen hos över 2 700 experter. Läs mer om oss på vår webbplats här [https://www.rantalainen.fi/sv/].



Vi söker nu en redovisningskonsult för ett föräldraledighetsvikariat till teamet för skandinaviska kunder i Västra Nyland!



I denna roll arbetar du med ett konsultativt arbetssätt med våra kundföretags bokföring, bokslut och andra uppgifter inom ekonomiförvaltning. Du har regelbunden kontakt med dina kunder och använder din expertis för att omvandla ekonomiska siffror till beslutsunderlag samt bidra till utvecklingen av våra kunders verksamhet ur ett ekonomiskt perspektiv.

Du får planera och genomföra ditt arbete självständigt, men har alltid stöd av ditt eget team och hela vår breda expertorganisation. Som stöd i arbetet har du ett glatt och hjälpsamt team samt din närmaste chef.



Ditt teams bas finns på det Rantalainen-kontor som ligger närmast dig, till exempel i Västra Nyland eller huvudstadsregionen. Vi hoppas att du vid behov har möjlighet att arbeta på något av våra kontor tillsammans med de övriga teammedlemmarna. Enligt överenskommelse kan du också delvis arbeta på distans. Tjänsten är ett tidsbegränsat föräldraledighetsvikariat med en beräknad anställningstid från 1.10.2026 – 31.10.2027.



Vad erbjuder Rantalainen dig?

På Rantalainen erbjuder vi dig en intressant och ansvarsfull roll på Finlands ledande redovisningsbyrå inom en spännande bransch. Hos oss får du stöd av en kunnig organisation, goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling och moderna arbetsverktyg. Som en flexibel arbetsgivare ger vi dig friheten att planera ditt eget arbete, flexibel arbetstid och möjlighet till distansarbete, så att det blir enklare att kombinera arbetet med övriga delar av livet.

Vår ambition är att vara den bästa arbetsplatsen inom ekonomi- och löneadministration, både idag och i framtiden. På Rantalainen värdesätts varje medarbetare för den hen är, och hos oss får du en trivsam arbetsmiljö och en rättvis värdegrund. Vi satsar på ett kvalitativt ledarskap och goda karriärmöjligheter inom företaget.



Läs mer om våra omfattande personalförmåner och om Rantalainen som arbetsgivare på vår webbplats. Du kan också kolla Markus medarbetarberättelse och läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss som redovisningskonsult.



Det här hoppas vi att du har med dig?

Vi hoppas att du har en utbildning inom ekonomiförvaltning och erfarenhet av arbete inom området. Att upprätta bokslut är välbekant för dig, och du behärskar helheten inom ekonomiförvaltning samt arbetar självständigt. Du arbetar smidigt med kunder, och därför förutsätter vi att du kan arbeta på både svenska och finska. Kunskaper i engelska räknas till fördel.



Vi värdesätter erfarenhet av olika programvaror inom ekonomiförvaltning samt en vilja att lära dig nya system. Till dessa erbjuder vi naturligtvis en grundlig introduktion. Hos oss får du möjlighet att upprätthålla och utveckla din kompetens genom mångsidiga och kontinuerliga utbildningar.



Vänligen ansök så snart som möjligt, dock senast 6.9.2026. Vi behandlar ansökningar redan under ansökningstiden och fattar beslut så snart en lämplig person hittas. Vänta alltså inte till sista ansökningsdagen. Vi kontrollerar kreditupplysningar för den person som väljs i slutet av rekryteringsprocessen. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar per e-post.



Om du vill höra mer om tjänsten eller ditt framtida team berättar Business Director Joakim Lindfors gärna mer (010 321 6801).

CONFIANCE / AUTHENTICITE / AVENTURE HUMAINE / RECONNAISSANCE / REUSSITE

Nos valeurs guident notre quotidien et nous vous invitons à embarquer dans cette aventure palpitante avec nous !

De 2018 à aujourd'hui, pour 125 apprenants intégrés, c'est 86% de taux de satisfaction, 86% de réussite au TP et 92% de taux d'insertion dans l'emploi.

- Assurer la traçabilité des opérations effectuées et le conseil du client à l'issue d'une intervention

La formation allie cours théoriques et stage pratique sur site. Lors de son cursus, l'apprenant est accompagné d'un tuteur.

Disposer de connaissances et savoirs faire en électricité / électrotechnique, à minima un Bac pro MELEC ou acquis par l'expérience

Une bonne communication orale et écrite
Une bonne aisance relationnelle et le sens des responsabilités
Etre inscrit.e à France Travail

Notre process de recrutement pour vous intégrer dans cette formation :

Un échange téléphonique avec notre Chargé.e de recrutement
Des tests de prérequis (électricité et logique) et un entretien de motivation en face à face
La validation de votre candidature

Compter environ deux mois de délai entre votre entretien et votre intégration dans la formation.


La formation est entièrement gratuite. Pendant les 3 premiers mois, vous serez rémunéré(e) par France Travail via une indemnité de formation.

Si vous vous sentez prêt.e à endosser ce rôle , n'hésitez pas à postuler !

Ensemble, remplissons notre devoir avec détermination et passion !

jobs.title: Den selvejende institution. Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1.10.2026 eller snarest derefter en medarbejder 15-20 timer i gennemsnit pr. uge.
jobs.description:
Den selvejende institution Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1.10.2026 eller snarest derefter en medarbejder 15-20 timer i gennemsnit pr. uge.

Stefanshjemmet er et bo- og beskæftigelsestilbud til mennesker med erhvervet hjerneskade og/eller svære fysiske handicap.

Der er 10 beboere på en afdeling, og de har en erhvervet hjerneskade. På afdelingen er der ca.15 faste medarbejdere med forskellig baggrund og faglighed til at varetage pleje, omsorg, bostøtte og aktivitet for beboerne efter serviceloven.

På Stefanshjemmet værner vi om det tværfaglige miljø og har omkring 130 ansatte. Hovedgrupperne af ansatte består af SOSU-assistenter, pædagoger og ergo- og fysioterapeuter.

Det kan også være du er uddannet SOSU-hjælper eller sygehjælper.

Vi søger en medarbejder, der

·        brænder for sit fag

·        har lyst til at bruge tid sammen med beboerne i løbet af dagen til aktivitet og samvær og være med til at skabe en god hverdag for beboerne

·        evner at tage sig tid til nærvær med beboerne og påskønner livshistorierne

·        er engageret og god til at se muligheder

·        er udadvendt, opsøgende og initiativrig

·        ser værdien i dokumentation og deling af viden. Vi bruger dokumentationssystemet Modulus.

·        Det kan også være, du er fleksjobber, hvor timetallet passer godt

 

 

Som ansat på Stefanshjemmet er det vigtigt for os, at du er fagligt stolt, engageret og har hjertet på rette sted og et menneskesyn der stemmer overens med Stefanshjemmets værdier. Beboernes selvbestemmelse og værdighed ligger os meget på sinde.

Dagligdagen byder på mange spændende faglige udfordringer og etiske dilemmaer, gode kollegaer, godt arbejdsmiljø og højt humør.

Arbejdet på afdelingerne tager udgangspunkt i beboernes behov og muligheder og vi arbejder mere og mere med KRAP-modellens anerkendende og ressourceorienterede tilgang, såvel som vores neuropædagogiske tilgang, samt værdier og etik.

Alle medarbejdere indgår i arbejdet med plejeopgaver, bostøtte og aktiviteter for beboerne og byder ind i de fælles opgaver med hver deres faglighed. Vi søger en dedikeret medarbejder, der har lyst til at indgå i plejen, omsorgen og aktiviteterne for beboerne. Vi arbejder med udvikling af afdelingen såvel monofagligt som tværfagligt, så kompetencer og viden kommer bedst muligt i spil.

Du skal være indstillet på, at der er tale om et arbejde, hvor man skal have en god fysik samt kunne arbejde et sted, hvor man af og til udfordres følelsesmæssigt i sit arbejde.

Hvis du bliver ansat hos os, vil der blive udarbejdet et introduktionsprogram for dig, som en del af din oplæring i huset.

Vi får pr. 1.10.2026 også en ledig stilling i vaskeriet på ca. 10 timer pr. uge. Hvis du har interesse i også at søge denne stilling, må du gerne notere det i din ansøgning.

Vi vil glæde os til at modtage din ansøgning og håber, du kan se dig ind i de arbejdsopgaver, der er skitseret ovenfor.

Vil du vide mere er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Tina Rudebeck Holm på tiruho@aarhus.dk  eller telefonnr. 4185 7871

Du kan også få mere at vide om Stefanshjemmet på vores hjemmeside: www.stefanshjemmet.dk.

Arbejdstiden er skiftende dag- og aftenvagter med arbejde hver 3. weekend.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomster.

Vi har driftsoverenskomst med Aarhus kommune.

Ansøgningsfristen er onsdag den 23. september kl. 8.00 og ansøgninger kan sendes pr. mail på info@stefanshjemmet.dk mærket ”Medarbejder til HG2”

Vi söker inhoppare till Kristinestad för olika köksuppgifter. Oavsett om du har bakgrund som storkock eller diskare söker vi pigga och motiverade personer för vikariat av olika längd.
I Kristinestads område samt i närliggande kommuner finns skolor och daghem vars kök periodvis är i behov av vikarier. Har du behov av inhopp eller vill du få in en fot genom dörren? Här har du en utmärkt möjlighet att bekanta dig med arbetsuppgifter vid olika enheter.

Vi söker yrkeskunniga och utbildade kockar samt köksbiträden för assisterande uppgifter.
- För kockuppgifter kräver vi utbildning eller minst arbetserfarenhet från motsvarande uppgifter samt språkkunskaper (finska eller svenska).
- Som köksbiträde söker vi pigga och motiverade personer, som har erfarenhet av olika arbetsuppgifter i köksmiljö. Språkkunskaper i första hand finska eller svenska, men även god engelska räcker.

Vad vi söker:
- Behovet gäller i synnerhet inhoppare, så vi uppskattar möjlighet att ta emot arbetspass även med kort varsel. Samma vikarier tillfrågas i första hand också för längre vikariat.
- Arbetspassen är alltid vardagar mellan kl. 7–17.
- Tillgång till egen bil, eftersom vikariat även kan förekomma i närområdet.

jobs.title: Betonarbejdere til renovering og specialopgaver
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde med renovering af beton?

Hos Christiansen & Essenbæk er vi på udkig efter flere dygtige kolleger til vores afdeling for betonrenovering. Har du erfaring med betonarbejde – og trives du både med at skabe noget nyt og give nyt liv til det gamle – så vil vi rigtig gerne høre fra dig.

Som en del af vores specialiserede entreprenørvirksomhed får du fingrene i alt fra fundamenter og bundplader til reparation og forstærkning af eksisterende konstruktioner. Vi løser både store projekter, der kræver tung faglighed, og mindre opgaver, hvor detaljen gør forskellen.

Du bliver en del af et hold, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og ordentligt håndværk står øverst på dagsordenen – og hvor der er plads til udvikling, sparring og gode kollegaer undervejs.

Eksempler på opgaver du kan komme til at arbejde med:
  • Udførelse af fundamenter, sokler og terrændæk
  • Betonrenovering og finisharbejder
  • Renovering af altaner
  • Støbning af trapper, ramper og støttemure
  • Mindre elementmontager og specialopgaver

Du bliver en del af et sjak, hvor man hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok. Nogle opgaver vil du løse selvstændigt, andre i tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer og sjakbajs.

Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Har erfaring med betonarbejde, fx som struktør eller betonarbejder
  • Har kendskab til armering, støbning, forskalling og arbejde med diverse mørtler
  • Er mødestabil og god til at samarbejde
  • Har mod på en alsidig og fysisk arbejdsdag
  • Er engageret og har lyst til at blive en del af fællesskabet
Hos os kan du forvente:
  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med gode kollegaer og ordentlig tone
  • Specialiserede og varierende opgaver inden for beton
  • Grundig oplæring og mulighed for kurser
  • Løn efter kvalifikationer
Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send os en kort ansøgning. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet de rette.

jobs.title: Midwife with International Experience Wanted for the Labour Ward at Aalborg University Hospital
jobs.description:
Become Part of a Unique Community – Midwife with International Experience Wanted for the Labour Ward at Aalborg University Hospital
Do you dream of working in a place where professional excellence, compassion, and development go hand in hand?
Where you are surrounded every day by dedicated colleagues, and where your skills and experience are recognised, utilised, and appreciated?
If so, this is your opportunity to join our fantastic maternity team at Aalborg University Hospital.

We are seeking a midwife with international experience and knowledge of different childbirth cultures for a permanent position, starting on 1 September 2026 or as soon as possible. We wish to expand our work on childbirth culture and cultural understanding and are therefore looking for a midwife who can contribute to this development. The position is not a development role, but a standard clinical midwife position on the labour ward with a special professional profile.

We expect you to have experience working as a midwife in a non-European country and to be fluent in a widely spoken world language other than English. You must have completed the Danish adaptation and evaluation employment programme and hold Danish authorisation as a midwife.

Why Choose Us?
At Aalborg University Hospital, you will find more than just a job—you will become part of a strong, supportive, and professionally inspiring community.
We are the largest maternity unit in the North Denmark Region. As a highly specialised department, we provide care for approximately 3,300 pregnant women, women in labour, postpartum women, and their families each year. Here, you will have the opportunity to apply your professional expertise in a dynamic environment with varied responsibilities and room for both specialisation and professional development.

In addition, we offer:
  • A clinical supervising midwife on every shift as a dedicated professional mentor
  • A personal coordinator during your onboarding period
  • A buddy system on every shift
  • Opportunities for professional courses, supervision, and targeted competency development
  • Teams and professional communities that hold regular group meetings with both professional and social content

You will become part of a large and engaged professional community consisting of approximately 150 skilled colleagues—midwives, nurses, healthcare assistants, doctors, and administrative staff—all dedicated to creating safe, coordinated, and professional maternity care pathways.

Opportunities with Us
We understand that a long working life includes changing needs and interests. Therefore, we place great emphasis on flexibility and the opportunity to combine different functions according to your preferences.
This means you may combine work in areas such as:
  • Labour Ward and Midwifery Antenatal Clinic
  • Labour Ward and Maternity Assessment Unit
  • Labour Ward and Postnatal Ward

The majority of our midwives work in combined positions like these, creating professional variety, development opportunities, and job satisfaction.
We highly prioritise education and professional growth, and as a midwife with us, you will be part of a workplace where learning and development are natural parts of everyday practice.

Who Are You?
You are a qualified midwife with substantial professional experience from another country and exposure to a different childbirth culture.
You thrive in a professionally strong environment where teamwork, safety, and professionalism are central values.
You are passionate about working in the birthing suite. You enjoy building new relationships and work confidently both in complex obstetric cases and in births where the most important task is simply “being there” for the woman and her family.
You are able to identify the differences between childbirth cultures and contribute valuable insights and reflections to the daily professional discussions on the labour ward.

In addition, we expect that you are fluent in a widely spoken world language other than English. You must have completed the Danish adaptation and evaluation employment programme and hold Danish authorisation as a midwife.

Most importantly, you:
  • Want to become part of a committed and caring team
  • Contribute positively to a supportive and developmental work environment
  • Are passionate about creating safe and coherent childbirth experiences

Our Values – Your Foundation
Our work is based on the North Denmark Region’s core values: Involvement, Trust, Decency, and Professionalism (I-TOP).
This means that we meet women, families, and relatives with empathy and respect—and we treat each other in the same way.

We Offer You
  • A workplace characterised by high professional standards, warmth, and humour
  • Strong interdisciplinary collaboration where everyone contributes
  • A quality standard that ensures one midwife for every woman in labour
  • A work environment where psychological and physical well-being are prioritised
  • Supervision by trained supervisors in structured group programmes
  • A unique collaboration between Health and Safety Representatives, Union Representatives, and Management, based on openness, respect, and trust
  • A department where ideas are encouraged and where your voice matters
  • A workplace that values your experience and is genuinely curious about your professional background

And last—but certainly not least:
The best colleagues in the world and a workplace you look forward to coming to every day.

Salary and Employment Conditions
Salary and employment terms according to the current collective agreement for non-managing midwives, etc., concluded with the Danish Midwives' Association.

Further Information
For questions about the position, please contact:
Arianne Brandborg Nørhave
Acting Deputy Head Midwife and Manager of the Labour Ward
Phone: +45 20 73 07 50
Email: a.noerhave@rn.dk

Recruitment Process
Application deadline: 20th of september 2026
Please submit your application, CV, and any other relevant documents electronically to this e-mail: m.cederstroem@rn.dk

Interviews: Expected to take place shortly after the application deadline.

Starting date: 1th of October 2026 or earlier by agreement.

jobs.title: Account Manager Capital Sales Ocean Division
jobs.description:
Account Manager - Ocean Division NDR



Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.



As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



About the Job
As our new Account Manager Ocean Division, you will play a pivotal role in driving the company's growth by proactively identifying and pursuing new business opportunities. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast paced, customer focused environment and enjoys the challenge of building lasting relationships.



Your responsibilities will include:

    Direct sales responsibilities, ensuring customer success for your assigned accounts, handling all activities from inquiry to order.
    Generate and nurture leads, converting them into orders.
    Collaborate with the other teams such as Business Development, P&A and Service in order to grow the business.
    Engage actively with the market, focusing on customer interactions, including regular in person engagement, understanding customer needs, and delivering product and service value.
    Develop value based quotes that reflect customer needs and highlight unique selling points.
    Actively follow up on quotes to ensure the proposed value is understood and matches customer needs.
    Provide direct support to customers during the quotation process.
    Work proactively and in a structured manner within and across teams to optimize sales efficiency.
    Use CRM and other tools consistently and effectively to support the sales process and decision-making.



This position is based in one of our Nordic Sites located in Sandvika, Espoo, Søborg, Aalborg or Lund.



Who You Are

You are a proactive and driven sales professional with strong communication skills and a passion for building customer relationships. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, are comfortable using digital tools, and enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. You are structured, goal-oriented, and eager to deliver value to customers while growing your career in a global company.



What You Know
To succeed in this role, we imagine you have:

    Proficiency in commercial contract management and understanding.
    Experience in field sales, account management, or a similar customer-facing role, with a proven track record of successful face-to-face customer engagement.
    High digital competence including frequent usage of CRM systems and digital communication tools.
    You understand technical products and can translate customer needs into value-based solutions.
    Excellent interpersonal skills, comfortable communicating with individuals and teams, including at senior levels.
    Strong communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language.
    You know how to work collaboratively across teams to achieve sales goals.
    Technical education, such as a bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field would be a benefit.



What We Offer

You'll be part of a small, informal team where everyone's voice matters. We work hard, but we also make sure there's room for a healthy balance in life. Teamwork is at the heart of everything we do, we support each other, share ideas, and celebrate our successes together. As part of Alfa Laval, you'll also enjoy the benefits of working in a global company, with opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from around the world, learn from diverse perspectives, and grow your career in an international environment.



What's in it for you?

You'll enjoy a challenging and rewarding role in a global, open, and supportive environment. You'll collaborate across functions, gaining broad business insights and building a valuable international network. Your contributions will be recognized, and you'll see the real impact of your work on Alfa Laval's success. As you help shape the future of our industry, you'll also have opportunities for personal and professional growth, developing your skills, expanding your horizons, and advancing your career in a company that values innovation, teamwork, and initiative.



For More Information
Please contact Ocean Capital Sales Manager Anna-Maja Eriksson

TAP, Divya Sharma



Application Deadline: Please submit your application no later than 15th September 2026



Selection and interviews will be ongoing continuously. Please be aware that the application process may close earlier if we identify suitable candidates, so do not delay in applying.



As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role.



We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.



Applications sent directly via email will be disregarded without notice due to GDPR.

We are looking forward to your application.
