- Développement commercial : définir et piloter le plan d'action commercial, développer les partenariats locaux, renforcer la visibilité de l'établissement, optimiser le mix clientèle et contribuer à l'amélioration durable du chiffre d'affaires.
- Revenue management et performance : En relation avec le revenue manager du groupe, suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (taux d'occupation, prix moyen, RevPAR, GOP), analyser les résultats, identifier les axes d'amélioration et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires.
- Management : recruter, encadrer, accompagner et fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs. Développer une culture de la performance, de l'engagement et de la satisfaction client.
- Exploitation : garantir le bon fonctionnement quotidien, veiller au respect des standards de marque, assurer la qualité de service et maintenir un haut niveau de satisfaction client.
- Gestion sociale : accompagner les évolutions organisationnelles du site et assurer un dialogue social constructif dans un contexte d'internalisation récente des équipes de ménage.
- Pilotage économique : élaborer et suivre les budgets, optimiser les charges d'exploitation et garantir la rentabilité des établissements.

Votre profil :
Issu d'une formation en hôtellerie, tourisme ou gestion, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative en direction d'hôtel ou en direction adjointe au sein d'établissements à forte capacité.
- Vous êtes reconnu pour votre forte orientation résultats et votre capacité à développer l'activité commerciale d'un établissement. Véritable manager de terrain, vous savez mobiliser les équipes, accompagner le changement et créer une dynamique positive dans des contextes exigeants.
- Doté d'une excellente culture opérationnelle, vous maîtrisez les enjeux de rentabilité, de revenue management et de satisfaction client. Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, de leadership et d'une forte capacité d'analyse.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Har du starka kunskaper inom redovisning och ekonomi, och motiveras du av att skapa struktur, kvalitet och insikter i finansiella processer? Trivs du i en roll där du får ansvar för rapportering, controlling och ekonomisk uppföljning? Då kan detta vara rätt möjlighet för dig.

Om rollen

Tjänsten är baserad på vårt nordiska huvudkontor i Albertslund, Danmark. Som Financial Controller får du en viktig roll i den löpande ekonomistyrningen och rapporteringen av våra verksamheter. Ditt huvudsakliga ansvarsområde blir att stötta och följa upp våra svenska och finska bolag samt säkerställa hög kvalitet i den finansiella rapporteringen och ekonomiska uppföljningen.

Du ansvarar för finansiell uppföljning, månads- och årsbokslut samt för att säkerställa noggrannhet och kvalitet i våra redovisningsdata och finansiella rapporter. Du kommer att delta aktivt i budget- och prognosprocesser, analysera ekonomiska resultat och bidra med insikter som stödjer ledningens beslutsfattande.

Du kommer även att arbeta med processförbättringar och interna kontroller för att säkerställa effektiva och robusta finansiella processer. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med både interna och externa intressenter, och du kommer att bidra till att säkerställa efterlevnad av gällande redovisningsprinciper och interna riktlinjer.

Ditt arbete kommer att vara avgörande för att skapa transparens, kvalitet och kontroll i våra finansiella processer.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som inte bara är erfaren, utan även har ett genuint intresse för att skapa struktur och kvalitet i ekonomiska processer. Du har en relevant utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning eller finans samt erfarenhet från en liknande roll.

Du behärskar engelska och minst ett skandinaviskt språk och har stark analytisk förmåga. Du arbetar strukturerat och noggrant och är bekväm med att hantera stora datamängder och finansiella analyser. Erfarenhet av ERP-system och Excel är meriterande.

Som person är du proaktiv, ansvarstagande och självständig. Du trivs med att samarbeta över organisatoriska gränser, skapar förtroende genom din professionalism och har ett naturligt intresse för att förbättra processer och arbetssätt. Du tar ägarskap för dina uppgifter och levererar resultat med hög kvalitet inom överenskomna tidsramar.

Intresserad?

Vi genomför intervjuer löpande, så skicka in din ansökan och ditt CV redan idag.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Heidrun Thorsteinsdottir på +45 2234 6657.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

jobs.title: Hostellityöntekijä
jobs.description:
**Hostellityöntekijä** - Hostel Café Koti, Rovaniemi

Hostel Café Koti on vuonna 2016 avattu laadukas hostelli ja kahvila Rovaniemen keskustassa. Nimensä mukaisesti olemme kodikas, aito ja välittävä yksityisyritys, joka työllistää ympärivuotisesti noin 10 henkilöä. Meille Kodissa on tärkeää työntekijöiden hyvinvointi, asiakkaiden tyytyväisyys, palvelun ja tuotteiden laatu sekä asioiden tekeminen kestävästi omalla tyylillä, arvojemme mukaan. Meille ovat yhtä tärkeitä niin paikalliset kuin muualta saapuvat vieraat.

Etsimme nyt kahta hostellityöntekijää vahvistukseksi tiimimme talvisesonkiin. Työ on määräaikainen marraskuun 2026 alusta maaliskuun 2027 loppuun saakka, ja osa-aikainen vähintään 90h/3vkoa. Jos pidät monipuolisesta työstä, nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja haluat työskennellä osana lämminhenkistä tiimiä, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.

_Mitä odotamme sinulta?_

Iloinen ja lämminhenkinen asiakaspalvelija, jolla on tilannetajua ja kyky kohdata asiakkaat aidosti myös vilkkaassa ympäristössä. Arvostat kestävää toimintaa, viihdyt monipuolisissa työtehtävissä ja palvelet asiakkaita sujuvasti sekä suomeksi että englanniksi. Lisäksi sinulla on voimassa olevat anniskelu- ja hygieniapassit.

_Roolisi meillä_

Hostellityöntekijänä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti kaikkea, mitä seiniemme sisällä tapahtuu – vastaanoton ja kahvilan työstä aina kerroshoidon tehtäviin.

_Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?_

Tarjoamme sinulle työn mukavassa ja lämminhenkisessä työyhteisössä, jossa saat hyvän perehdytyksen tehtäviisi. Työhyvinvointiasi tukevat niin esihenkilöt ja työkaverit kuin laaja työterveyshuoltokin. Lisäksi saat käyttöösi henkilöstöetumme sekä mahdollisuuden oppia ja kehittää itseäsi osana kasvavaa ja kehittyvää yritystä.

_Lisätietoja_

- Työsuhde: määräaikainen 9.11.2026 - 28.3.2027

- Työaika: vähintään 90 h / 3 vkoa

- Työ on kaksivuorotyö, joka sijoittuu pääsääntöisesti maanantaista sunnuntaihin klo 06.00-20.30 väliselle ajalle. Vuorot kiertävät tasavertaisesti samaa työnkuvaa tekevien välillä.

- Palkkaus sovittavissa, kokemuksen mukaan

- Lisätietoja antaa majoituspäällikkö Janne Pietilä sales@hostelcafekoti.fi


_Haku_

- Laita vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja CV:si 18.9.2026 klo 16.00 mennessä osoitteeseen sales@hostelcafekoti.fi

- Täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, haethan siis pian!

jobs.title: Paving Worker / Landscaping Construction Worker – Practical Skills
jobs.description:
Work location: Denmark
Working hours: 37 hours per week
Employment type: Full-time, permanent position
Salary: After qualificatons
Start date: By agreement

About the position

We are looking for practical and reliable employees to carry out paving and landscaping construction work in Denmark.

The position is suitable for candidates who have good practical skills, an aptitude for manual work and an interest in construction and outdoor work.

A formal vocational qualification as a paving worker or landscaper is not required.

Instead, we value practical experience, a good understanding of manual work, accuracy, reliability and the ability to learn new working methods.

Main duties

The work will primarily include:

  • Paving and surfacing work

  • Laying paving stones, concrete slabs, cobblestones, kerbstones and other paving materials

  • Measuring, setting out and preparing work areas

  • Excavation and preparation of ground and sub-base

  • Levelling and compacting sub-base and sand

  • Cutting and adapting paving materials

  • Establishing and adjusting edges, levels and gradients

  • Minor landscaping and groundworks

  • Using hand tools and small construction machinery

  • General maintenance and cleaning of the work area

  • Following applicable health, safety and environmental regulations

The exact tasks may vary depending on the project and the employee's practical experience.

We are looking for someone who

  • Has a natural aptitude for practical and manual work

  • Is comfortable with physically demanding work

  • Works accurately and takes pride in the quality of their work

  • Can work independently based on instructions

  • Works well as part of a team

  • Is reliable, punctual and responsible

  • Is motivated to learn and develop practical skills

  • Preferably has previous experience in paving, landscaping, construction, groundworks, installation, renovation or other practical work

A formal vocational qualification is not required.

Relevant practical experience from construction, civil works, groundworks, installation, renovation, agriculture or other practical occupations is considered an advantage.

Language requirements

English is an advantage.

Danish is not required at the time of employment. However, the employee must be able to understand relevant work instructions and health and safety instructions sufficiently to perform the work safely.

Salary and employment conditions

The fixed and guaranteed salary is:

DKK 37,500 gross per month for 37 hours of work per week.

In addition, the employer provides an occupational pension in accordance with the applicable employment terms.

The fixed cash salary corresponds to your qualifications

The salary is fixed and guaranteed and is not dependent on bonuses, commissions or overtime.

Employment conditions, including working hours, pension, holiday entitlement, overtime and notice periods, will be specified in the employment contract and will comply with applicable Danish legislation and customary Danish employment conditions for the position.

Occupation / DISCO-08

DISCO-08: 711220 – Paving Work

The position specifically involves paving and surfacing work, including the preparation, installation and finishing of paved surfaces.

What we offer

  • Permanent full-time employment in Denmark

  • 37-hour working week

  • Fixed salary matched to your qualifications

  • Training and introduction to the company's working methods

  • Varied projects within paving and landscaping construction

  • A professional working environment

  • Opportunity to develop practical and manual skills

How to apply

Please send your CV and a short description of your previous work experience.

You do not need to have a formal vocational qualification.

Instead, please describe the practical work you have previously performed, the tools or machinery you have experience using, and the types of tasks you are accustomed to carrying out.

Candidates will be assessed based on their practical experience, aptitude for manual work, motivation, reliability and ability to learn.

This is a genuine full-time position in Denmark and the vacancy will be advertised through Jobnet and EURES.

jobs.description:

ASKOLA

MYYJÄ, SALE MONNINKYLÄ, 25 H/VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme myyjää SaleMonninkyläänvakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Myyjän työtehtävissä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti kaupan eri tehtäviä, mm. asiakaspalvelutyötä kassalla,päivittäisen siisteyden ylläpitoa ja tavaroiden hyllytystä. Päivittäiseen työhösi kuuluu myös myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtiminen sekä tuotteiden esillepano ja saatavuuden varmistaminen.

Me Sale Monninkylässä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei toki tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä jotenkin tylsää tai tylsää porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin!

Toivomme sinulta:
- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Reipasta ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä asennetta sekä halua oppia uutta.
- Kykyä ottaa järjestelmät haltuun.
- Mahdollisuutta tehdä vaihtelevaa vuorotyötä - myös juhlapyhinä.
- Suomen kielen taitoa ja ruotsin kieli katsotaan eduksi.

Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työ, joka saa sinut hyvälle tuulelle niin ennen työpäivää kuin sen jälkeenkin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.

Palkkaus
- Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta(10,89 €/h – 14,57 €/h), johon vaikuttavat kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
-5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Mahdollisuuden koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen jopa 1,70 €/ tehty työtuntitulospalkkioonyrityksen tuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittareiden perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 13.9.2026. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa toimipaikkapäällikkö Suvi Heikkinen (suvi.heikkinen@sok.fi). Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

---

FÖRSÄLJARE, SALE MONBY, 25 H/VECKA, FAST ANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en försäljare till Sale Monby för en fast anställning. Som försäljare får du arbeta mångsidigt med butikens olika uppgifter, bland annat kundservice i kassan, daglig renhållning och varuplock. I ditt dagliga arbete ingår också att se till att butiken är trivsam samt att säkerställa produkternas exponering och tillgänglighet.

Här på Sale Monby brukar vi säga att vi har helt vanliga jobb. Vanlighet betyder förstås inte att vi skulle ha det tråkigt eller att vi skulle vara ett tråkigt gäng – tvärtom!

Vi önskar att du
- möter kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe <3
- har en glad och kundserviceinriktad attityd och vilja att lära dig nytt
- har förmåga att ta i bruk nya system
- har möjlighet att arbeta i varierande skift – även under högtider.
- har kunskaper i finska; kunskaper i svenska ses som en fördel.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- Ett jobb som får dig på gott humör både före och efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där man inte lämnar kollegorna i sticket och där cheferna jobbar sida vid sida med teamet.
- Möjlighet att utvecklas och utbilda dig.
- Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, smink, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.
- Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmån.

Lön
- Lön enligt handelns kollektivavtal (10,89–14,57 €/h), beroende på din erfarenhet och utbildning.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 procent om du kan betjäna kunder på båda finska och svenska.
- Möjlighet till hela personalens gemensamma resultatpremie på upp till 1,70 euro per arbetad timme, baserat på företagets resultat och branschvisa mätare.

Intresserad?
Vi går vidare i rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast söndag 13.9.2026. Mer information om tjänsten får du av enhetschef Suvi Heikkinen (suvi.heikkinen@sok.fi). Anställningen börjar enligt överenskommelse.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Vantaalle
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Vantaalle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi – työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Kohtaamisia erilaisten ihmisten kanssa

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työsi sisältöön

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, Ikääntyneiden palvelut, Asumispalvelut, Mynämäki ja Raisio
jobs.description:
Haemme lähihoitajia Kuivelakotiin Mynämäelle ja Ruskakotiin Hulvelan palvelukeskukseen Raisioon.

Kuivelakoti on 15-paikkainen ikääntyneiden ympärivuorokautisen palveluasumisen yksikkö, joka sijaitsee rauhallisessa maalaismiljöössä Mynämäen keskustassa. Asukkaat ovat muisti- ja monisairaita ikäihmisiä.

Ruskakoti on 18-paikkainen pääasiassa muistisairaita asiakkaita hoitava yksikkö Hulvelan palvelukeskuksessa Raisiossa.

Lähihoitajana olet osa moniammatillista tiimiä, jossa osallistut asukkaiden perushoitoon, lääkehoitoon, ravitsemuksesta ja hygieniasta huolehtimiseen, oSKE-toiminnan järjestämiseen, ulkoiluun sekä kuntouttavaan hoitotyöhön yhdessä muun henkilökunnan kanssa.

Työ on kolmivuorotyötä.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Työ tarjoaa monipuolisen mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ikääntyneiden ja muistisairaiden asiakkaiden hoidossa. Pääset työskentelemään yksiköissä, joissa asukkaiden arjen hyvinvointia rakennetaan yhdessä eri ammattiryhmien kanssa.

Saat tehtävään yksilölliset tarpeet huomioivan perehdytyksen, jotta pääset sujuvasti mukaan yksikön toimintaan ja työyhteisöön.

Meillä on käytössä yhteisöllinen työvuorosuunnittelu, joten sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omiin työvuoroihisi.

Hulvelan palvelukeskukseen on hyvät kulkuyhteydet bussilla, ja omalla autolla kulkeville on käytettävissä maksuton pysäköintialue. Kuivelakotiin on mahdollista kulkea julkisilla kulkuvälineillä, mutta yhteydet eivät palvele kaikkia työvuoroja, joten oman kulkuneuvon käyttö voi olla tarpeen.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Toivomme kiinnostusta ikääntyneiden ja muistisairaiden asiakkaiden hoitotyöhön. Kinestetiikan ja ergonomian osaaminen sekä voimassa oleva hygieniapassi katsotaan eduksi.

Tehtävässä toimiminen edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.

Eduksi katsomme voimassa olevan LOVe-lääkeluvan, joka on myös mahdollista suorittaa työsuhteen alussa määräaikaan mennessä.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammatillinen perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteinen tutkinto sekä voimassa oleva rekisteröinti JulkiTerhikki - ja JulkiSuosikki-rekisterissä.

Kiinnostuitko? Hae mukaan tekemään merkityksellistä työtä ikääntyneiden parissa Kuivelakotiin tai Ruskakotiin. Odotamme hakemustasi.

Etenemme rekrytointiprosessissa jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävät sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Etsimme Vaasaan henkilökohtaista avustajaa tukemaan asiakkaan arkea. Työ sisältää säännöllistä kauppa-asiointia maanantaisin klo 13.00-15.30 sekä torstaisin noin klo 13 alkaen (kesto yleensä noin 2 tuntia). Lisäksi työvuoroja voi olla satunnaisesti esimerkiksi sunnuntaisin ulkoilun merkeissä. Asiakas arvostaa avustajalta hyvää suomen kielen taitoa, ja aiempi kokemus avustamis- tai hoivatyöstä katsotaan eduksi. Asiakkaan toiveena on löytää tehtävään naisavustaja, jonka kanssa yhteistyö vastaa parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla asiakkaan yksilöllisiä tarpeita. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer! Build production software – and raise the engineering bar around you
jobs.description:
If your definition of seniority is more than simply having written code for many years, this could be interesting.

Cubris develops software that helps rail operators run smarter, safer and more sustainable railway services.

As part of Hitachi Rail, we are now strengthening our engineering organisation and developing Cubris into a high-performing technology competence centre around our GreenSpeed® platform.

We are therefore looking for a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong hands-on development skills with technical ownership.

This is not a role where you receive a Jira ticket, implement it and move on.

You will take ownership of delivery within a product area – from understanding requirements and making implementation decisions to coordinating development, identifying risks and getting robust software into production.

What you will do

You will:

  • Design, develop and ship production-grade software

  • Translate requirements into clear technical tasks and solutions

  • Take ownership of technical execution within a product area

  • Coordinate development across multiple engineers when required

  • Identify dependencies, blockers and technical risks before they affect delivery

  • Challenge unclear requirements constructively

  • Participate actively in design discussions and technical reviews

  • Design and document architecture at component level

  • Develop and maintain release pipelines

  • Work closely with Product and Quality Engineering

  • Support colleagues through technical sparring, reviews and coaching

  • Improve code quality, testability, maintainability and delivery practices

The role is deliberately broader than coding alone. Cubris expects senior engineers to take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.

What you bring

We are looking for substantial software engineering experience and a strong track record of taking software from requirements into production.

Your technical foundation should include:

  • Strong C#/.NET experience

  • Docker/container experience

  • Azure DevOps Cloud

  • Solid software design fundamentals

  • Testing and code-quality practices

  • CI/CD and modern delivery workflows

  • Debugging and performance thinking

  • Database and data-access experience

Experience with .NET MAUI, Blazor, Android/device-based UI or embedded UI solutions is relevant for parts of the GreenSpeed® environment and would be an advantage.

But technical skills alone are not enough.

You should also be comfortable creating momentum when requirements are ambiguous, making sound engineering decisions and helping other developers become better. The formal role description specifically calls for experience leading technical initiatives without necessarily having formal people-management responsibility.

Why Cubris?

You join at a point where your experience can make a visible difference.

You will work close to Product, Quality Engineering and experienced technical colleagues while helping define the standards, tools and engineering practices of the organisation Cubris is becoming.

You get:

  • A technically meaningful product

  • Direct influence on engineering decisions

  • A focused Danish technology environment

  • International reach through Hitachi Rail

  • The opportunity to help build the engineering culture rather than simply become part of an established one

Location: Ballerup, Denmark
Company: Cubris – a Hitachi Rail company

Interested?

Reach out for an informal and confidential conversation.

Please note that work permit needs to be in place before applying and that there is no relocation package included. You must be able to commute to the office in Ballerup every work day.

jobs.title: Tech Lead! 50% Lead Developer. 50% Software Architect. 100% technical leadership.
jobs.description:
Are you the engineer people turn to when the code is difficult, the architecture matters and the team needs a technical direction?

Cubris is strengthening its engineering organisation around GreenSpeed® as part of our ambition to build a high-performing technology competence centre for intelligent railway solutions within Hitachi Rail.

We are looking for a Tech Lead who combines deep hands-on software engineering with architectural judgement.

This is deliberately not a traditional management role.

You will spend approximately 50% of your time as a Lead Developer and 50% as a Software Architect – building production software, solving difficult engineering problems and coaching developers while also representing your team in the Architecture Group and translating architectural direction into practical solutions.

Your role as Lead Developer

You will:

  • Write and ship production code

  • Take ownership of technically complex stories

  • Unblock other engineers when problems become difficult

  • Coach developers through pairing, design discussions and high-quality PR reviews

  • Raise standards for automated testing and CI/CD

  • Improve pipeline reliability and engineering effectiveness

  • Strengthen observability through logs, metrics and traces

  • Drive systematic reduction of technical debt

  • Establish useful patterns, runbooks and reference implementations

In other words: you are expected to remain technically credible because you are still doing the work.

Your role as Software Architect

At the same time, you will:

  • Represent your team in Cubris’ Architecture Group

  • Translate architectural decisions and ADRs into practical team standards

  • Define service boundaries, APIs, events and data contracts

  • Establish and verify non-functional requirements around security, reliability, performance and cost

  • Lead technical migrations and integrations

  • Manage architectural dependencies and compatibility

  • Maintain architectural documentation, roadmaps and decision records

You become the technical bridge between Product, Engineering and Architecture.

What you bring

We expect you to have:

jobs.title: Project Employee - Nordic Energy Capital-project, anonymous recruitment
jobs.description:
We are looking for a project employee to work on the international Nordic Energy Capital (NEC) project from 28 September 2026 to 31 July 2027.

The project will develop an interactive web service for energy data and citizen engagement, aiming to visualise and integrate sensor data from the citys IoT platform.

The Nordic Energy Capital (NEC) project develops solutions for a sustainable energy transition and participatory urban development. The project employees role is to support the technical implementation of the energy data and citizen participation portal being developed as part of the NEC project. The work includes tasks related especially to data visualisation, user interface development, building prototypes and using different data sources.

Key tasks
- mapping solutions for the portal
- defining and possibly even partly developing the user interface of the interactive portal
- defining and designing data visualisations
- conducting studies related to the processing of geospatial, IoT and sensor data
- assessing new technical solutions and tools for the needs of the project
- other supporting project tasks.

Qualification requirements
- a suitable higher education degree
- good command of English.

We expect
- an interest in developing online services
- experience in energy and software engineering
- the ability to work in a multidisciplinary environment and seek new solutions to problems.

An interest in the energy transition or sustainable urban development, as well as in the development of geospatial data systems, will be considered an advantage.

We offer
- the opportunity to work on a significant and impactful EUI-funded project promoting sustainable urban development
- an international network and opportunities for collaboration
- an inspiring and dynamic working environment
- extensive opportunities for remote working.

In addition, we offer staff benefits for city services, a bicycle benefit, and an ePassi employee benefit for sports, culture, wellbeing, and commuting.

The task-specific salary is €3,164.96 per month.
Any applicable supplements in accordance with the municipal collective agreement KVTES will also be paid.

The trial period is five months.

The interviews are scheduled to take place 21 September and 22 September.

Those invited to an interview must bring their original degree certificates and employment certificates with them.


This recruitment process is carried out as anonymous recruitment. This means that applicants names, ages, native languages, and genders are removed from the applications. Please fill in the sections on education, language skills, and work experience carefully, as interviewees will be selected based on this information. When writing the free-text section of the application, please also make sure that you follow the principles of anonymous recruitment. The supervisor selects the candidates to be interviewed from among the anonymous applications. After this, the recruitment process proceeds as normal.


To promote equality, the City of Vaasa favours anonymous recruitment. The aim of anonymous recruitment is to focus attention on applicants professional competence and work experience.

Vaasa is a beautiful, historic city with something for everyone. As the Nordic Energy Capital, Vaasa offers plenty of job opportunities, a wide range of study options and a variety of leisure activities, as well as beautiful scenery, the sea, culture, and energy. The international and truly multilingual city has a population of 70,118. Vaasa and its surrounding region are among Finlands most successful areas, offering opportunities to pursue your dreams.

The City of Vaasa is the largest employer in the Vaasa region, with around 3,500 people working in a wide range of roles and fields. A customer-oriented, innovative, and network-based organisational culture provides the foundation for a strong spirit of collaboration. As an employer, we are committed to coaching leadership and the wellbeing of our employees.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Platform Integrations (Monetization)
Chef- Zoku Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.

As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 

WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

Zoku is a new type of hotel that offers a place to live, co-work and socialize in Europe's most livable cities: Amsterdam, Vienna, Copenhagen & Paris. 

Designed for the new generation of travellers, Zoku is so much more than a long stay hotel. It is a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. Zoku is a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so travellers can stay connected and well rested as they live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities.

jobs.title: Production Worker (Day/night)
jobs.description:
Would you like to help ensure a more sustainable future? Vestas is currently looking for unskilled workers with experience in production work. We are looking for someone who wants to help ensure quality and prioritize safety and well-being in the workplace.

Being hired as a production worker at Vestas is not just about experience, it's about motivation, curiosity, and interest in learning new things. Through thorough training and instruction, we will provide you with all the tools to become skilled at making wind turbines. The Nakskov factory produces blades for our offshore wind turbines; the factory is an epoxy workplace, so everyone must complete an epoxy course or have a certificate no older than 5 years.

This posting is for those who thrive on working 12-hour shifts, either day or night.

Responsibilities

  • Safety: At Vestas, safety is the first priority, which means you must prioritize your own and your colleagues' safety, both physically and mentally.
  • Quality: Our next priority is top-notch quality, so we expect you to take pride in producing a product that meets standards.
  • Production Plan: At Vestas, we also have some plans that need to be met to deliver on time. So, we expect an employee who is diligent and strives to meet deadlines without compromising safety or quality.

Qualifications

  • You are in good physical shape and accustomed to standing and walking throughout the workday.
  • It is advantageous if you have experience with 5S and Lean.
  • It is advantageous if you have experience with production work, but if you are willing to learn, we would like to hear from you.

Competencies

  • You are quality-conscious and focus on safety.
  • You contribute to creating a good atmosphere at work.
  • You don't mind changing tasks.
  • You have an interest in learning new things and are curious.

We Offer

A workplace with a focus on employees, their safety, and providing them with the tools to create quality in their work. We offer an attractive salary package with health insurance, dental insurance, and a canteen arrangement.

Additional Information

  • Workplace: Nakskov
  • Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.
  • Reference check will occur after interviews. Please state in your application if you have a reference. 

Our commitment to a fair hiring.
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.

DEIB Statement
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process

About Vestas
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 185 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. With 30,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future. Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity. To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

jobs.title: IT Service Manager, UPM, Helsinki
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will provide leadership and endtoend service management ownership of global IAM, CyberSecurity and License Management within UPM IT and supplier ecosystem. You will ensure that service delivery from suppliers consistently supports business strategy, resilience, security and longterm value creation across the organization.

You will define and govern ITILbased ITSM frameworks in line with contractual requirements, setting clear expectations for service performance through SLA and KPI models while ensuring strong supplier governance and accountability. As the service manager accountable for service outcomes, you will steer prioritization, risk management and escalations, enabling transparency and informed decisionmaking at both operational and management levels, assuring compliance with; contracts and external/internal controls.

Acting as a key partner to our architectural design personnel, service owners and crossfunctional stakeholders, you will drive service alignment with enterprise roadmaps, support modernization initiatives and contribute to the evolution of scalable, futureready operating models.

Work tasks
- Provide endtoend leadership for IAM and CyberOperations services and suppliers, ensuring reliability, security and alignment with business strategy
- Establish and oversee SLA and KPI models, ensuring measurable service performance, transparency as well as continuous service improvement
- Manage service escalations and act as a single point of escalation for business-critical issues
- Lead and steer the governance forums
- Monitor service performance, risks, and dependencies across integrated services
- Drive service quality, stability, and customer satisfaction
- Ensure services comply with UPM security, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements
- Support budgeting, cost control, forecasting, and financial transparency for services
- Ensure alignment of services with UPM IT strategy, standards, and operating model
- Collaborate closely with Service Owners, Business IT, Architects and local/site IT management
- Act as the primary interface between UPM IT stakeholders and IT service providers

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of IT infrastructure, applications, and modern IT solutions
- Experience in stabilizing and improving complex IT services, specifically in IAM or CyberSecurity
- Proficiency in navigating multi-supplier ecosystems within a SIAM model
- Solid understanding of ITIL and ITSM practices
- Strong presentation, facilitation, and reporting skills
- Solution-oriented mindset with high accountability under pressure
- Fluent English skills

It is meritorious if you have
- ITIL certification

To succeed in the role, you also are:
- Change oriented
- Great communicator
- Stress tolerant

Other information:
- Start: As soon as possible
- Employment period: 6 months, possibility to extend
- Location: Helsinki, some flexibility to remote work. Occasional visits to UPM Tampere.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Sous Chef
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Employer: T & M Ventures Ltd, trading as The Burton Location: The Burton, 18/19 Duke Street, Dublin Position: Sous Chef Employment: Full-time Hours: 20 hours per week Salary: €41,600 equivalent to approximately €20 per hour based on a 40-hour working week, depending on experience. T & M Ventures Ltd, trading as The Burton, is seeking an experienced and motivated Sous Chef to join our professional kitchen team at The Burton, 18/19 Duke Street, Dublin. The successful candidate will assist the Head Chef in the day-to-day management and operation of the kitchen and will help ensure consistently high standards of international food preparation, presentation, food safety and kitchen organization. Main Duties and Responsibilities Assist the Head Chef with the daily management and operation of the kitchen. Supervise and coordinate kitchen staff during food preparation and service. Support the Head Chef in maintaining consistent food quality, presentation and portion control. Prepare, cook and present dishes to the required standards. Oversee food preparation and service across different sections of the kitchen as required. Assist with menu planning, development of dishes and implementation of seasonal menu changes. Ensure that all food is prepared and stored in accordance with food safety, HACCP and hygiene requirements. Monitor stock levels and assist with ordering, receiving and proper storage of ingredients and supplies. Assist with stock control, waste reduction and effective management of food costs. Train, support and supervise junior chefs and other kitchen personnel. Organise kitchen workflow and allocate duties to kitchen staff during preparation and service. Ensure kitchen equipment, work areas and food preparation areas are maintained to appropriate hygiene and safety standards. Assist in maintaining kitchen records and food safety documentation. Work closely with the Head Chef and management team to ensure the efficient operation of the kitchen. Deputise for the Head Chef when required. Ensure compliance with health and safety procedures and all applicable food hygiene regulations. Requirements Minimum of 5 years' professional experience at Sous Chef level (International cuisine). Strong knowledge of professional kitchen operations, food preparation and cooking techniques. Good knowledge of HACCP, food hygiene and food safety procedures. Experience supervising and coordinating kitchen staff. Ability to work effectively in a busy professional kitchen environment. Strong organizational and communication skills. Ability to maintain high standards of food quality and presentation. Ability to work as part of a team and support the Head Chef in the overall management of the kitchen. apply here

jobs.title: Manager salle de Loisirs (H/F) (3 postes)
jobs.description:
Rejoignez l'aventure d'un nouveau centre La Tête Dans Les Nuages à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91)
Bienvenue chez La Tête Dans Les Nuages !

Depuis plus de 25 ans, La Tête Dans Les Nuages fait vivre à ses visiteurs des expériences de loisirs uniques et immersives.
Arcades nouvelle génération, attractions interactives, réalité virtuelle, anniversaires, événements d'entreprise, moments en famille ou entre amis : nos centres sont de véritables lieux de vie et de divertissement pour tous les publics.

Dans le cadre de l'ouverture prochaine de notre nouveau site à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91), nous recherchons notre futur(e) Manager Loisirs.

Vous aimez le terrain, le management de proximité et le contact client ? Vous souhaitez participer à une ouverture de site et contribuer à sa réussite dès les premiers jours ? Alors rejoignez-nous !

Votre mission
Rattaché(e) au Directeur de Site, vous êtes un acteur clé de l'exploitation quotidienne du centre.
Véritable relais managérial sur le terrain, vous accompagnez les équipes et veillez à offrir à chaque visiteur une expérience mémorable.

- Manager et accompagner les équipes
- Participer au recrutement et à l'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.
- Former, accompagner et animer les équipes au quotidien.
- Garantir la bonne application des procédures et des standards de qualité.
- Fédérer les équipes autour de la satisfaction client et de l'esprit de service.
- Assurer le bon déroulement de l'activité durant votre présence.
- Garantir une expérience client exceptionnelle
- Accueillir et accompagner les visiteurs.
- Conseiller les clients sur les différentes offres du centre.
- Accompagner l'organisation des anniversaires, événements privés et séminaires.
- Veiller à la satisfaction des clients tout au long de leur visite.
- Gérer les éventuelles réclamations avec professionnalisme et réactivité.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement du site
- Superviser les opérations d'ouverture et de fermeture du centre.
- Veiller au respect des règles d'hygiène, de sécurité et des procédures internes.
- Contrôler la bonne tenue des espaces de loisirs et d'accueil.
- Participer à la gestion des stocks et des approvisionnements.
- Garantir la disponibilité et la qualité des prestations proposées.
- Être un véritable ambassadeur de La Tête Dans Les Nuages
- Partager votre enthousiasme avec les équipes et les visiteurs.
- Contribuer à créer une ambiance conviviale et dynamique.
- Participer activement à la réussite commerciale du site.

Votre profil
Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +2 minimum ou disposez d'une expérience équivalente.
Vous justifiez d'une première expérience réussie en management de proximité, idéalement dans l'un des secteurs suivants :
Loisirs, Restauration, Commerce / Retail, Hôtellerie, Evénementiel, Distribution.

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
Votre excellent relationnel, votre sens du service client, votre leadership naturel, votre dynamisme et votre esprit d'équipe, votre capacité à gérer les priorités et à prendre des initiatives, votre goût pour le terrain et l'opérationnel.

Vous appréciez les environnements dynamiques où aucune journée ne ressemble à une autre.

Conditions du poste

Travail selon planning variable.
Présence requise les week-ends, jours fériés et certaines soirées selon l'activité du site.
Deux jours de repos consécutifs en semaine.
Horaires aménagés dans le respect de la réglementation du travail.
Les avantages
Tickets restaurant après 2 mois d'ancienneté.
Mutuelle d'entreprise.
Prise en charge des transports en commun à hauteur de 50 %.
Intégration au sein d'un groupe leader du loisir indoor.
Participation à l'ouverture d'un nouveau site ambitieux.

jobs.title: Kokoonpanija tuotantoon
jobs.description:
Kokoonpanija tuotantoon

Etsimme arvostetulle teollisuusalan asiakkaallemme mekaanista asentajaa kokoonpanotehtäviin tuotantoon.

Asiakkaamme suunnittelee ja valmistaa omia suunnittelemiaan tuotteita eri laitevalmistajille teollisuuden tarpeisiin. Toimintaa ohjaa korkea laatu, vahva osaaminen ja pitkä kokemus alalta.

Tehtävässäsi

Pääset työskentelemään kokoonpano tiimissä tehden itsenäisesti monipuolista mekaanista osakokoonpanoa. Työssä pääset näkemään konkreettisesti kättesi jäljen sekä osallistumaan laadukkaiden tuotteiden valmistukseen alusta loppuun.

Työsi sisältää mm.:

- mekaanista asennus- ja kokoonpanotyötä

- teknisten piirustusten lukemista ja hyödyntämistä

- vianetsintää ja ongelmanratkaisua tuotannon eri vaiheissa, ennenkuin tuote lähtee ulos

- yhteistyötä kokeneen tiimin kanssa

Odotamme sinulta

Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta
Aikaisempaa kokemusta sarjatuotannon kokoonpanoista tai mekaanisista asennustyö kokemusta teollisuusympäristössä
Hyvää piirustusten lukutaitoa
Ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja oma-aloitteista työotetta
Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti, että osana tiimiä

Eduksi katsomme:

- erilaisten käsityökalujen käyttötaidot

- kokemuksen mekaanisesta asentamisesta ja kappaleiden käsittelystä

- ERP-järjestelmän käyttökokemusta

Tarjoamme sinulle

Vakaan ja arvostetun työnantajan
Modernit työvälineet ja siistin työympäristön
Mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön
Vaihtelevan työn, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi

Työsuhde alkaa määräaikaisena, mutta tavoitteena on pitkäaikainen yhteistyö. Työ on kokopäivätyötä arkisin, ja sitä tehdään 1–2 vuorossa, joten valmius vuorotyöhön on tärkeää.

Palkkaus määräytyy kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä – toimi siis nopeasti!

Huomioithan, että emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse tietosuojasyistä.


Talent ValtaGroup

Talent ValtaGroup on rekrytointeihin ja henkilöstövuokraukseen erikoistunut yritys, jonka toiminnassa yhdistyvät vahva asiantuntemus ja aito välittäminen. Uskomme, että onnistunut rekrytointi ei ole pelkkää osaajien ja yritysten yhdistämistä – se on ihmisten urapolkujen ja organisaatioiden menestyksen rakentamista.

Meillä rekrytointi tehdään tunteella ja taidolla. Kohtaamme sekä asiakkaat että ehdokkaat yksilöinä, kuunnellen ja ymmärtäen heidän tarpeensa. Toimimme avoimesti, joustavasti ja vastuullisesti varmistaen, että jokainen rekrytointiprosessi on sujuva ja ehdokaskokemus laadukas.

Pitkä kokemuksemme eri toimialojen rekrytoinneista ja henkilöstövuokrauksesta on tuonut meille kyvyn löytää juuri oikeat osaajat oikeisiin paikkoihin – tavalla, joka tuntuu oikealta.

jobs.title: Hallintosihteeri
jobs.description:
**Hallintosihteeri Pancho Villa Finland Oy:lle**

Haluaisitko olla osa Pancho Villa -franchising-ketjun loistokasta tarinaa? Avaamme haun täysin uuteen tehtävään ketjun näköalapaikalle!

Meillä Pancho Villassa pääset osaksi rentoa, mutkatonta ja eteenpäin menevää työyhteisöä. Olemme vahvasti kasvava kotimainen ravintolaketju, jossa välitämme työntekijöistämme ja tuemme toistemme onnistumista. "Pancho-perheessä" viihdytään pitkään, sillä arvostamme työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa, luotamme työntekijöihimme ja ylläpidämme avointa keskustelukulttuuria.

**Olisitko sinä etsimämme hallintosihteeri?**

Etsimme huolellista ja tarkkaa hallintosihteeriä vakituiseen tehtävään, jossa olet merkittävä osatekijä Pancho Villan menestyksessä. Työ sisältää muun muassa osto- ja myyntireskontran hoitoa, laskutusta, tiliöintiä sekä tiivistä yhteistyötä tilitoimiston, tavarantoimittajien ja ketjun yrittäjien kanssa. Lisäksi tehtävään kuuluu sopimuskannan ylläpitoa sekä kuittien ja kuluraporttien esikäsittelyä. Pääset myös järjestämään erilaisia kokoustilaisuuksia, ketjupäiviä sekä muita sisäisiä tapahtumia.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- **Joustavat työajat:** Voit rytmittää työpäiväsi vapaasti, kunhan olet tavoitettavissa ketjun yrittäjille ja yhteistyökumppaneille arkisin ydinajat klo 9.00–14.00.

- **Vapautta ja vastuuta:** Mahdollisuuden työskennellä etänä mistä päin Suomea tahansa. Toimistomme sijaitsee **Tampereella,** jonne toivomme sinun pääsevän tarvittaessa.

- **Reilun palkkauksen:** Kilpailukykyisen palkan, josta haluamme kuulla palkkatoiveesi. Palkka tehtävässä on noin 2 300–3 400 €/kk riippuen osaamisesta, kokemuksesta ja tehtäväkuvan laajuudesta.

- **Kattavat edut:** Liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun: ePassi, kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä tietenkin tuntuvat henkilökunta-alennukset ketjumme ravintoloihin ympäri Suomen.

- **Täyden tuen:** Nykyaikaiset työvälineet sekä mahtavan tiimin tuen, meillä et jää tehtäviesi kanssa yksin.


**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Kokemusta myynti- ja ostoreskontran hoitamisesta Procountorilla

- Kaupallista koulutusta, esim. merkonomi tai tradenomi

- Taitoa hahmottaa monimutkaisiakin kokonaisuuksia

- Vahvaa tietoteknistä osaamista ja uusien järjestelmien omaksumiskykyä

- Huolellisuutta, järjestelmällisyyttä ja täsmällisyyttä


**Arvostamme:**

- Kykyä kannatella samanaikaisesti useita lankoja

- Sujuvia tiimi- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- Positiivista otetta ja kehittämishalua


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Toimitusjohtaja Teemu Vanharanta, teemu.vanharanta@panchovilla.fi

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi palkkatoiveineen osoitteeseen **rekry@panchovilla.fi** viimeistään **25.9.2026**. Toimi kuitenkin nopeasti, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuajan puitteissa ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

jobs.title: DIAS Fellow in Engineering within Robotics
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Robotics. The candidate is expected to start on January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the Department and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. 

 

Who are we looking for

We seek a researcher with expertise in the field of Robotics, who is eager to develop their research career within the DIAS framework. The ideal candidate should demonstrate: 

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields. 

  • Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Qualifications

Successful applicants must: 

  • Have research experience in computer vision fields related to laboratory automation. This could include (but is not limited to) methods for:

    • vision-based handling of laboratory equipment, in particular glassware and fluids 

    • segmentation and vision-based handling of medical specimens and fluids

  • Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of Robotics, such as robotics control, modelling, computer vision, medical/industrial robotics and artificial intelligence. 

  • Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries. 

  • Be fluent in English.

  • Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network, are considered comparative advantages.

  • Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. 

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally. 

 

The Department

MMMI

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The institute is the origin of robotics research in Denmark and has spawned the world-renowned cluster of robotics in Odense with more than 130 robotics companies including Universal Robots and Mobile Industrial Robots. Building on our expertise in AI, robotics and software, we have raised strong research centres in related domains, such as Health Informatics and Energy Informatics, Drones and other relevant research areas. 

SDU Robotics

SDU Robotics conducts research among others within the fields of robotics and computer vision. The unit focuses on research problems from real robotics applications within manufacturing industries, hospitals, elderly care, and other partners in society. The unit also focuses on Robot related vision technologies for facilitating industrial part feeding, automated product assembly, uncertainty aware quality inspection, and biomedical segmentation for diagnosis and robot control. 

SDU Robotics’ research involves mathematical modeling and control of robots, robotic processes and robot systems, human-robot interactions, computer vision for reliable inspection and robot control, and simulation technologies for robotics and computer vision aimed at closing the Sim2Real gap. Artificial Intelligence is widely applied within all research fields. 

 

Additional information

For further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For more questions about the position please contact Head of Unit, Professor Thiusius Rajeeth Savarimuthu at trs@mmmi.sdu.dk.

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The candidate will be attached to The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute in Odense and is also expected to participate in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense regularly.
The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for tenure track assistant professor as described herein. Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Further information on salary and taxation.

 

The tenure track programme the Faculty of Engineering is aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area. Candidates enter the assistant professor level (for up to 6 years) and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position of associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented independent scholarly output, ground-breaking publications, achievement of excellence grants, and international research network.
Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

To qualify for the position, you must have obtained a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline. 

 

Application requirements
The application must include the following:

  • Letter of motivation that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position.

  • Detailed CV including documentation of experience, and contacts for possible references. 

  • An elaborate research and funding plan (max 4 pages) for the next three years including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications, indicating which publications are most relevant for the position.

  • Up to five of the most relevant research articles – if you submit a monograph, it counts as 3 articles. Please upload a pdf for each publication. For co-authored publications, briefly describe the extent of the co-authorship or your contribution to the publications (please do this for each co-authored publication). You can do so by using this form or by describing the co-authorship in such a way that the committee can assess the extent of your contribution.

  • Teaching Portfolio as documentation for teaching and learning experience as well as supervision qualifications. Any format is acceptable, but you can find inspiration for structuring your teaching portfolio on the Faculty's teaching portfolio page.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you can find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark.

Submission guidelines

  • All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be protected by password. 

  • Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.

Assessment of applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicant will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. 

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation and references may be obtained. 

 

About SDU
SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.
SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.



Equal opportunity employment
The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.



How to apply
Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply online" link provided in the job posting.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.
 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

NURMES

Kokki Break Sokos Hotel Bomballe

Huikaisevan kauniin Pielisen rannalla Pohjois-Karjalassa sijaitseva Bomba on ainutlaatuinen ja omaperäinen matkailukohde ympäri vuoden. Bomban uudestisyntynyt kylpylähotelli hellii jokaista aistia. Haluaisimme saada sinut mukaan rakentamaan omalla työpanoksellasi elämyksiä asiakkaillemme.

Haetaan kiireestä syttyvää sekä monipuolisesta työnkuvasta nauttivaa kokkia osaksi Bomban keittiötiimiä. A'la cartesta aamiaiseen, kokouksesta cateringiin ja kaikkea maan sekä taivaan väliltä on luvassa ainutlaatuisessa matkailukohteessa Pielisen rannalla. Sinulla tulee olla kokin koulutus tai aikaisempi työkokemus ravintolan keittiössä työskentelystä. Odotamme, että olet oma-aloitteinen, paineensietokykyinen ja tehokas henkilö. Sinä haluat sekä kehittyä omassa työssäsi ja kehittää työyhteisön toimintaa. Arvostat hyvää ruokaa ja ensiluokkaista asiakaskokemusta. Hygieniapassi vaaditaan.

Työtehtävä on vakituinen ja tunteja tarjoamme sinulle 75 h / 3 vk. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Me tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työnkuvan, loistavan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi. Meille on tärkeää, että työntekijöillämme on mahdollisuus oppia, kehittyä ja laajentaa omaa osaamistaan. jobs.title: Postdoc in material flow analysis and resource management
jobs.description:
The SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a postdoctoral position in material flow analysis and resource management. The position is initially offered for one year, with the possibility of extension depending on available funding.

The position will focus on quantitative assessment of material and resource systems. The work will involve analysis of material stocks and flows, resource use, waste management and recycling, and associated environmental impacts across different material systems and end-use sectors.

The postdoc will apply material flow analysis, life cycle assessment and scenario analysis to support research on resource and waste management. Application areas may include plastics, phosphorus, critical raw materials and other material systems.

The position will contribute to ongoing research projects and activities at SDU Life Cycle Engineering.

Main tasks

The main tasks include:

·         Quantifying material stocks and flows across different material systems and end-use sectors

·         Assessing secondary resource availability and future resource demand

·         Applying life cycle assessment and scenario analysis

·         Contributing to scientific publications and research projects

·         Contributing to teaching and supervision within relevant areas

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

·         A PhD in environmental engineering, industrial ecology, environmental science or a related field

·         Strong experience with material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, and scenario analysis

·         Strong quantitative and analytical skills

·         A strong publication record in relevant international journals

·         Experience in international research collaboration

·         Good written and spoken English

·         Ability to work independently and as part of a research team

Experience with plastics, phosphorus, critical raw materials or related resource systems will be considered an advantage. 

Research environment

As a postdoc, you will conduct independent research, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy and energy system optimization.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with external partners, including international conferences and research visits.

Application

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying

  • PhD degree certificate(s)

  • A list of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

Submission guideline: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

The application deadline is 10. September 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)  

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Wu Chen
Associate Professor
Department of Green Technology
SDU Life Cycle Engineering
University of Southern Denmark
Email: wuc@igt.sdu.dk

Assessment and selection process 

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

Read about the Assessment and selection process.    

Employment terms 

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from 15 October 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein.  

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.  

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s). 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information. 

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering. 

Apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu.
